Yubin seibum mi wen aibin gulijap dai, en yu nomo bin larram mi buldan, wulijim ai garra oldei wok garram yu langa yu lait.

Main God, jidan kain langa mi, en sori langa mi. Mi kaman langa yu blanga jidan seifwan, jis laik ola lilwan bard ran langa ola mamiwan bard blanga jidan seif wen trabul im kaman. Wal mi kaman langa yu blanga jidan seifwan wen det trabul im gulijap.
Main God, mi jingat langa yu. Yu Brabli Haiwan, en yu meigim det plen weya yu garram blanga mi hepin trubala.
Yu irrim mi langa hebin, en yu ensim mi en seibum mi. Yu bidim main enami olabat hu gibitbat mi adtaim. Yu kaman en album mi lagijat na. Yu oldei laigim yu pipul, en yu oldei dum wanim yu pramis.
Main enami olabat raidaran langa mi. Dei weidabat, redibala blanga kilim mi. Mi fil bradin na, laiga lilwan enimul im bradin wen im luk ola dinggo raidaran, en im luk olabat tang en olabat tuth.
God, yu shoum yu haibala pawa deya ontop langa skai, en yu larram pipul luk yu brabli shainiwan lait ebriweya langa dijan wel. Yu shoum pipul ebriweya yu brabli haibalawan!
Main enami olabat lukaranbat blanga mi. Mi brabli nogudbinji. Jis laik detlot men grajim bigwan hol wen dei wandi trepam enimul, wal lagijat na detlot men wandi trai trepam mi, bat dei garra oni trepam olabat ronselp. Dei garra jidan langa det trabul olabat selp.
Ai garra kipgon trastimbat yu, God. Trubala, ai garra kipgon trastimbat yu. Ai garra sing en preisim yu!
Mi dalimbat miselp, “Jidan gudbinji! Gajim yu gita en sing! Ai garra gidap bifo det san en sing!”
Main Bos, ai garra gibit yu theingks lida langa ola pipul. Ai garra preisim yu lida langa ola pipul brom ebri kantri.
Yu filing blanga kipgon laigimbat pipul im jidan ebriweya, brom longwei ontop raitdan langa graun. Yu trubalawei gajimap det skai.
God, yu shoum yu haibala pawa deya ontop langa skai, en yu larram pipul luk yu brabli shainiwan lait ebriweya langa dijan wel. Yu shoum pipul ebriweya yu brabli haibalawan!

Ol yumob boswan, yumob reken yumob kotim pipul raitwei? Yumob reken yumob gibit ebribodi feyago? Najing!
Yumob oni jinggabat blanga dumbat nogudbala ting, en kilimbat pipul ebriweya langa dijan kantri.
Nogudwan pipul oldei dum nogudbala ting olataim. Brom det taim wen deibin bon, dei oldei dalimbat laiya.
Olabat jidan wulijim sneik garram detmatj nogudwan poisin. Olabat jadimap miselp irriwol jis laik det defwan kobra sneik.
Im nomo lisin det myusik wen det men plei, o det klebawan men wen im singimbat.
God, dislot pipul wulijim detlot jigiwan laiyan. Breigimap ola tuth blanga olabat.
Larram olabat jis binijap wulijim woda weya im draiyap. Larram olabat jidan wulijim fletwan gras weya fladwoda nokamdan.
Larram olabat binijap wulijim det wem weya im draiyap. Larram olabat jidan wulijim beibi wen im bon dedwan.
God, dumaji yu wail langa olabat, wal yu binijimap olabat bifo dei sabi, jis laik weya sambodi kadimdan rabishwan gras.
Ola pipul hu jidan trubalawei garra jidan gudbinji wen dei luk ola nogudbala pipul git panish. Olabat garra luk detmatj blad buldan blanga detlot nogudbala pipul.
Ola pipul garra tok, “Trubala orait. Gudbala ting garra kaman langa detlot pipul hu jidan trubalawei. Trubala God im jidan boswan en im gibit feyago langa ebri kantri.”

Main God, seibum mi brom main enami olabat. Lukaftum mi brom ol detlot hu wandim kilimbat mi.
Seibum mi brom ol detlot nogudbala pipul. Seibum mi brom detlot hu laigim medrimbat pipul.
Yu luk deya! Olabat weidabat blanga kilim mi ded. Ola krulwan pipul majurrumapbat miselp blanga mi, bat ai nomo bin dum eni rong ting!
YAWEI, dei meigimbat miselp redi blanga kilim mi, bat ai nomo bin dum enijing rong!
YAWEI, gidap na en album mi garram main trabul. Yu luk tharran garram yu ron ai. YAWEI, main Boswan God, en God blanga ola Isreil pipul, gidap na en panishim ol detlot pipul brom ebri kantri. Yu nomo sori langa detlot hu jidan nogudbala en tufeiswan.
Main enami olabat oldei kambek ebri aftanuntaim, jis laik ola jigiwan dog weya dei wokaranbat ebriweya langa taun.
Detlot nogudbala wed weya dei toktok gin kadim jis laik ola bigwan naif, en dei tok langa dei ronselp, “God kaan lisin langa wi.”
Bat yu laf langa olabat, YAWEI. Yu mokim ol detlot pipul brom ebri kantri hu nomo bilib langa yu.
Main God, yu na main seifwan haus. Ai gin go langa yu dumaji yu na main seifwan haus.
Main God, yu oldei laigim mi, en yu garra go lida langa mi, en larram mi luk weya yu bidim main enami olabat hu oldei tok nogudbalawei blanga mi.
Bat nomo kilim olabat ded, main Bos, bambai main kantrimenmob mait fogedabat ebrijing yubin dum. Yu win oba langa olabat garram yu strongbala pawa, en spredimat olabat ebriweya, dumaji yu na det shild blanga melabat.
Olabat tok brabli nogudbalawei, en detlot nogudwan wed jidan langa olabat mawus. Larram detlot wed dagat olabat, dumaji dei reken miselp detmatj. Dumaji olabat oldei sweya, en oldei dalimbat laiya du,
wal yu gitwail langa olabat en binijimap olabat. Yu binijimap olabat holot na! En bambai na ebribodi oloba langa dijan wel garra sabi God im jidan boswan blanga Isreil.
Main enami olabat oldei kambek ebri aftanuntaim, jis laik detlot jigiwan dog weya dei ranabat ebriweya langa taun.
Olabat jis laik detlot jigiwan dog weya dei oldei lukaranbat blanga daga, en if dei nomo faidim naf daga dei stat jinginatbat adbala.
Bat main God, ai garra singim song blanga yu blanga det strongwan pawa blanga yu. Ebri moning ai garra singim song blanga yu filing blanga laigim olagijawan. Yu oldei jidan main seifwan haus. Wen trabul kaman langa mi ai go langa yu blanga kipum mi seif.
Main God, ai preisim yu, dumaji yu brabli strongbalawan. Ai go langa yu blanga kipum mi seif. Yu oldei laigimbat mi detmatj.


God, yubin gibit bekboun langa melabat, en yubin bidim melabat. Yubin gitwail brabliwei langa melabat, bat melabat askim yu blanga kambek en meigim melabat yu ronwan pipul igin.
Yubin meigim dijan kantri sheik nomo lilbit, en yubin bastimap dijan kantri. God, yu meigim dijan kantri jidan gudwan igin.
Yubin meigim ol yu pipul olabat ardimbat detmatj. Yubin meigim melabat buldanbat ebriweya laiga drangginbala.
Bat yubin gibit woning langa detlot hu weship langa yu blanga sabi, wulijim olabat gin kamat brom det deinja.
Ensim melabat preya en seibum melabat garram yu pawa, wulijim ola pipul hu yu laigim gin jidan seifwan.
God bin tok brom im brabli seikridwan pleis, “Gudbinjiwei ai garra kadimat det taun Shekam, en gibit det kantri Sukait Beli langa main pipul olabat.
Det dubala kantri gulum Giliyad en Manesa blanga main. Det kantri Ifreiyim jidan wulijim main speshalwan het, en det kantri Juda im jidan wulijim main seikridwan stik.
Bat ai garra meigim det kantri Moweb jidan wulijim rabishwan pleis weya dei tjakam dardiwan woda, en ai garra tjakam main but langa det kantri Idam blanga shoum mi bos blanga im. Mi jingat gudbinjiwei, dumaji aibin bidim detlot Filistain pipul.”
God, hu garra album mi en deigim mi langa det bigwan taun garram haibala wol? Hu garra album mi en deigim mi langa Idam?
Maitbi yubin libum melabat olagijawan na, God. Yu garra stil go garram melabat ami olabat o najing?
Yu album melabat fait langa dislot enami. Pipul kaan album melabat. Najing! Olabat nomo strongwan.
Oni yu na God garra meigim melabat win. Yu na garra bidim melabat enami olabat.

God, irrim mi wen mi kraikraibat. Irrim main preya.
Mi nogudbinji en mi jidan longwei brom main kemp. Mi jingat langa yu. Meigim mi jidan seifwan,
dumaji yu na oldei maindimbat mi. Yu na brabli strongbala blanga seibum mi brom main enamimob jis laiga strongwan haus.
Larram mi jidan langa yu seikridwan haus olagijawan. Larram mi jidan seifwan langa yu bingga wulijim beibiwan jukjuk weya im jidan seifwan andanith langa im mami wing.
God, yubin irrim main pramis, en yubin gibit mi wanim yubin gibit langa ol detlot pipul hu oldei rispek langa yu.
Yu larram det king jidan laibala longtaim, en larram im bigininimob jidan king afta langa im.
God, im garra oldei jidan bos, en yu garra oldei lukaftumbat im garram yu trubalawan filing blanga laigimbat olagijawan.
Blanga tharran na, ebridei ai garra oldei sing preis song langa yu wen ai gibit yu wanim aibin pramisim yu.

Mi weitabat kwaitbalawei blanga God blanga seibum mi, dumaji oni im na wanbala mi trastim.
Oni im na brabli strongbala, jis laiga rok weya oldei kipum mi seifwan. En im na main seifwan haus en nomo enijing kaan ardimbat mi.
Haulong main enami olabat garra kilimbat mi? Olabat reken mi jis laik olwan fens redibala blanga buldan.
Olabat meigim plen. Dei nomo wandim mi blanga jidan haibala weya ai garram rispek brom najalot pipul. Olabat laigim dalimbat laiya blanga mi brabliwei. Olabat oldei tok gudbala wed langa mi, bat insaid langa olabat hat dei oldei tok brabli nogudbalawei blanga mi.
Oni langa God na mi oldei trastimbat. Mi bilib oni langa im wanbala.
Oni im na brabli strongbala, jis laiga rok weya oldei kipum mi seifwan. Im na main seifwan haus en nomo enijing kaan ardimbat mi.
Oni God na oldei seibum mi en shoum rispek langa mi. Im oldei lukaftumbat mi en im na det brabli strongbala rok. Im na det seifwan haus blanga mi weya im oldei maindimbat mi.
Trastim God olataim, main kantrimen. Dalim im blanga ol yu trabul, dumaji im na det seifwan pleis blanga wi.
Yu kaan trastim pipul tudei. Olabat wulijim det win weya wi blowimbat blanga meigim faiya. Nomeda pipul jidan haibala o lobala, olabat jis najing. If yu meshurum olabat, dei kaan jidan hebiwan o laitwan, najing. Olabat wulijim det win weya wi blowin.
Nomo beldim enibodi blanga gajim eni gudbala ting. Nomo reken miselp yu gin abum enijing brom stilimbat. Nomeda if yu jidan brabli ritjwan, nomo trastim langa detlot ting.
Dubala meinwan ting aibin lisin blanga God. Im na det brabli strongbalawan God garram detmatj pawa,
en im filing blanga laigimbat pipul im jidan olagijawan. Yu na Bos en yu jadjim ebribodi raitwei en yu garra peiyimbek ebribodi blanga ola enijing weya deibin dumbat.

God, yu na main God, en mi wandim yu brabliwei. Holot main filing wandim yu. Main spirit jidan wikwan en mi thestiwan blanga yu, jis laik drai en rabishwan kantri weya wandim woda.
Larram mi luk yu deya langa yu seikridwan haus. Larram mi luk hau strongbala en haibala yu jidan.
God, blanga yu filing im kipgon laigimbat mi. Im mobedawan langa main laif. Blanga tharran na ai garra preisim yu.
Ai garra oldei gibit yu theingks raidap mi dai. Ai garra lidimap main bingga langa yu wen mi prei.
Main spirit garra jidan bulap en sedisfaid jis laik aibin dagat detmatj daga. Ai garra sing ola hepiwan song blanga preisim yu.
Naitaim wen mi leidan mi oldei jinggabat langa yu, en olnait mi jinggabat langa yu,
dumaji yu na bin oldei albumbat mi. Mi sing hepiwan song dumaji mi gudbinji. Mi jidan seifwan garram yu, jis laiga beibiwan jukjuk weya im jidan seifwan andanith langa im mami wing.
Mi holdim yu adbala, en yu bingga kipum mi seifwan.
Detlot hu oldei trai blanga kilim mi ded garra godan langa det pleis weya ola dedwan pipul jidan.
Olabat garra gitkil langa wofait, en ola wailwan dog garra dagadagat olabat bodi.
Dumaji God album det king blanga win, det king garra jidan gudbinjiwan. Detlot hu meigim pramis garram God neim garra preisim im, bat God garra jadimap ola mawus blanga laiyinbala pipul.

Mi garram trabul, God. Yu irrim main preya! Mi bradin blanga main enamimob. Yu seibum main laif!
Yu maindim mi brom detlot nogudwan plen blanga detlot nogudwan pipul. Olabat bigmob nogudwan pipul.
Olabat yusum olabat tang blanga tok ola wed laik shapwan naif, en ola krulwan wed kamat jis laik ola poisinwan erro weya det hanta yusum.
Olabat nomo bradin. Brabliwei dei spredimat ola laiyawan stori blanga ola gudbala pipul. Dei jis laik det hanta weya blandim miselp en shudum im erro.
Olabat album gija blanga dum nogudbala plen. Olabat tok gija hau dei garra pudum ola trep blanga gudbala pipul. En olabat tok, “Nobodi kaan luk melabat. God du kaan luk melabat.”
Olabat jidan en meigim plen blanga dum nogudbala ting en dei tok, “Wibin meigim brabli gudwan plen blanga dum.” Det hat en main blanga pipul im brabli difrinwan. Wi kaan sabi wanim dei jinggabat.
Bat God garra shudum olabat garram ol im erro, en streidawei olabat garra gitkil.
Im garra binijimap olabat blanga detlot nogud wed deibin tok. Detlot nogudbala wed weya deibin oldei toktok garra binijimap olabat. Ebribodi hu garra luk olabat garra sheikim olabat hed blanga mokimbat langa olabat.
Olabat holot garra bradin. Dei garra jinggabat wanim God bin dum en dei garra tok blanga ola ting weya imbin dumbat.
Ola pipul hu jidan raitwei langa YAWEI garra gudbinji blanga wanim imbin dum. Olabat garra go langa im blanga jidan seifwan. Ola gudwan pipul garra preisim im.

Brabliwei melabat garra preisim yu, God, deya langa Saiyan, en melabat garra kipumbat ola pramis melabat bin meigim langa yu.
Dumaji yu oldei ensim ola preya, pipul brom ebriweya garra kaman langa yu.
Ola nogudbala ting melabat oldei dumbat jidan bos blanga melabat, bat yu na oldei sori en larramgo melabat fri.
Ol detlot pipul weya yubin pikimat en bringimap blanga jidan langa det seikridwan haus blanga yu, jidan gudbinjiwan. Melabat garra jidan gudbinjiwei garram ola gudwan ting langa det seikridwan haus blanga yu.
God, wen yu irrim melabat preya yu oldei dum ola brabli gudbala ting en seibum melabat. Pipul langa ebri kantri en brom najasaid langa solwoda du trastimbat yu, God.
Garram yu pawa yubin meigim ola bigwan hil en pudum olabat langa olabat raitwan pleis, en dei shoum pipul yu na brabli strongwan.
Yu meigim det solwoda jidan kwaitbala. Yu meigim pipul jidan kwaitbala wen dei meigimbat trabul.
Wen yu dum ola brabli gudbala ting, ola pipul brom ola kantri sanraiswei raidap langa ola kantri sangodanwei hatjamp brabliwei, en olabat jingat gudbinjiwei.
Yu lukaftumbat dijan graun. Yu jandimdan rein en meigim det graun jidan brabli gudwan wulijim ola daga garra gro. Yu bilimap ola draiwan krik en ola riba garram woda. Yu pudum ola plent langa graun blanga ola pipul blanga dagat, en yu growimap olkain daga. Yu na dumbat ol dislot ting.
Yu jandimdan rein blanga meigim det graun jidan wetwan blanga meigim redibala blanga growimapbat ola sid daga. Yu jandimdan rein blanga meigim det graun sofwan wulijim ola yangwan plent garra gro.
God, dumaji yu brabli gudbala, yu gibit melabat detmatj gudwan ting. Yu gibit melabat olkain daga en bif.
Ebriweya langa kantri detmatj buligi, ship en nenigout jidan. Ola hil kantri garram olkain plent en gras en tri, en im jis laik im preisim yu gudbinjiwei.
Ola ship jidan detmatj langa det kantri, en sid daga gaburrumap ola plein kantri. Im jis laik ebrijing brabli gudbinji en sing en preisim yu.
Ola pipul langa dijan wel preisim God adbala gudbinjiwei!
Sing blanga preisim im haibala neim. Preisim im brabliwei.
Tok langa God, “Yu dumbat ola brabli gudwan ting. Blanga yu pawa im brabli strongbalawan, en yu enami olabat brabli bradin blanga yu en baudan lida langa yu.
Ebribodi langa dijan wel weship langa yu. Olabat preisim yu. Olabat sing ola preis song langa yu neim.”
Kaman en luk wanim God bin dum. Imbin dum ola brabli gudwan ting blanga pipul.
Imbin meigim det solwoda jidan drai graun. Wi femilimob hubin jidan bifo bin krosoba langa det riba garram fut. Deya na, wibin jingat gudbinjiwei blanga wanim imbin dum.
Garram im strongbala pawa im jidan bos olagijawan, en im wotjimbat pipul langa ola kantri. Nomo gibit bekboun langa YAWEI.
Ola pipul brom ebri kantri preisim wi God. Larram ebribodi irrim det preis.
Im nomo bin larram wi dai, en im nomo bin larram wi buldan.
God, yubin testimbat melabat wulijim silba wen im barn langa faiya blanga klinimat det rabish pat. Wal lagijat na yubin testim melabat.
Yubin larram melabat abum loda trabul jis laik melabat bin buldan insaid langa trep, en jis laik yubin meigim melabat garrimap hebiwan loud langa bekboun.
Yubin larram melabat enami olabat jidan krulbala bos langa melabat, jis laik deibin ranimdan melabat garram olabat hosis en bagi. Melabat bin abum brabli adtaim, jis laik wen faiya o fladwoda binijimap ebrijing blanga pipul. Bat yu na bin bringimap melabat langa seifwan pleis garram detmatj daga.
Ai garra deigim detlot barnapwan ofring langa yu serramoni pleis. Ai garra gibit yu wanim aibin pramisim wen aibin abumbat trabul.
<range>
Ai garra gibit ola fetwan enimul langa yu blanga sekrifais. Ai garra gibit yu ola boiwan ship en buligi en nenigout, en det smok garra gowap langa yu.
Ol yumob pipul hu gibit rispek langa God, kaman en irrim wanim imbin dum blanga mi.
Aibin jingat langa im blanga album mi. Aibin preisim im garram ola song.
If ai bina nomo sabi langa ol main nogudbalawei, im nomo bina irrim mi.
Bat God bin irrim mi orait. Imbin irrim main preya.
Mi preisim God, dumaji im nomo bin nokambek main preya, en kipumbek im filing blanga laigim mi olataim.

God, yu sori langa melabat, en yu dum ola gudbala ting blanga melabat. Yu garra luk langa melabat garram yu shainiwan feis,
wulijim ola pipul langa ebri kantri garra sabi wanim yu wandim olabat blanga dum, en ola pipul garra sabi yu na garram det pawa blanga seibum olabat.
Ola pipul preisim God! Larram ola pipul ebriweya preisim yu brabliwei.
Larram ola pipul langa ebri kantri jidan gudbinji en sing song gudbinjiwei langa yu, dumaji yu jadjim ola pipul raitwei en gibit olabat feyago, en yu lidim ebri kantri langa dijan wel.
Ola pipul preisim God! Larram ola pipul ebriweya preisim yu brabliwei.
God garra meigim dijan kantri jidan garram detmatj daga. Det God blanga wi na garra gibit wi ebrijing.
God garra brabli gudbala langa wi, en ola pipul ebriweya garra gibit im rispek.

God, yu gidap en meigim yu enami olabat ranawei ebriweya. Detlot hu nomo laigim yu, olabat ranawei dumaji dei nomo bin win.
Yu andimwei olabat ebriweya wulijim det win wen im blowimwei det smok. Wulijim kendul weya im meltap langa faiya, wal lagijat du detlot nogudwan pipul garra binij rait deya lida langa yu God.
Bat ola pipul hu jidan trubalawei garra gudbinji deya weya God im jidan. Olabat garra gudbinji en jingat adbala gudbinjiwei.
Sing langa God. Sing preis song langa im neim. Meigim det wei redi blanga tharran hu kaminap garram klaud. Im neim YAWEI det trubala God. Jidan gudbinji garram im.
God hu jidan langa im Serramoni Pleis, oldei lukaftumbat ola pipul hu nomo garram mami en dedi en ola widogel du.
Im gibit kemp langa pipul hu nomo garram femili, en meigim ola prisana jidan gudbinji en fri. Bat pipul hu laigim faidabat garra jidan langa kantri weya nomo garram enijing.
God, wen yubin deigimat yu pipul olabat brom Ijip, en yubin go lida langa olabat deya langa det deset kantri,
det graun bin sheik en rein bin buldan, dumaji yu na God, det God hubin tok langa Sainai, en yu na det God blanga ola Isreil pipul.
Yubin meigim detmatj rein kaman en meigim det drai kantri gudwan igin.
Yu pipul olabat bin meigim olabat kemp deya na, en garram yu gudwan filing yubin album ola powan pipul.
Bos, yubin gibit wed en loda wuman bin deigim dijan nyus ebriweya,
“Ola boswan en olabat amimob ranaweibat na!” Lagijat na deibin tok. Ol detlot wuman hubin stap langa kemp en maindimbat ola ship bin kadimat miselp ebrijing weya deibin gedim langa det wofait.
Deibin gedimbat detmatj silba en gol, en olabat bin jidan purdiwan jis laiga purdiwan bard.
Wen God det brabli boswan bin andimwei ola king langa det bigwan hil gulum Seilman, imbin meigim sno buldan deya.
Beishan im brabli bigwan hil. Im jandap garram loda haiwan haiwan hil.
Beishan, wotfo yu jidan jelas langa det hil gulum Saiyan weya God bin pikimat blanga jidan? YAWEI det trubala God garra jidan deya olagijawan na.
YAWEI bin kaman brom Sainai blanga go langa det seikridwan haus langa Saiyan. Imbin kaman garram detmatj hos en bagi yu kaan adli kaundimap olabat, jis laik ola lif langa tri.
Imbin gowap langa det haibalawan hil gulum Saiyan, en imbin deigim loda prisana garram im du. Ola pipul bin gibit im gudwan ting, en detlot nogudbala pipul hubin gibit bekboun langa im bin gibit im gudwan ting du. YAWEI det trubala God garra jidan deya na.
Wi garra preisim det Bos hu oldei garrimap wi trabul ebridei. Im na det God hu oldei seibum wi.
Det God blanga wi na im det God hu oldei seibum wi. Im na YAWEI det trubala God, wi Bos. Im na seibumbat wi brom daidaibat.
God na garra breigimap ola hedpat blanga im enami olabat, ol detlot na hu kipgon dumbat ola nogudbala ting.
Det Bos bin tok, “Ai garra bringimbek yu enami olabat brom det hil kantri gulum Beishan. En ai garra bringimbek olabat brom det dipwan solwoda,
wulijim yumob garra wok langa olabat blad, en ola dog blanga yumob gin dagadagat haumatj dei wandim.”
Main God, yubin win, en ebribodi bin luk yubin go lida langa yu brabli seikridwan pleis.
Ola singa bin go lida, en detlot hubin plei myusik bin kaman biyain, en langa midul ola yanggel bin hitimbat ola lilwan dram.
Wen ol im pipul olabat midap olabat tok, “Preisim God. Preisim YAWEI ol yumob femili blanga Jeikob.”
Det lilwan klen blanga Benjamin bin go lida basdam. Brom deya ola lida blanga det klen blanga Juda garram olabat pipul olabat, en afta, ola lida blanga det dubala klen gulum Sebyulan en Neftali.
God, brom yu seikridwan pleis langa Jerusalem weya ola boswan king oldei bringim presen langa yu, shoum yu pawa, det pawa na weya yubin yusum basdam blanga seibum melabat.
<range>
Panishim detlot pipul langa Ijip hu jidan jis laik det wailwan enimul langa ribasaid, en panishim detlot enami olabat langa najalot kantri hu bosmob jidan laik ola wailwan buligi, raidap olabat meigim miselp lobala langa yu en gibit yu ola silba. Yu jandimwei ebriweya detlot pipul hu oldei laigim meigimbat wofait.
Meigim detlot boswan kaman brom Ijip garram ola kopawan presen, en meigim detlot Ithiyopiya pipul lidimap olabat bingga blanga prei langa God.
Sing song langa God ola pipul ebriweya langa dis wel. Sing blanga preisim im.
Im na kaman garram klaud brom det skai weya imbin meigim longtaim. Ebribodi irrim det thanda. Tharran na YAWEI jinginatbat adbala.
Ebribodi garra tok blanga det pawa blanga God. Im na jidan brabli boswan langa ola Isreil pipul, en det skai na shoum im pawa.
Im brabli haibalawan God en im kaman brom det pleis weya im jidan. Im na det God blanga ola Isreil pipul. Im na meigim im pipul olabat strongbala, en im na gibit olabat pawa. Preisim God!

God, seibum mi! Det woda im raidap langa main nek.
Mi godan olawei langa dipwan mad en andanith im nomo adwan, najing. Mi longwei langa dip woda en det woda im gulijap draundim mi.
Mi nokap na brom jinginatbat langa yu blanga album mi, en main throut im nogud du. Mi ardim ai brom lukaranbat blanga yu blanga album mi.
Detlot pipul hu nomo laigimbat mi fo najing, olabat jidan detmatj na, mowa den ol main heya langa main hed. Main enami olabat oldei dalimbat laiya stori blanga mi. Olabat strongbala en dei wandi kilim mi ded. Deibin meigim mi gibit ola ebrijing langa olabat weya ai nomo bin stilim.
God, ai kaan haidim ol main nogudbalawei brom yu. Yu sabi wen mi jidan nogudbala.
Yu na YAWEI, det Brabli Boswan God. Nomo larram mi meigim sheim langa ol detlot hu trastim yu. God blanga Isreil, nomo larram mi meigim sheim langa detlot hu weship yu.
Blanga yu na najalot pipul bin meigim fan langa mi, en mi jidan garram sheim brabliwei na.
Mi wulijim streinja langa main femilimob. Langa main femilimob mi jis laik brom najawan kantri.
Mi laigim det Serramoni Pleis blanga yu brabliwei. Main filing insaid im barn wulijim faiya. Wen pipul tok nogudwan wed langa yu, im meigim mi nogud du.
Wen ai nomo dagat daga blanga meigim miselp lobala, pipul tokabat nogudwei langa mi.
Wen mi werrimon sekbeigwan klos blanga jidan soribalawei, olabat laf langa mi.
Olabat tokabat mi ebriweya langa roud, en drangginwan pipul meigimap song blanga mi.
Bat mi, ai garra prei langa yu, YAWEI. God, langa yu ron taim yu ensim mi. Yu ensim mi, dumaji yu garram bigwan filing blanga laigim pipul brabliwei, en dumaji yu oldei kipum blanga yu pramis blanga seibumbat pipul.
Seibum mi God. Pulumat mi brom det mad. Nomo larram mi sinkdan. Kipum mi seif brom main enami olabat. Seibum mi brom det dipwan woda.
Nomo larram fladwoda gaburrumap mi, en nomo larram mi draun, en nomo larram mi godan langa greib.
Ensim mi YAWEI, dumaji yu na brabli gudwan en yu kipgon laigimbat mi detmatj. Dumaji yu brabli kainbala, wal yu kaman langa mi.
Nomo haidim miselp brom mi, yu wekinmen. Ai garram bigwan trabul. Yu ensim mi na.
Kaman langa mi en seibum mi. Seibum mi brom main enami olabat.
Yu sabi hau ai oldei abum adtaim, en hau mi jidan garram sheim, en nomo garram eni rispek. Yu gin luk ol main enami olabat.
Det nogudwan wed bin meigim mi nogudbinji en ai kaan dum enijing na. Aibin wandim pipul blanga sori langa mi, bat najing. Aibin wandim pipul blanga kaman langa mi blanga meigim mi gudbinji, bat najing.
Wen aibin hanggri deibin gibit mi poisinwan bif. Wen aibin thesti deibin gibit mi biniga.
Meigim olabat seikridwan padi panishim olabat gin. En meigim olabat jidan nomo garram enijing.
Meigim olabat blainwan, en meigim olabat garrimap hebiwan loud olagijawan.
Gitwail en ranimap olabat raidap yu gajim olabat. Dumaji yu wail langa olabat, wal yu panishim olabat.
Meigim olabat kemp jidan emtiwan. Nomo larram enibodi jidan laibala langa olabat kemp.
Olabat mokimbat ol detlot pipul weya yubin panishim. Olabat tokabat blanga detlot pipul weya jidan garram detmatj pein dumaji yubin panishim.
Yu raidimdan ola nogud ting weya dei dumbat. Nomo larram olabat joinin garram detlot pipul weya yubin meigim jidan fri.
Rabumat olabat neim brom det speshalwan buk blanga laif. Nomo larram olabat neim jidan garram ola neim blanga yu pipul olabat.
Bat mi ardim en ai nomo sabi wanim ai garra dum. Yu lidimap mi God, en seibum mi.
Ai garra preisim God garram song. Ai garra tokabat blanga det haibalawei blanga im en gibit im theingks.
Tharran na garra meigim YAWEI jidan mowa gudbinji, mowa den det buligi ofring. Nomeda if yu sekrifais brabli bigwan bul garram bigwan hon, im stil najing tharran.
Wen ol detlot pipul hu abumbat adtaim luk dijan, dei garra gudbinji. Detlot hu weshipbat God garra jidan mowa strongbala.
YAWEI im lisin langa ol detlot pipul hu nomo garram enijing, en im nomo fogedabat im pipul olabat hu oldei jidan prisana.
Ebrijing langa skai en graun, preisim God. Ola solwoda en ola enimul langa solwoda preisim im du.
Im garra seibum Jerusalem en bildimap ola taun langa Juda igin. Im pipul olabat garra jidan deya igin.
Detlot bambaiwan femilimob blanga detlot pipul hu teiknodis en duwit langa im garra teikoba en abum det kantri, ol detlot na hu laigim im garra jidan deya.

Main God, seibum mi! Kwikbala YAWEI, album mi tudei na!
Detlot hu trai blanga kilim mi, nomo larram olabat win, en yu meigim olabat grangran hed. Stapam detlot hu jidan gudbinji langa ol main trabul, en meigim olabat gobek garram sheim.
Detlot hu mokimbat mi, meigim olabat nogudbinji en jidan sheimwei.
Ol detlot hu kaman langa yu, larram olabat jidan gudbinjiwei. Ol detlot pipul hu jidan gudbinji wen yubin seibum olabat, larram olabat tok lagijat, “God na im brabli haibalawan orait!”
Bat mi jidan wikwan nomo garram enijing. Main God, kaman kwikbala langa mi! Yu na YAWEI, main trubalawan God en yu na gin seibum mi. Kaman kwikbala en album mi!
YAWEI, ai kaman langa yu blanga kipum mi seifwan. Nomo larram enibodi meigim mi sheim.
Dumaji yu oldei dum wanim rait, album mi en seibum mi. Irrim mi en seibum mi.
YAWEI, yu jidan jis laiga bigwan ston weya ai gin go enitaim blanga jidan seifwan. Yu main seifwan haus en yu fait blanga mi.
Main God, yu seibum mi brom ola nogudbala pipul, en brom det pawa blanga ola krulwan en brabli nogudwan pipul.
YAWEI yu det boswan God. Ai libum ebrijing langa yu. Aibin trastimbat yu brom yang taim.
Ol main laif aibin larram yu hendulum ebrijing. Yubin maindimbat mi olawei brom det taim wen aibin bon. Ai garra preisimbat yu olataim.
Main laif shoum loda pipul, yu na strongwan en yu oldei lukaftumbat mi.
Mi preisimbat yu oldei. Mi tokabat yu dumaji yu brabli haibalawan.
Nomo libum mi dumaji mi olbala. Nomo libum mi na dumaji mi wikwan.
Main enami olabat wandim kilim mi ded. Olabat tokabat blanga wanim dei garra dum langa mi.
Olabat tok, “God bin libum im na. Wi garra go en gedim im. Nobodi kaan seibum im.”
God, nomo jidan longwei. Kaman kwikbala en album mi.
Yu nomo larram detlot hu kaman blanga fait langa mi win. Yu binijap olabat. Yu meigim detlot hu wandi ardim mi, sheim brabliwei.
Ai garra oldei trastim langa yu blanga ebrijing. Ai garra kipgon preisimbat yu.
Ai garra dalimbat ola gudbala ting weya yu oldei dumbat blanga seibum yu pipul olabat, nomeda ai nomo sabi ebrijing weya yubin dum.
YAWEI, yu na det brabli strongwan God, en yu na bin dum detmatj ting garram yu pawa. Ai garra tokabat blanga yu dumaji yu trubala. Oni yu na ai garra preisim.
Main God, brom wen aibin lilwan yubin titjim mi, en raidap tudei mi stil dalimbat pipul blanga ola gudwan ting weya yu oldei dumbat.
Main God, nomo libum mi dumaji mi olwan en mi garram greiwan heya. Jidan garram mi wen mi toktokbat blanga yu pawa langa ola biginini, en olabat bigininimob wen dei garra kaman bambai.
Blanga yu raitwei im gajimap det skai. Yubin dum loda haibalawan ting. Nobodi jidan wulijim yu, najing.
Yubin meigim trabul kaman langa mi en aibin ardim, bat yu garra meigim mi strongbala igin. Yu kaan larram mi go langa greibyad.
Yu garra meigim mi jidan mowa haibalawan igin. Yu garra meigim mi jidan gudbinjiwei igin.
Ai garra preisim yu garram gita. Blanga det trubalawei blanga yu ai garra preisim yu, main God. Garram main gita ai garra plei ola song langa yu, det holiwan God blanga Isreil.
Ai garra jingat gudbinjiwei wen mi preisim yu. Brabliwei na ai garra sing dumaji yubin baiyimbek mi.
Oldei ai garra tokabat blanga det raitwei blanga yu, dumaji ol detlot hubin wandim trai kilim mi, dei nomo bin win en dei jidan brabli sheim na.
God, yu album det king blanga kotim pipul raitwei. Yu album im blanga gibit pipul feyago laik yu oldei dum,
wulijim im gin jidan bos blanga yu pipulmob raitwei, en gibit feyago langa detlot pipul hu abumbat adtaim.
Meigim dijan kantri jidan gudbalawei garram ebrijing, dumaji yu pipul bulurrum det raitwei blanga yu.
Meigim det king kotim ola powan pipul feyago, en albumbat ola pipul hu nomo abum enijing, en bidim detlot hu oldei gibit olabat adtaim.
Meigim det king jidan laibala olataim, jis laik det san shain olataim, en det mun gibit lait olataim.
Meigim det king jidan jis laik rein weya meigim ebrijing gudwan langa dijan kantri.
Meigim det king jidan det raitwei langa im laif olataim, wulijim ola pipul garra jidan gudbinjiwei garram ebrijing olagijawan.
Larram im jidan bos blanga ola kantri brom wan solwoda raidap langa najawan solwoda, en brom det Yufreitis Riba raidap najasaid langa dijan wel.
Detlot pipul hu jidan langa drai kantri garra nildan lida langa im, en im enami olabat garra tjakam miselp feisdan langa graun.
Ola king brom Tashish en brom ola ailin kantri garra gibitbat presen langa im. Detlot king brom Shiba en Seba garra bringimap ola ofring langa im du.
Meigim ola king nildan lida langa im, en ola pipul brom ebri kantri garra wek blanga im.
Im seibum ola powan pipul wen olabat jingat langa im, en ol detlot du hu nomo garram enijing en detlot weya nobodi album olabat.
Im garram soriwan filing blanga ola wikwan en ola powan pipul, en im seibum detlot laif blanga ol detlot hu nomo garram enibodi blanga albumbat olabat.
Im seibum olabat brom abumbat adtaim en brom faitfaitbat, dumaji olabat laif jidan speshalwan langa im.
Trubala, longtaim im garra jidan king! Larram detlot pipul brom Shiba gibit im gol. Larram ola pipul prei blanga im olataim. Larram God jidan gudbala langa im olataim.
Larram ola sid daga jidan detmatj langa det kantri. Larram ola hil kantri jidan garram detmatj daga, jis laik Lebanan garram detmatj. Larram ola taun jidan garram detmatj pipul, jis laik ola fam kantri jidan garram detmatj gras.
Larram pipul jinggabat det neim blanga det king olagijawan, en nomo fogedabat im. Larram pipul ebriweya sabi blanga im raidap det taim weya det san kaan gibit lait enimo. Larram pipul langa ebri kantri askim God blanga jidan gudbalawei langa olabat, seimwei laik imbin gudbala langa det king.
Preisim YAWEI det God blanga Isreil! Oni im na oldei dumbat ola gudwan ting.
Preisim im haibala neim olagijawan. Larram ola pipul ebriweya sabi det haibalawei blanga im. Yuwai! Trubala!
Dijan na det laswanpat blanga ola preya weya Deibid det san blanga Jesi bin prei.
Trubala YAWEI im brabli gudbala langa ola Isreil pipul, en langa detlot pipul hu jidan trubalawei langa im.
Bat aibin gulijap nomo bilib na, jis laik aibin gulijap buldan,
dumaji aibin jelas langa detlot praudbala en nogudbala pipul wen aibin oldei luk ebrijing bin oldei go gudwei blanga olabat.
Olabat nomo ardimbat olataim. Olabat jidan strongbala en gudwei.
Olabat nomo abumbat detlot trabul laik najalot pipul abumbat.
Ebridei olabat jidan brabli praudbala, en ebridei olabat oldei faitabat jis laik ebridei dei werrimon klos.
Brom insaid olabat adwan hat ol detlot nogudwan ting kamat, en olabat oldei jinggabat nogudwan ting olataim.
Olabat oldei laflafbat en toktok nogudwei blanga pipul. Dei jidan praudbala en dei oldei meigimbat plen blanga ardimbat najalot pipul.
Olabat tok nogudbalawei blanga YAWEI hu jidan deya langa hebin. En olabat oldei bosobabat ebribodi iya langa graun,
en ola pipul blanga YAWEI bin bulurrum olabat, en bilib wanim olabat bin tok.
Olabat oldei tok, “YAWEI det Haibalawan God nomo sabi enijing en im kaan faindat wanim wi dumbat.”
Lagijat na ola nogudbala pipul jidan. Olabat oldei abum blendibala ting, en dei gedimbat mowa en mowa enijing weya dei oldei wandimbat.
Maitbi fo najing aibin kipum miselp klinbala en nomo bin dumbat ola nogudwan ting.
God, yubin meigim mi abumbat det pein oldei, en ebri ailibala yubin oldei panishimbat mi.
If ai bina tok ola nogudbala ting, wal ai nomo bina jidan laik yu pipul olabat.
Aibin trai jinggabat blanga sabi ebrijing blanga ola gudbala pipul en ola brabli nogudbala pipul, bat najing. Imbin brabli adwan.
Bat wen aibin go langa yu Serramoni Pleis, deya na aibin sabi wanim garra hepin langa ol detlot brabli nogudbala pipul.
Yu na YAWEI garra meigim olabat buldan en olabat garra ol binijap.
Streidawei olabat garra binij. Olabat kaan dai gudwei.
Olabat jidan jis laiga drim weya gowei wen yu gidap ailibala. YAWEI wen yu gidap, olabat binij du, jis laik det drim.
Wen aibin oldei jinggabat ola nogud ting, en aibin oldei ardimbat,
aibin jidan brabli siliwan wulijim wailwan enimul. Ai nomo bin sabi langa yu.
Bat stil aibin jidan gulijap langa yu, en yu holdim main bingga.
Yu shoumbat mi wujei blanga go garram yu wed, en bambai yu garra welkam mi deya weya yu jidan garram yu pawa en shainiwan lait.
YAWEI, oni yu na ai garram deya ontop langa hebin. Dumaji ai garram yu, ai kaan wandim enijing langa dijan kantri na.
Maitbi main bodi en main garra jidan wikwan, bat yu na God meigim mi jidan strongbala, en oni yu na mi wandim olagijawan.
Ol detlot pipul hu gibit bekboun langa yu garra binijap. Yu garra binijimap ol detlot hu nomo jidan trubalawei langa yu.
Bat im brabli gudwan blanga mi blanga jidan gulijap langa yu God. Mi jidan seifwan garram yu, YAWEI det boswan God. Ai garra dalimbat najalot pipul blanga ola gudbala ting yubin dumbat.
God, wotfo yubin libum melabat? Yu garra lagijat olagijawan? Wotfo yu wail langa yu ron pipul olabat? Melabat blanga yu ship.
Yu jinggabat yu pipul olabat weya yubin pikimat blanga yu ronselp longtaim, en wen yubin baiyimbek olabat wen deibin jidan prisana, en yubin meigim olabat jidan yu ronwan traib. Yu jinggabat det hil gulum Saiyan weya yubin jidan bifo.
Yu wok oba ol detlot rabish weya yu seikridwan haus bin jidan. Melabat enami olabat bin bitsimap ebrijing.
Yu enami olabat bin jinginatbat adbala langa yu Serramoni Pleis. Deibin bidim melabat en bin pudumbat olabat fleig deya blanga shoum deibin win.
Deibin jis laik detlot pipul hu oldei kadimdan tri garram olabat eks.
Deibin smeshimap ola purdiwan wudwan ebrijing garram olabat eks en bigwan hema.
Deibin barnimap yu Serramoni Pleis garram faiya, en deibin dum brabli nogud ting deya weya melabat oldei kaman en weshipbat yu.
Olabat bin wandi binijim melabat brabliwei, en deibin barnimap ola seikridwan pleis langa dijan kantri weya melabat bin weshipbat yu, God.
Ola seikridwan ebrijing bin ol binijap, en ola speshalwan mesinja blanga God bin ol binijap du. En nobodi sabi haulong dijan trabul garra kipgon lagijat.
God, haulong dislot enami blanga melabat garra laflafbat langa yu? Maitbi olabat garra kipgon toktokbat nogudwei blanga yu neim fogud. Wotaim dei garra stap toktok nogudbalawei?
Wotfo yu nomo album melabat? Wotfo yu haidim miselp bingga?
Bat God, yubin jidan melabat king brom longtaim. Lodataim yubin oldei seibum yu pipul olabat iya langa melabat kantri.
Garram yu strongbala pawa yubin kadimat det solwoda, en yubin breigimap detlot hedpat blanga detlot bigwan enimul weya jidan insaid langa solwoda.
Yu na bin breigimap detlot hedpat blanga detlot bigwan krokadail gulum Labaiyathan, en yubin gibit im bodi langa detlot deset enimul blanga dagat.
Yu na bin meigim ola springwoda en lilwan krik randan. En yu na bin draiyimap ola bigwan riba.
Yu na bos blanga deitaim en naitaim, en yu na bin pudum det san en det mun langa dubala pleis.
Yu na bin meigim ebrijing langa dijan wel blanga jidan langa olabat pleis, en yu na bin meigim hotwetha en kolwetha.
Bat YAWEI, yu jinggabat. Detlot enami blanga yu bin mokimbat yu, en olabat nomo bin bilib en wandim yu.
Nomo larram ola wailwan enimul gajim lilwan bard blanga yu. Nomo fogedabat yu ronwan pipulmob hu abumbat adtaim brom ola krulwan enami.
Yu jinggabat det strongwan pramis yubin meigim garram melabat, dumaji ola nogudbala ting jidan langa ebri kantri tudei.
Yu nomo larram detlot pipul hu abumbat adtaim jidan garram sheim. Yu larram ol detlot powan pipul en ol detlot pipul hu nomo garram enijing preisimbat yu neim.
Yu gidap God, en jandap blanga yu wei. Yu jinggabat na blanga ol detlot pipul hu oldei mokimbat yu.
Yu nomo fogedabat yu enami olabat hu oldei jinginatbat. Dei oldei kipgon jinginat.

Wi gibit yu theingks, God. Wi gibit yu theingks. Wi dalimbat blanga hau yu jidan haibalawan, en wi tok blanga ola brabli gudwan ting yubin dum.
God im tok, “Aibin meigim taim blanga jadjimbat pipul, en ai garra gibitbat olabat feyago.
Nomeda dijan wel en ebrijing weya jidan laibala langa dijan wel sheiksheik nomo lilbit, ai garra meigim im meinwan pat jidan strongwan.
Ai dalim detlot pipul hu laigimbat miselp, ‘Nomo meigim miselp haibala!’
Ai dalim detlot nogudbala pipul, ‘Stap toktok praudbalawei! Nomo toktok oldei blanga yu pawa!’” Lagijat na God bin tok.
Det jadj nomo kaman brom sangidapwei o sangodanwei, o brom det nowathsaid o sauthsaid. Det pawa blanga jadjim pipul nomo kaman brom pipul.
Im kaman brom God, hu jidan det boswan blanga jadjimbat pipul. Im panishim sambala en najalot im larramgo fri.
YAWEI jadjim ola nogudbala pipul, jis laik im holdim kap langa im bingga, en det kap im ful garram strongwan wain. Tharran wain im det wailwan filing blanga im. Im spilimat det wain en gibit langa ola brabli nogudbala pipul blanga dringgim. Olabat dringgim en binijimap det wain holot.
Bat ai kaan neba stap toktokbat blanga det God blanga Jeikob, en blanga singimbat preis song langa im.
Im garra binijimap det pawa blanga ola brabli nogudwan pipul, bat im garra gibit mowa pawa langa ola gudbala pipul.

Ola pipul langa det kantri Juda sabi God. Dei rispek im neim langa Isreil.
Im garram kemp langa Jerusalem. Im jidan langa Saiyan, det bigwan hil.
Deya na, imbin breigimap ola erro blanga ol im enamimob, en ola shild en bigwan naif blanga olabat du. Ebrijing weya deibin abum blanga fait imbin breigimap.
God, yu shain garram lait brabliwei. Yu jidan brabli haibalawan wen yu kambek brom detlot bigwan hil weya yubin bidim ol yu enamimob.
Ola breibwan soljamob blanga olabat nomo garram enijing na, en tudei olabat ol dedwan. Olabat bin strongbala en bin sabi hau blanga fait, bat najing na. Olabat kaan dum enijing.
God blanga Jeikob, wen yubin graulim olabat adbalawei, detlot hosis en ola men bin buldanbuldan ded.
Bat oni langa yu YAWEI, ebribodi bradin. Wen yu gitwail, nobodi kaan jandap langa yu.
Brom ontop langa hebin yubin larram pipul sabi blanga yu kotkeis. Ola pipul langa dijan wel bin bradin en deibin jidan kwaitbala.
Wen yubin gidap blanga tok langa det kotkeis, yubin gitredi blanga seibum ola pipul langa dijan wel hu abumbat olkain trabul.
Pipul preisim yu, YAWEI dumaji yu gitwail langa eni nogudbalawei. Ol detlot hu nomo gitkil langa wofait garra kipgon preisimbat yu.
Gibit langa YAWEI, yu God wanim yubin pramisim im. Bringimap ola presen langa im, ol yumob pipul hu jidan langa ola gulijapwan kantri. YAWEI meigim ola pipul bradin en jidan garram rispek langa im brabliwei.
Im meigim ola praudbala bos jidan lobala. Im meigim ola strongwan king bradin brabliwei.

Mi brabli nogudbinji en mi wandim God blanga album mi. Mi jingat brabliwei langa im blanga irrim mi.
Wen ai abum trabul, ai jingat langa YAWEI. Olnait ai lidimap main bingga en prei, bat ai nomo fil gudbinji.
Wen mi jinggabat main God, mi wori, en mi fil brabli nogudbinji.
Ai kaan jadimap main ai dumaji yu na kipum mi weik. Mi brabli nogudbinji en ai kaan tok.
Mi jinggabat blanga wanim bin hepin bifo, en mi jinggabat blanga ola oldendeis.
Mi jinggabat ola song naitaim, en mi jinggabat en mi askim miselp.
“Maitbi det Bos garra oldei nokambek wi? Maitbi im kaan gudbinji langa wi igin?
Maitbi imbin stap laigimbat wi? Maitbi im garra stapam det pramis weya imbin meigim longtaim?
Maitbi imbin kipumbek det kainbala filing blanga im dumaji im wail langa wi?”
Afta na aibin tok miselp, “Dijan na meigim mi brabli nogudbinji. God bin abum detmatj pawa basdam, bat tudei na ai nomo luk im pawa.”
YAWEI, ai garra jinggabat blanga ola haibala ting yubin oldei dumbat. Ai garra jinggabat ol detlot ting yubin oldei dumbat garram yu strongbalawan pawa longtaim.
Ai garra jinggabat ebrijing yubin oldei dum. Ai garra jinggabat olataim blanga ebrijing yubin oldei dumbat garram yu strongbalawan pawa.
Det wei blanga yu main God im holiwan. Nomo eni drimin brabli haibalawan wulijim yu.
Yu na det God hu oldei dum olkain ting garram yu pawa. Yu na shoum yu pawa langa ola pipul langa ebri kantri.
Garram yu pawa yubin seibum ol yu pipul olabat, detlot bigininimob blanga Jeikob en Josef.
God, wen ola woda bin luk yu deibin ol bradin, en ebrijing weya jidan insaid langa det solwoda bin sheik nomo lilbit.
Ola klaud bin meigim rein buldan, en thanda bin meigim nois brom skai en laitining bin laitlaitbat brom ebri said.
Det nois blanga yu thanda bin jidan langa det wiliwili, en det lait brom yu laitining bin laitimap dijan wel. Dijan wel bin sheiksheik nomo lilbit.
Yubin wok rait thru det solwoda. Yubin krosim det dipwan solwoda. Bat nobodi bin luk yu trek.
God, yubin lidim yu pipul olabat jis laiga stakmen wen yubin pikimat Mosis en Eran blanga lidimbat yu pipul olabat.
Main pipul, yumob irrim main wed en teiknodis wen mi tok.
Ai garra tok ola gudbala wed blanga meigim pipul sabi brabliwei, en dalim olabat detlot sigridwan ting brom longtaim bifo,
ola ting na wibin sabi en irrimbat brom wi dedimob.
Wi garra dalimbat wi bigininimob en blanga olabat bigininimob blanga det pawa blanga YAWEI, en blanga ola haibala en ola gudwan ting imbin dum. Wi kaan blandim ol detlot stori brom olabat.
Imbin gibit ola lowa langa ola Isreil pipul hubin kaman brom olabat grengrenfatha Jeikob. Imbin dalim wi femili olabat hubin jidan longtaim blanga titjimbat olabat bigininimob blanga ol im lowa,
wulijim detlot bigininimob hu garra jidan bambai gin sabi, en olabat gin dalimbat olabat bigininimob du.
Wen dei lagijat dei garra trastimbat God du, en nomo fogedabat wanim imbin dum, en oldei teiknodis langa ol im lowa.
Olabat kaan jidan wulijim olabat grengrenfathamob hubin jidan brabli nogudbala en nomo garram irriwol. Olabat nomo bin trastim God strongbalawei, en dei nomo bin jidan trubalawei langa im.
Detlot pipul brom Ifreiyim bin abum bo en erro redibala, bat olabat bin ranawei wen det dei blanga det wofait bin kaman.
Olabat nomo bin kipum det strongwan pramis blanga olabat langa God. Dei nomo bin wandi teiknodis langa im lowa.
Deibin fogedabat wanim imbin dum, ol detlot klebabala ting weya deibin luk imbin dumbat.
God bin dum ol detlot klebabala ting garram im pawa langa det plein kantri gulum Sowan, langa det kantri Ijip. En detlot femili blanga olabat bifo bin lukinat imbin dumbat.
Imbin opinimap det solwoda en imbin deigim detlot pipul thru. Imbin meigim det solwoda jandap wulijim haiwan wol.
Deitaim imbin oldei lidim olabat garram klaud, en naitaim faiya bin oldei barnbarn blanga lidim olabat.
Imbin opinimap bigwan ston en imbin gibit olabat detmatj woda.
Imbin meigim woda kamat brom det ston, en imbin meigim det woda randan wulijim riba.
Bat deibin stil dumbat nogudbala ting langa God. Deya langa det deset kantri dei nomo bin wandi teiknodis langa det brabli haibala God.
Deibin testimat God brabliwei wen deibin dalimbat im wanim deibin wandim blanga dagat.
Deibin tokabat langa God en deibin tok, “Yu reken God gin gibit wi daga langa dijan deset kantri?
Trubala orait imbin hitim det ston en detmatj woda bin kamat, bat yu reken im gin gibit wi daga en gibit im pipulmob bif?”
Blanga tharran na YAWEI bin brabli wail wen imbin irrim olabat toktok lagijat. Imbin fait langa im pipul olabat garram faiya. Imbin barn binji langa olabat brabliwei, jis laiga hotwan faiya,
dumaji dei nomo bin trastim im, en dei nomo bin bilib im na garra seibum olabat.
Bat imbin tok langa det skai blanga opinap im en imbin opin.
Imbin gibit olabat sid daga brom hebin wen imbin gibit olabat det lilwan damba gulum mena blanga dagat.
Wal lagijat na deibin dagat det seimkain daga blanga ola einjul, en God bin gibit olabat ebrijing deibin wandim blanga dagat.
Imbin meigim det win blo brom sangidapwei, en garram im pawa imbin sterrimap det sauth win.
En imbin jandim langa im pipul olabat detmatj bard wulijim sengraun weya jidan langa solwoda.
Deibin buldanbat raidaran langa ola tent langa olabat kemp.
Wal detlot pipul bin dagadagatbat en deibin sedisfaid. God bin gibit olabat wanim deibin wandimbat.
Bat wen olabat bin stil dagadagatbat bard, en dei nomo bin brabli sedisfaid,
God bin gitwail langa olabat en kilim ded olabat strongwan men, ol detlot brabli gudwan yangmen blanga Isreil.
Nomeda ol detlot ting bin hepin, detlot pipul bin kipgon dumbat ola nogudbala ting. Nomeda imbin dum klebabala ting dei nomo bin stil trastim im.
Wal imbin binijimap olabat jis laik win weya stap streidawei, en olabat bin dai brom nogudwan ting.
Ebritaim wen God bin oldei kilim ded sambala pipul, det najalot bin oldei kambek langa im. Deibin oldei libum olabat olbalawei en prei brabliwei langa im.
Deibin sabi det boswan God na bin oldei maindimbat olabat, en imbin oldei albumbat en seibum olabat.
Bat ola wed deibin oldei tok bin laiyawan. Ebrijing weya deibin toktok nomo bin trubala.
Dei nomo bin gibit God rispek. Olabat nomo bin kipum olabat strongwan pramis langa im.
Bat God bin sori langa im pipul olabat. Imbin larramgo olabat fri brom olabat nogudbalawei en im nomo bin binijimap olabat. Lodataim God bin oldei holdimbek miselp en nomo gitwail langa olabat.
Imbin sabi deibin oni pipul weya garra dai, jis laik win weya kaman en binij kwikbala.
Lodataim deibin gibit im bekboun. Detmatj taim deibin oldei meigim im fil nogudbinji.
Oba en oba deibin oldei testimbat God, en deibin oldei ardimbat det filing blanga im na, det brabli holiwan God blanga Isreil.
Deibin fogedabat im strongwan pawa, en det dei wen imbin seibum olabat brom olabat enamimob,
en wen imbin shoum ola klebabala ting imbin dum langa Sowan deya langa det kantri Ijip.
Imbin tjeinjim ola riba woda en meigim blad, en detlot pipul langa Ijip nomo bin abum eni woda blanga dringgim na.
Imbin jandim loda flai langa olabat weya bin ardimbat olabat, en ola frog bin meigim olabat kantri nogudwan.
Imbin jandim ola bigwan grashopa blanga dagat olabat gadin, en binijimap ola daga weya bin gro langa olabat fam.
Imbin meigim dai ola greiptri blanga olabat garram ola heilston, en imbin meigim dai ola figtri blanga olabat garram brabli kolwanwetha.
Imbin kilim ded ola buligi blanga olabat garram heilston, en ola ship blanga olabat garram laitining.
Imbin meigim olabat abum detmatj wori wen imbin brabli wail nomo lilbit langa olabat, en imbin jandim detlot speshalwan einjul langa olabat blanga kilim olabat ded.
Im nomo bin holdimbek miselp wen imbin wail langa olabat en im nomo bin sori langa olabat du. Imbin kilim olabat holot garram nogudwan siknis.
Imbin kilim ded ola boi hubin bon fes blanga ola femili langa Ijip.
Brom deya imbin deigim im pipul olabat jis laiga stakmen en imbin deigim olabat thru det deset kantri.
Imbin lidim olabat seifwei en olabat nomo bin bradin, bat det solwoda bin gaburrumap olabat enamimob.
Imbin bringimap olabat langa im seikridwan kantri, en langa detlot bigwan hil weya imbin teikoba.
Imbin andimwei detlot pipul hubin oldei jidanabat langa det kantri wen im pipulmob bin go thru deya. Imbin kadimat olabat kantri en gibit miselpmiselp langa ola klen blanga Isreil, en imbin gibit ola kemp blanga olabat langa im pipul olabat.
Bat olabat nomo bin irrim langa det Boswan God en deibin testimbat im. Olabat nomo bin teiknodis langa ol im lowa.
Olabat bin gibit bekboun langa im en dei nomo bin jidan trubala langa im, laik olabat grengrenfatha bin dumbat longtaim bifo. Olabat bin nogud jis laik bendiwan spiya.
Olabat bin meigim im gitwail, dumaji deibin oldei weshipbat ola drimin sheip blanga olabat langa detlot nogudwan weship pleis. Deibin meigim im gitwail langa olabat nomo lilbit na.
God bin wail wen imbin luk wanim deibin dumbat, en blanga tharran na God bin tjakidawei olabat.
Imbin libum im kemp insaid langa det tent deya langa Shailo, det kemp na weya imbin oldei jidanbat garram pipul.
Imbin larram wi enamimob deigidawei det Seikridwan Boks. Det Boks bin shoum pipul im brabli haibalawan pawa.
Imbin wail garram im ronwan pipul, en imbin larram olabat gitkil brom olabat enamimob.
Ola yangbala men bin gitkil langa wofait, en ola yangbala gel nomo bin abum hasbin blanga merrit na.
Deibin kilim ded ola wekinmen blanga God langa fait, en olabat waif nomo bin lau blanga krai en jidan soriwei.
Bambai God bin gidap na, jis laik imbin weikap brom silip. Imbin jis laik strongwan men weya bin dringgim wain.
Imbin andimwei im enamimob brabliwei, en imbin bidim olabat en meigim olabat sheim miselp olagijawan.
God nomo bin wandim det femili olabat blanga Josef. Im nomo bin pikimat det klen blanga Ifreiyim.
Bat imbin pikimat det klen blanga Juda, en Saiyan, det hil weya im laigim nomo lilbit.
Deya na imbin bildimap im Serramoni Pleis jis laik im kemp langa hebin. Imbin meigim im brabli strongbalawan jis laik dijan wel igin. Im jidan brabli strongbalawan olataim.
Imbin pikimat im wekinmen Deibid. Imbin bringimap im brom detlot pedik weya imbin oldei wek,
en weya imbin oldei lukaftumbat ola ship. Imbin meigim im jidan king blanga ola Isreil pipul. Imbin det stakmen blanga ola pipul blanga God,
en imbin shoum olabat det raitwei blanga jidan.
Main God, ola nogud pipul bin teikoba yu kantri. Deibin dum nogud ting langa yu Serramoni Pleis, en deibin libum Jerusalem rabishwan.
Deibin libum ola ded bodi blanga yu pipul olabat blanga ola bard blanga dagadagatbat, en deibin libum ola bifpat blanga yu wekinmen olabat blanga ola wail enimul blanga dagadagatbat.
Deibin meigim yu pipul olabat lujim blad wulijim woda. Rait thru Jerusalem det blad bin randan laik woda, en nobodi nomo bin jidan laibala blanga gaburrumap detlot hubin dai.
Pipul langa najalot kantri hu nomo weship God toktok nogudwei blanga melabat. Olabat laflaf en mokimbat melabat.
YAWEI, haulong yu garra wail langa melabat? Haulong yu garra kipgon wail jis laik faiya im barnbarnbat?
God, yu garra gitwail langa detlot pipul brom najalot kantri hu nomo weship yu, en langa detlot pipul hu nomo prei langa yu.
Dumaji olabat na bin kilim ola pipul blanga yu, deibin meigim yu kantri nogudwan.
Nomo panishim melabat blanga ola nogudbala ting weya melabat femilimob bin oldei dumbat longtaim. Yu sori langa melabat na. Yu album melabat kwikbala.
Album melabat God. Seibum melabat en larramgo melabat fri brom ol melabat nogudbalawei wulijim ebribodi garra rispek yu brabliwei.
Wotfo detlot pipul brom najalot kantri askim melabat, “Weya yumob God?” Melabat wandim luk yu panishim detlot pipul hubin meigim yu wekinmenmob lujim blad.
God yu garra irrim detlot prisanamob kraikraibat, en detlot prisana hu garra dai, en yu garra meigim olabat fri garram yu strongbala pawa.
Detlot pipul weya deibin toktokbat nogudwei langa yu YAWEI, yu garra meigim olabat peiyimbek yu sebentaim.
En langa det taim na melabat garra gibitbat yu theingks olagijawan en preisimbat yu olataim. Melabat jidan yu pipulmob, en melabat jis laik yu ship olabat langa yu pedik.

God, yu stakmen blanga ola Isreil pipul. Yu irrim melabat. Yu na det boswan blanga yu ron pipul olabat. Yu jidan langa yu speshalwan tjeya deya langa midul langa det dubala golwan sheip garram wing.
Yu shoum miselp langa detlot klen blanga Ifreiyim, Benjamin, en Manesa. Shoum melabat yu pawa en kaman seibum melabat.
God, meigim melabat strongbala igin! Yu luk langa melabat garram yu shainiwan feis en seibum melabat.
YAWEI, Boswan God, haulong yu garra jidan wail en nomo ensim ola preya blanga yu pipul olabat?
Yubin meigim melabat jidan brabli nogudbinjiwan. En yubin meigim melabat dringgim melabat ronwan tiyas.
Yubin larram melabat enamimob fait blanga melabat kantri, En dei mokimbat melabat na.
Brabli Boswan God, meigim melabat strongbala igin! Yu luk langa melabat garram yu shainiwan feis en seibum melabat.
Yubin bringimat yu pipul olabat jis laiga greiptri brom det kantri Ijip. Yubin andimwei pipul brom najalot kantri en yubin plentim det tri langa olabat kantri.
Yubin klinimap pleis blanga det greiptri blanga growap. Det rutpat bin godan raitdan en det greiptri bin spredimat miselp oloba langa det kantri.
Imbin gaburrumap ola hil garram im bigwan sheid. Detlot wadi blanga det tri bin gro en gaburrumap detlot bigwan sidatri.
Detlot wadi blanga det tri bin kamat langa det Medatareiniyan solwoda en langa det Yufreitis Riba.
God, wotfo yubin larram detlot enami blanga ola Isreil pipul breigimdan det wol weya bin jidan raidaran? Olabat garra stilim ola greip daga na wen dei gopas.
Olabat jis laik detlot wailwan bigibigi weya rudimat det greiptri, en jis laik ola wailwan enimul dagadagatbat ola greip daga du.
Brabli Boswan God, luk langa melabat! Yu lukdan langa melabat brom hebin. Kaman en seibum yu pipul.
Yu kaman en seibum dijan greiptri weya yubin plentim, dijan na det yangwan greiptri weya yubin meigim gro brabli strongbala.
Melabat enamimob bin kadimdan det tri en barnimap garram faiya. Yu wail langa olabat en binijimap olabat.
Yu lukaftum yu pipul olabat weya yubin pikimat, ol detlot pipul na weya yubin meigim jidan brabli strongbala.
En melabat kaan gowei brom yu igin. Meigim melabat strongbala igin en melabat garra weship en preisim yu.
YAWEI, boswan God, yu meigim melabat strongbala igin. Yu luk langa melabat garram yu shainiwan feis en seibum melabat.

Sing langa God gudbinjiwei! Im na oldei maindimbat wi. Preisim wi God, det God blanga wi grengrenfatha Jeikob.
Stadimap det myusik. Plei det lilwan dram. Plei gudwan myusik garram olkain gita.
Blowim detlot hon blanga abum det dubala serramoni blanga nyumanth en wen im fulmun.
Dijan na det lowa blanga Isreil, en imbin kaman brom det God blanga Jeikob.
Imbin gibit det lowa langa detlot Isreil pipul wen imbin deigimwei olabat brom Ijip. Aibin irrim sambodi tok bat ai nomo bin sabi hu. Imbin tok,
“Aibin deigimwei ola hebiwan loud brom yumob bekboun, ol detlot brabli adwek langa Ijip.
Wen yumob bin abumbat trabul, yumob bin jingat langa mi en aibin seibum yumob. Aibin ensim yumob brom main haiding pleis deya langa det stom klaud. Aibin testimbat yumob deya langa det springwoda langa Meriba.
Main pipul olabat, lisin langa main woning! Isreil, yumob nomo sabi haumatj ai wandim yumob blanga lisin langa mi.
Yumob nomo lau weship eni drimin.
Mi na YAWEI det trubala God blanga yumob hubin bringimat yumob brom Ijip. If yumob jidan trubala langa mi, ai garra gibit yumob ola gudbala ting, jis laik det mamiwan bard weya im gibit daga langa im beibi.
“Bat main pipul olabat nomo bin lisin langa mi. Ola Isreil pipul nomo bin wandi teiknodis langa mi.
Aibin lafta larram olabat dum wanim deibin wandim dum dumaji olabat nomo bin wandim lisin langa mi.
Brabliwei ai wandim main pipul olabat blanga lisin langa mi. If dei bina duwit langa mi,
ai bina bidim olabat enami kwikbalawei. Ai bina bidim olabat garram main pawa.
Detlot hu nomo laigim mi garra nildan bradinwei langa mi, en ai garra panishim olabat olagija.
Bat if yumob teiknodis langa mi ai garra meigim yumob brabli bulap binji garram ola brabli gudwan sid daga en brabli switwan shugabeig.”
God im det bos blanga det kothaus langa hebin. Im dalim ola drimin blanga dum wanim im wandim olabat blanga dum.
Im tok, “Haulong yumob garra kipgon jadjimbat ebribodi rongwei? Haulong yumob garra kipgon bekimap detlot nogudbala pipul?
Yumob bina album ola powan pipul en ola biginini hu nomo garram mami en dedi, bat najing! Yumob bina gibit feyago langa detlot pipul hu nomo garram enijing, en langa detlot pipul hu nomo garram enibodi blanga albumbat olabat, bat najing!
Yumob bina seibum olabat brom det pawa blanga ol detlot nogudwan pipul, bat najing!
“Yumob nomo sabi enijing. Yumob brabli nogud en nomo eni lowa jidan langa dijan wel.
‘Yumob ola drimin! Yumob holot jidan bigininimob blanga det Brabli Haibala God.’
Bat yumob garra binijap wulijim ola pipul, en yumob laif garra binijap wulijim det san blanga eni bos.”
God, yu kaman en jidan bos blanga dijan wel, dumaji ola pipul hu jidan oloba langa dijan wel, olabat holot blanga yu.

Kaman God! Yu album melabat. Nomo jidan kwaitbala.
Yu luk detlot hu nomo laigim yu! Yu enami olabat gidap redi blanga fait.
Olabat meigimbat ola sigridwan plen blanga yu pipul. Olabat toktokbat blanga dum nogud ting langa yu pipul hu yu laigim brabliwei en yu oldei lukaftumbat.
Olabat tok, “Kaman. Wi garra binijimap olabat wulijim nobodi kaan jinggabat detlot Isreil pipul enimo.”
Olabat ol agri gija blanga olabat plen, en blanga fait langa yu.
Dislot pipul brom ol dislot traib na bin meigim dijan plen. Ola pipul brom Idam, en ola Ishmeil pipul, en ola pipul brom Moweb en ol detlot Heigrait pipul,
en ol detlot pipul brom det kantri Gebal, en ola Eman pipul en ola Amalek pipul, en ol detlot pipul brom Filistiya en brom Taya.
Detlot pipul brom det kantri Asiriya bin joinap garram olabat du. Olabat bin jidan brabli gud fren blanga album ol detlot Eman pipul, en ol detlot Moweb pipul hubin brom det femili lain blanga det men neim Lot.
God, yu panishim olabat seimwei jis laik yubin dum langa ola Midiyan pipul. Yu binijimap olabat jis laik yubin binijimap Sisera en im king Jeibin, deya langa det Kishan Riba,
gulijap langa det taun gulum Endowa. Deya na yubin bidim olabat en olabat bodi bin jidan nogudwan langa graun.
Yu bidim ola boswan blanga olabat jis laik yubin dum langa Oreb en Sib en langa Seba en Seilmuna.
Olabat na bin tok, “Nomeda det kantri blanga God, melabat garra teikoba en meigim im blanga melabat ronwan kantri na.”
God, yu spredimat olabat jis laiga das, en jis laiga draiwan gras weya det win oldei blowimweibat.
Jis laik faiya wen im barnimap ola tri, en jis laik lilwan faiya wen im stadimap bigwan faiya langa ola hil,
wal yu andimwei olabat garram yu strongwan win, en yu meigim olabat bradin garram yu jigiwan win en laitining.
YAWEI, yu meigim olabat jidan sheimwan, en yu meigim olabat sabi det pawa blanga yu.
Nomo larram olabat win en meigim olabat jidan brabli bradinwan olagijawan. Larram olabat sheim brabliwei en dai.
YAWEI, meigim olabat sabi oni yu na wanbala det trubala God, en oni yu na jidan det brabli haibala boswan blanga dijan wel.

YAWEI, Boswan God, ai laigim yu Serramoni Pleis brabliwei.
Mi wandim jidan langa det Serramoni Pleis blanga YAWEI brabliwei! Garram ol main laif mi sing gudbinjiwei langa det laibalawan God.
YAWEI, Boswan God, yu na main bos en main God. Ola lilwan bard meigim olabat kemp deya langa yu haus, en olabat growimap olabat beibi gulijap langa ol yu teibul blanga ofring.
Ol detlot pipul hu jidan langa yu seikridwan haus oldei jidan gudbinjiwei, en singsing en preisimbat yu.
Ol detlot pipul hu trastimbat yu blanga meigim olabat strongbala oldei jidan gudbinjiwei. Olabat kaan weit blanga go langa Saiyan blanga weship yu.
Wen dei go thru langa det draiwan kantri gulum Baka Beli, yu jandim rein en bilimap ola wodahol, en meigim det kantri jidan jis laik springwoda kantri.
Yu pipul olabat gro brabli strongbala en dei garra kamat langa det Brabli Boswan God deya langa Saiyan.
YAWEI, Boswan God, det God blanga Jeikob, yu irrim main preya.
God, yu na bin pikimat melabat king. Jidan kainbala langa im dumaji im oldei lukaftumbat melabat jis laiga shild kipum wi seif.
Im mobeda blanga jidan langa yu Serramoni Pleis oni wanbala dei den blanga jidan langa najawan pleis wan thausan dei. Blanga mi, im mowa gudwan blanga jandap en maindimbat det dowa blanga main God haus, den blanga jidan garram ola brabli nogudbala pipul.
YAWEI, det trubala God oldei maindimbat wi en im wi bos. Im brabli kainbala langa wi en im rispek wi. Langa ol detlot pipul hu dumbat rait ting, im nomo nokambek eni gudwan ting.
YAWEI, Boswan God, ol detlot hu trastimbat yu jidan gudbalawei.

YAWEI, yubin oldei shoum yu kainbala filing langa yu pipul langa Isreil. Yubin gibit olabat ebrijing igin.
Yu nomo bin peiyimbek yu pipul olabat blanga olabat nogudbalawei, en yubin meigim olabat fri.
Yubin stap gitwailbat langa olabat en yubin holdimbek yuselp.
God, yu seibum melabat na, en yu bringimbek melabat langa melabat kantri. Nomo jidan nogudbinji garram melabat.
God wanim yu garra dum? Yu garra jidan nogudbinji langa melabat olagijawan? Yu garra jidan nogudbinji en wail langa melabat en melabat bigininimob hu garra jidan bambai du?
Yu meigim melabat strongbala igin wulijim melabat yu pipul olabat garra preisimbat yu gudbinjiwei.
YAWEI yu seibum melabat, en shoum melabat yu laigim melabat olataim.
Lisin langa wanim YAWEI det trubala God im toktok langa wi. Wi jidan im ronwan pipul olabat. Im pramisim wi blanga jidan gudbinjiwei if wi nomo gobek langa wi nogudbalawei.
Trubala, im oldei redi blanga seibum ol detlot hu oldei shoum rispek langa im, en im garra oldei jidan iya langa wi kantri du.
YAWEI yu na laigim yu pipul olabat brabliwei, en yu na oldei jidan trubala langa olabat olataim. Yu na oldei dum ebrijing raitwei blanga olabat, en yu na oldei meigim ebrijing gudwan blanga olabat.
Wen pipul jidan trubala langa God tharran na garra gowap langa im, en det raitwei blanga God garra kamdan en jidan langa olabat.
Trubala, YAWEI garra gibit ola gudwan ebrijing, en wi kantri garra abum detmatj daga.
Det trubalawei blanga YAWEI garra go lida langa im, en meigim det wei redibala blanga im.
YAWEI, lisin langa mi en ensim mi, dumaji ai kaan dum enijing en mi wikwan.
Nomo larram mi dai, dumaji mi jidan trubala langa yu. Seibum mi dumaji mi blanga yu wekinmen, en mi trastim yu.
Yu na main bos, wal yu kain langa mi, dumaji mi oldei jingat langa yu olataim.
Main bos, meigim mi jidan gudbinji dumaji mi blanga yu wekinmen. Mi oldei jingat langa yu.
Bos, yu oldei gud langa melabat en oldei larramgo melabat fri. En langa ol detlot hu oldei jingat langa yu, yu laigim olabat olagijawan.
YAWEI, yu lisin langa main preya. Yu lisin langa mi wen mi jingat langa yu blanga album mi.
Wen trabul kaman ai jingat langa yu, dumaji yu oldei ensim mi.
Main Bos, det najalot drimin nomo jidan wulijim yu. Detlot drimin kaan dum wanim yu gin dum.
Ola pipul langa ebri kantri weya yubin meigim garra kaman en nildan langa yu, en olabat garra preisim yu dumaji yu brabli haibalawan.
Yu na brabli strongbalawan en haibalawan, en yu dum ola brabli gudwan ting. Yu na wanbala, yu jidan God.
YAWEI, yu meigim mi sabi wanim yu wandim mi blanga dum, en ai gin wok langa det trubalawei. Album mi blanga wek blanga yu garram brabli trubalawan hat.
God, main bos, ai garra preisim yu brabliwei garram ebrijing insaid langa mi, en ai garra kipgon dalimbat ebribodi blanga yu haibala pawa.
Blanga yu filing blanga laigimbat mi im detmatj, im kipgon olagijawan. Aibin gulijap binij bat yubin seibum mi.
Main God, detlot praudbala pipul geingap langa mi blanga trai kilim mi ded, detlot pipul na weya dei nomo oldei jinggabat langa yu.
Bat yu na main God. Yu jidan garram kainbalawan en soriwan filing, en yu laigimbat pipul olataim. Yu nomo gitwail kwikbalawei, najing. Yu oldei jidan kainbala en yu truwan.
Luk langa mi en sori langa mi. Meigim mi strongbala en seibum mi dumaji mi wek blanga yu laik main mami bin wekwekbat blanga yu.
YAWEI, shoum mi yu gudbalawan langa mi, en detlot hu nomo laigim mi garra jidan sheimwei na, wen dei garra luk yubin album mi en meigim mi gudbinji.
YAWEI bin meigim det taun deya ontop langa det seikridwan hil.
Im laigim Jerusalem brabliwei, mowa den eni pleis langa Isreil.
Pipul blanga det taun blanga God, irrimbat ola gudwan ting weya God im tok blanga yu.
God bin tok, “Ai garra raidimdan ola neim blanga dislot kantri weya pipul teiknodis langa mi. Olabat brom Ijip en Bebalon, Filistiya, Taya en Ithiyopiya en olabat tok deibin bon langa Jerusalem.”
God, det Brabli Boswan, garra meigim Jerusalem jidan strongbala, en ola pipul ebriweya garra tok, “Melabat bin bon deya du.”
YAWEI garra raidimdan neim blanga ola pipul, en im garra tok blanga olabat, “Dijan bin bon iya langa Jerusalem.”
Dei garra dens en sing, “Ola gudbala ting kaman brom Jerusalem.”

YAWEI yu na det trubalawan God en yu seibum mi. Mi oldei jinginatbat langa yu deitaim en naitaim.
Yu irrim mi. Mi jinginatbat langa yu blanga album mi.
Aibin abum loda trabul en mi gulijap binij.
Mi jis laik detlot pipul hubin olredi dai. Ai nomo fil strongbala na.
Olabat bin libum mi miselp, jis laik aibin gitkil en leidanbat langa greib garram ola dedbala pipul. Im jis laik yu God, bin fogedabat mi en kaan dum enijing blanga album mi.
Yubin tjakamdan mi langa det dipwan en dakwan greibyad.
Yubin brabli wail langa mi en im jis laik yubin tjakam mi langa solwoda en detlot weib tjakambat mi oloba.
Yubin meigim main frenmob tenawei en bradin brom mi en deibin libum mi miselp. Mi trep na en ai kaan ranawei.
Main ai dubala wikwan brom kraikraibat. YAWEI, ebridei mi jingat langa yu. Wen mi prei langa yu mi oldei lidimap main bingga langa yu.
YAWEI, ai jinggabat detlot dedbala pipul. Olabat gin luk ola klebabala ting yu dumbat? Najing. Olabat gin jandap en preisim yu? Najing.
Olabat gin tok blanga det filing blanga laigim pipul olataim en blanga yu trubalawei? Najing.
Olabat gin luk blanga yu klebabalawei deya langa det dakbala pleis? Najing. Olabat gin sabi blanga yu gudbalawei deya langa det pleis weya yu nomo jinggabat olabat enimo? Najing.
Bat YAWEI, mi jingat langa yu blanga album mi. Ebri moning mi prei langa yu.
YAWEI, wotfo yu nokambek mi? Wotfo yu gibit mi bekboun?
Brom wen aibin yang aibin ardimbat en aibin gulijap binij. Mi brabli wik na dumaji yubin dum detmatj nogudbala ting langa mi.
Dumaji yu barn binji im jis laik fladwoda gaburrumap mi. Yubin gulijap binijimap mi.
Ebridei ol detlot nogudbala ting brom yu kaman langa mi brom ebri said jis laik fladwoda, en olabat jidan raidaran langa mi.
Yubin meigim main gudfren olabat libum mi, en det dakbala pleis na main fren.

YAWEI, ai garra oldei sing blanga det filing weya yu oldei laigimbat olagijawan. Ai garra oldei dalimbat blanga hau yu jidan trubalawei langa yu pipul olagijawan.
Ai garra dalimbat blanga det filing blanga yu blanga laigimbat garra jidan olagijawan, en yu trubalawei jidan olagijawan wulijim det skai weya jidan olagijawan.
Yubin tok, “Aibin meigim strongwan pramis garram det men aibin pikimat. Aibin pramisim main wekinmen Deibid dijan.
‘Brom yu femili lain na king garra oldei jidan. Ai garra meigim yu femili jidan lagijat olagijawan.’”
Ebribodi langa hebin sing blanga ola gudwan ting yu oldei dumbat. Olabat sing blanga det trubalawei blanga yu.
YAWEI, nobodi langa hebin jidan laik yu. Nobodi deya jidan seimwei laik yu.
Olabat bradin langa yu brabliwei, en olabat rispek yu brabliwei du.
YAWEI, Boswan God, nobodi jidan garram pawa laik yu. YAWEI, brabli trubalawei yu dum ebrijing.
Yu jidan bos blanga detlot strongwan weib langa solwoda. Yu meigim olabat jidan kwaitbala.
Yubin kilim ded det bigwan solwoda enimul gulum Reiheb. Garram yu strongbalawan pawa yubin bidim yu enami olabat.
Hebin im blanga yu, en dijan wel du. Yubin meigim dijan wel en ebrijing weya jidan langa im.
Yubin meigim nowath en sauth. Teibowa en Heman, det dubala bigwan hil sing langa yu gudbinjiwei.
Yu na det brabli strongbalawan. Yu pawa im jidan nomo lilwan. Im brabli strongbala.
God, yu jidan brabli haibalawan bos, en pipul sabi yu jidan bos raitwei en yu oldei gibit feyago. Olabat sabi yu filing blanga laigim olabat en det trubalawei blanga yu.
YAWEI, detlot pipul hu oldei weship yu garram ola song, en hu oldei wokwok langa yu lait, olabat na jidan brabli gudbinjiwei.
Dumaji blanga yu na, olabat oldei sing en toktokbat, en olabat preisim yu blanga det raitwei blanga yu.
Garram yu pawa yu meigim melabat strongbala blanga win brabliwei. En blanga yu filing im laigimbat melabat olataim en meigim melabat gudbinji.
YAWEI, yu na bin pikimat det king blanga lukaftumbat melabat jis laiga shild. Yu na, det brabli Holiwan God blanga Isreil bin gibit melabat ronwan king.
YAWEI, longtaim langa drim yubin tok langa ol yu trubalawan wekinmen, “Aibin meigim dijan solja jidan strongbala garram big neim. Aibin pikimat dijan yangmen brom ola pipul blanga jidan haiwan king.
Aibin meigim main wekinmen Deibid jidan king wen aibin spilim det seikridwan oil langa im hed.
Ai garra oldei album im, en main pawa garra oldei meigim im strongbala.
Im enami olabat kaan neba win en jidan bos langa im. Ola brabli nogudwan pipul kaan bidim im.
Ai garra binijimap im enami olabat, en kilim ded ol detlot hu nomo laigim im.
Ai garra laigim im en jidan trubala langa im. En mowa igin, ai garra oldei meigim im win.
Ai garra meigim im kantri bigwan, brom det Medatareiniyan solwoda raidap langa det Yufreitis Riba.
Deibid garra tok langa mi, ‘Yu main dedi en main God. Yu na oldei maindimbat en seibumbat mi jis laiga bigwan ston.’
Ai garra meigim im main feswan san, en det brabli nambawan king brom ol detlot najalot king.
Ai garra oldei kipum main pramis langa im, en main strongwan pramis garra jidan olagijawan garram im.
Im femili neim garra jidan olagijawan wulijim det skai. Brom im femili lain, king garra oldei jidan.
“Bat if olabat nomo teiknodis en bulurrum ol detlot lowa blanga main,
en if olabat nomo dum wanim ai dalim olabat,
wal ai garra panishim olabat blanga olabat nogudbalawei. Ai garra meigim olabat ardimbat blanga olabat nogudbalawei.
Bat ai kaan stap laigimbat Deibid, en ai garra kipum main pramis langa im olagijawan.
Ai kaan breigim main strongwan pramis langa im, o deigimbek eni pramis aibin meigim langa im.
“Trubala dijan na det pramis aibin meigim garram main ronwan seikridwan neim. Ai kaan dalim laiya langa Deibid.
Im femili lain garra kipgon olagijawan. En ai garra oldei maindimbat det kantri weya im jidan bos wulijim det san weya im oldei shain olataim.
Im garra jidan olagija jis laik det mun, weya im jidan trubalawan witnis blanga mi langa skai.”
Bat YAWEI, yubin gitwail langa det king weya yubin pikimat. Yubin libum im miselp en yu nomo wandi sabi im enimo.
Yubin breigim yu strongwan pramis garram yu wekinmen, en yubin tjakamdan im speshalwan het langa graun.
Yubin breigimap ola wol blanga im taun, en yubin libum ol im strongwan haus breikinwan.
Enibodi hubin wokpas langa det pleis bin stilim ebrijing blanga im. En ola pipul langa ola gulijapwan kantri bin mokimbat im.
Yubin meigim im enami olabat bidimbat im, en yubin meigim olabat holot gudbinji nomo lilbit.
Yubin meigim nogud ola wepan blanga det king, en im nomo bin win wen imbin fait.
Yubin deigidawei im speshalwan stik weya im oldei holdim, en yubin nokamdan im speshalwan tjeya langa graun.
Yubin meigim im olmen na, bat im oni yangbala, en yubin meigim im jidan garram sheim.
YAWEI, haulong yu garra haidim miselp? Haulong yu garra barn binji wulijim faiya weya barn?
Yu jinggabat na. Main laif kaan jidan longtaim. Yubin meigim pipul blanga dai.
Nobodi kaan jidan laibala en neba dai. Nobodi kaan stapam miselp brom daidaibat.
YAWEI, weya det filing yubin abum bifo blanga laigimbat pipul olagijawan? Weya ola pramis yubin meigim langa Deibid?
YAWEI, yu sabi hau ol detlot hu nomo weship yu oldei mokimbat en meigimbat fan langa mi, yu wekinmen.
YAWEI, yu enami olabat tok nogudwei langa yu king weya yubin pikimat. Ebriweya im go dei tok nogudwei blanga im.
Preisim YAWEI det trubala God olagijawan. Yuwai! Trubala!
YAWEI, brom longtaim yubin oldei jidan laiga seifwan pleis blanga melabat.
Bifo yubin meigim ola hil en meigim dijan wel kamat, yu na bin oldei jidan det olagijawan God, en yu garra jidan God olagija.
Wen yu tok, pipul dai en olabat bodi garra gobek langa graun.
Det 1,000 yiya im laik wanbala dei langa yu. Olabat jis laik yestadei weya im gon olredi, en jis laik lilbit taim naitaim.
Yu deigidawei melabat jis laik fladwoda. Melabat jidan nomo longtaim, laik drim wen im binij. Melabat jidan laiga purdiwan flawa wen im kamat moningtaim,
en im binij sangodantaim.
Wen yu gitwail, yu binijimap melabat. Melabat brabli bradin langa yu wen yu gitwail nomo lilbit.
Yu pudum ola nogudbalawei blanga melabat lida langa yu, en ola nogudbala ting weya melabat bin dum sigridwei yu gin luk.
Jis laik wen sambodi opinim en jadimap ai kwikbala, en lagijat du melabat laif binij kwikbala wen yu gitwail.
Melabat laif maitbi jidan oni 70 yiya o maitbi 80 yiya if wi jidan strongbala, bat stil melabat abum loda trabul en soriwan filing langa ol detlot yiya. Detlot yiya binij kwikbala en wi binijap en wi gon.
Nobodi sabi det brabliwan pawa wen yu gitwail langa det nogudbalawei blanga pipul. Blanga tharran na melabat garra bradin en rispek yu olataim.
Yu lenim melabat hau det laif blanga melabat im shotwan, wulijim melabat garra jinggabat brabli gudwei.
Haulong mowa yu garra jidan wail lagijat? YAWEI, yu sori langa yu wekinmen olabat.
Bilimap melabat ebri moning garram det filing blanga yu blanga laigim yu, wulijim melabat garra sing en jidan gudbinji langa melabat laif olataim.
YAWEI, yu gibit melabat detmatj filing blanga jidan gudbinjiwei na blanga ola yiya weya melabat bin jidan nogudbinjiwei.
Yu larram melabat yu wekinmen olabat, luk ola brabli haibala ting yu dum. Yu larram melabat biginini olabat hu garra jidan bambai luk yu brabli haibalawan pawa.
YAWEI, melabat God, larram yu kainbala filing jidan garram melabat. Yu meigim ebrijing melabat wandi dum hepin gudbalawei.
Wen pipul go langa YAWEI det Boswan God blanga jidan seifwan, wal im jis laik olabat jidan andanith langa gudwan sheidiwan tri.
Dei garra tok langa YAWEI det trubala God, “Mi seif wen mi go langa yu. Yu na brabli strongwan en yu lukaftum mi. Yu na main God, en ai trastim yu.”
Wen yu enami olabat trai trepam yu, YAWEI na garra seibum yu. Wen yu jidan brabli wikwan o sikwan en gulijap dai, YAWEI na garra kipum yu seifwan.
God garra lukaftum yu wen detlot trabul kaman langa yu, jis laiga bard lukaftumbat ol im beibi. Wen dei bradin dei blandim miselp andanith langa im wing en dei jidan seif. Wal God oldei dum wanim im pramisim, en im garra kipum yu seif en blokim detlot trabul du.
Yu kaan bradin blanga olkain nogud ting weya hepin naitaim. If sambodi wandi ardim yu deitaim wal yu kaan bradin.
If yu brabli sik midulnait, o if yu gulijap gitkil dinataim, yu kaan bradin.
Nomeda loda pipul wansaid langa yu mait dai, en bigmob pipul mait binij raidaran langa yu, bat nomo enijing kaan ardim yu.
Yu garra oni luk det trabul, en yu garra wotjim God panishim brabliwei detlot nogudbala pipul.
If yu go langa YAWEI blanga jidan seif, en if yu jidan garram det Brabli Haibalawan,
wal nobodi kaan ardim yu. Nomo eni nogud ting kaan kaman langa yu kemp,
dumaji im garra jandim im einjul olabat langa yu, en im garra dalim olabat blanga wotjimbat yu ebriweya yu go.
Detlot einjul garra lidimap yu ontop garram olabat bingga wulijim yu kaan ardim miselp. Yu kaan ardim lilbit langa yu fut o eniweya langa yu bodi.
Nomeda yu pudumbut yangwan laiyan o jigiwan sneik, detlot einjul na garra seibum yu brom ol detlot jigiwan ting.
YAWEI tok, “Detlot pipul hu laigim mi, ai garra seibum olabat. Ai garra wotjim detlot hu sabi mi.
Wen dei jingat langa mi, ai garra ensim olabat. Ai garra jidan garram olabat wen dei abum trabul. Ai garra seibum olabat, en ai garra lidimap olabat haibala.
Ai garra meigim olabat jidan laibala longtaim. Dei garra luk hau mi seibum main pipul.”

YAWEI, im brabli gudwan blanga gibit theingks langa yu, en sing song blanga preisim yu, brabli haibala God.
Im brabli gudwan blanga sing ebri moning blanga yu filing blanga laigim pipul olataim, en ebri naitaim blanga yu trubalawei,
garram myusik brom olkain gita.
YAWEI, ola ting weya yu dum garram yu pawa meigim mi gudbinji. Ai sing song gudbinjiwei, blanga wanim yubin dum.
Trubala, im nomo lilwan ting weya yu dum, YAWEI. Detlot ting weya yu jinggabat, olabat brabli adwan blanga pipul blanga sabi.
Siliwan pipul kaan sabi blanga dijan na.
Wulijim bindiyai weya im gro isibalawei en spredat ebriweya, lagijat du nogudbala pipul nomo abum eni trabul en gajimbat detmatj ebrijing isibalawei tudei, bat bambai yu na YAWEI garra binijimap olabat olagijawan,
dumaji yu na YAWEI, jidan bos brabli olagijawan.
Wi sabi blanga yu enami olabat garra binij, en ola nogudbala pipul kaan win.
YAWEI, yubin meigim mi strongbala jis laik wailwan bul jidan strongbala. En dumaji yubin gud langa mi, mi jidan gudbinji.
Aibin luk yubin bidim main enami olabat, en aibin irrim olabat jingat.
Detlot pipul hu jidan raitwei garra jidan gudbalawei jis laik detlot tri weya oldei abum detmatj daga, en jis laik detlot sidatri weya oldei jidan strongbala.
Jis laik ola tri weya gro langa det Serramoni Pleis blanga YAWEI,
en weya oldei kipgon abumbat detmatj daga raidap olabat brabli olwan, wal lagijat du detlot pipul garra oldei kipgon jidan raitwei, en dei garra oldei tok dijan blanga YAWEI,
“YAWEI im brabli trubalawan en im nomo garram enijing rong langa im, en im oldei maindimbat mi, jis laiga bigwan ston weya kipum mi seifwan.”
YAWEI det trubala God im Boswan. Im jidan brabli haibalawan en brabli strongwan. Dijan wel im jidan langa im rait pleis en nomo enijing kaan mubum im.
YAWEI, yubin oldei jidan boswan bifo enijing bin jidan.
YAWEI, det solwoda jinginat adbalawei jis laik thanda. Im jinginat nomo lilbit.
YAWEI, im jidan langa hebin en im na det Brabli Haibalawan Bos blanga ebrijing. Im mowa strongbala langa det solwoda weya im jingat, en im mowa strongbala langa ola bigwan weib langa solwoda.
YAWEI, ola lowa blanga yu jidan olagijawan, en yu Serramoni Pleis im jidan brabli seikridwan olagijawan.
YAWEI, yu det God hu oldei panishim ol detlot jigiwan bos. Yu gitwail en panishim olabat na.
Yu na oldei jadjimbat melabat holot. Yu gidap en panishim detlot praudbala pipul.
Haulong detlot nogudbala pipul garra jidanabat gudbinjiwei? Haulong mowa YAWEI?
Haulong detlot pipul hu dumbat nogudbala ting garra kipgon laigimbat miselp en jidanbat praudbalawei wen dei dumbat detlot nogudbala ting?
Dei jidan jigiwan bos en meigim yu pipul olabat adwek brabliwei, YAWEI. Dei ardimbat yu pipul olabat.
Dei kilim ded ola widogel en detlot biginini hu nomo garram mami en dedi. En dei medrim pipul hubin kaman brom najawan kantri blanga jidan langa wi kantri.
En dei tok, “YAWEI nomo luk wi. Det God blanga Isreil nomo sabi wanim wi dumbat.”
Main pipul olabat, yumob brabli siliwan pipul. Wotaim yumob garra len?
