God bin meigim wi irriwol, bat yumob reken God kaan irrim yumob! Imbin meigim wi ai, bat yumob reken im kaan luk langa yumob!
Im graulim ola pipul langa najalot kantri, bat yumob reken im kaan panishim ola wikitwan bos blanga wi! Im na titja blanga wi holot, bat yumob reken im nomo sabi enijing!
YAWEI sabi wanim detlot pipul jinggabat, en im sabi detlot ting nomo garram eni pawa.
YAWEI, ol detlot pipul hu irrim yu en weya yubin titjimbat olabat ol yu lowa garra jidan gudbinjiwei.
Yu larram ol detlot hu irrim yu abum spel brom ola trabul raidap det taim weya yu redi blanga binijimap detlot nogudbala pipul.
YAWEI kaan neba gibit bekboun langa im pipul olabat. Im kaan neba libum ol im pipul olabat.
Langa ola kothaus ebribodi garra abum feyago igin, en ola pipul hu dumbat ola rait ting garra bekimap tharran.
Hubin jandap blanga mi langa ola nogudbala pipul? Hubin bekimap mi brom ola brabli wikitwan pipul?
If YAWEI nomo bin album mi, ai bina godan langa det pleis weya ola dedbala pipul oldei go.
Aibin tok, “Mi buldan”, bat det filing blanga yu weya yu laigimbat pipul olataim bin lidimap mi.
Wen mi hatjamp en wori, yu lidimap mi en meigim mi gudbinji.
Yu nomo laigim ola nogudbala jadj hu oldei gibit adtaim langa pipul. Dei nomo jadjim pipul raitwei garram ol yu lowa.
Dei meigim plen blanga ardimbat ola gudbala pipul, en kilimbat ded ola pipul hu nomo bin dum enijing rong.
Bat YAWEI maindimbat mi, jis laiga seifwan haus. Main God lukaftumbat mi jis laik wen mi blandim miselp langa bigwan ston.
Im garra panishim olabat blanga ola brabli nogudbala ting deibin dumbat en im garra binijimap olabat brabliwei. YAWEI det trubala God blanga wi garra binijimap olabat.
Kaman yumob! Wi garra preisim YAWEI det trubala God. Wi garra sing gudbinjiwei langa God hu oldei seibum wi en maindimbat wi jis laiga bigwan ston kipum wi seifwan.
Wi garra kaman langa im en tok theingkyu, en preisim im garram ola hepiwan song.
YAWEI im det brabli haibalawan God. Im haibala bos langa ola najalot drimin.
Im jidan bos blanga dijan wel. Im bos blanga ebrijing brom ola dipwan keib raidap langa ola haiwan hil.
Im bos blanga solwoda en dijan graun weya imbin meigim imselp.
Kaman yumob! Wi garra nildan langa im en weship im. Wi garra nildan langa YAWEI det trubalawan God hubin meigim wi.
Im na wi God, en wi na detlot pipul im oldei lukaftumbat, en wi jis laik ola ship blanga im weya im oldei gibit ebrijing. Irrim tudei wanim YAWEI tok,
“Nomo jadimap miselp hat wulijim yumob femili olabat bin dum bifo langa det kantri Meriba, en det taim langa Mesa det deset kantri.
Deya na deibin oldei grambulbat en aibin gitwail langa olabat. Dei nomo bin jinggabat wanim aibin oldei dumbat blanga olabat.
Blanga 40 yiya ai nomo bin gudbinji langa detlot pipul. Aibin tok, ‘Olabat nomo garram eni rispek blanga mi. Olabat nomo teiknodis langa ol main lowa.’
Aibin gitwail en aibin meigim dijan strongwan pramis langa olabat, ‘Aibin wandi gibit yumob det kantri blanga jidan gudbinjiwei, bat najing. Yumob kaan go deya na.’”
Sing nyuwan song langa YAWEI det trubala God. Ola pipul langa dijan wel sing song langa YAWEI.
Sing langa YAWEI en preisim im. Dalimbat det gudnyus ebridei weya imbin seibum wi.
Dalimbat pipul langa ebri kantri im brabli haibalawan, en dalimbat olabat blanga ola haibala ting imbin dumbat.
YAWEI det trubala God im haibalawan en pipul garra preisim im. Pipul garra abum loda rispek blanga im, mowa den langa ola najalot drimin.
Detlot drimin blanga najalot kantri olabat laiyawan, weya pipul bin meigimbat, bat YAWEI det trubala God bin meigim ebrijing langa skai.
Im brabli haibala pawa gaburrumap im raidaran. Im brabli shainiwan lait en pawa jidan langa im Serramoni Pleis.
Ola pipul langa dijan wel preisim YAWEI det trubala God. Preisim im haibalawan pawa.
Preisim det haibala neim blanga YAWEI. Bringim ofring en kaman langa im Serramoni Pleis.
Ebribodi langa dijan wel garra meigim miselp lobala en weship langa YAWEI det brabli haibalawan.
Dalim pipul langa ola kantri, “YAWEI im boswan! Dijan graun im jidan langa im rait pleis en najing kaan mubum im. Im garra jadjim ola pipul en gibit olabat feyago.”
Graun en skai, jidan gudbinji. Solwoda en ola enimul weya jidan insaid langa solwoda jingat gudbinjiwei.
Ola kantri en ebrijing weya jidan langa olabat, jidan gudbinji. Ola tri langa ola bush kantri sing gudbinjiwei.
Wen YAWEI kaman blanga jidan boswan langa dijan wel, im garra jidan bos blanga ola pipul brabli trubalawei, en det wei weya im gibitbat pipul feyago.
YAWEI det trubala God im Brabli Boswan! Ola pipul langa ebri kantri yumob gudbinji. Jidan gudbinji ola pipul langa ola longweiwan kantri.
Ola klaud en det dakbala jidan raidaran langa YAWEI. Im jidan bos en dumbat ebrijing raitwei, en im gibitbat ebribodi feyago.
Det faiya go lida langa im en barnimap ol im enami olabat.
Ola laitining blanga im shainimap dijan wel, en wen ola pipul luk tharran, im meigim olabat sheik nomo lilbit.
Ola hil meltap lida langa YAWEI. Im det boswan blanga ebrijing langa dijan graun tudei.
Ebrijing langa skai shoum det raitwei blanga im. En ebribodi langa ebri kantri luk im pawa en im shainiwan lait.
Ebribodi hu weshipbat ola drimin sheip, en hu jidan praudbala blanga olabat drimin, garra sheim miselp. Ola drimin nildan en weship YAWEI.

God bin tok blanga binijimap im pipul olabat, bat im wekinmen Mosis hu imbin pikimat, bin jandap langa God blanga detlot pipul en imbin stapam im. Imbin stapam im wen imbin gitwail brabliwei.
Brom deya deibin nokambek det gudwan kantri, dumaji olabat nomo bin bilib langa God pramis.
Deibin jidan insaid langa olabat tent en deibin grambulbat, en olabat nomo bin teiknodis langa YAWEI.
Brabliwei imbin gibit olabat dijan woning, “Yumob garra daidaibat iya langa dijan deset kantri,
en ai garra jandimwei yumob biginini olabat langa ola streinjawan kantri en larram olabat dai deya.”
Afta na langa det kantri Piyowa, God pipul olabat bin joinin blanga weship det drimin gulum Beil, en deibin dagat det sekrifais daga weya deibin gibit blanga detlot dedwan drimin sheip.
Deibin meigim YAWEI brabli wail na, en brabli nogud siknis bin kaman langa olabat.
Bat Finiyas bin gidap en panishim det dubala giltiwan pipul, en God bin stapam det siknis.
Brom det taim na pipul oldei jinggabat wanim imbin dum, en dei kaan neba fogedabat wanim imbin dum.
Langa detlot spring langa Meriba ola pipul bin meigim YAWEI gitwail brabliwei, en Mosis bin abum trabul brom olabat du.
Deibin meigim im brabli nogud, en imbin gitwail en tok adwei langa olabat.
YAWEI bin dalim olabat blanga kilim ded detlot pipul hu nomo bin bilib langa im, bat olabat nomo bin duwit.
En olabat bin merriyimbat langa olabat, en deibin bulurrumbat det wei blanga olabat.
God pipul olabat bin weshipbat ola drimin sheip, en tharran na bin meigim ola nogud ting binijimap olabat.
Deibin gibitbat olabat ronwan san en doda olabat blanga sekrifais ofring langa ola drimin sheip langa det kantri Keinan.
Deibin kilimbat ded ol detlot biginini hu nomo bin sabi dumbat eni rong ting, en det kantri bin jidan brabli nogudwan brom ol detlot medra.
Deibin meigim miselp nogud brom dumbat nogudbala ting, en dei nomo bin jidan trubala langa God.
Wal YAWEI bin gitwail langa ol im pipul olabat. Imbin brabli sheim en nogudbinji langa olabat.
Imbin hendimoba olabat langa detlot pipul hu nomo bin bilib langa im, en olabat enami olabat bin bosoba langa olabat.
Olabat enami olabat bin gibit olabat brabli adtaim, en deibin bosoba langa olabat du.
Lodataim YAWEI bin seibum im pipul olabat, bat dei nomo bin wandi irrim en teiknodis langa im, en deibin jidan mowa nogudbala.
Bat stil YAWEI bin oldei irrim olabat wen deibin oldei jingat langa im, en imbin teiknodis blanga olabat trabul.
Imbin jinggabat im strongbala pramis imbin meigim garram olabat. En dumaji imbin laigim olabat detmatj, imbin holdimbek miselp.
Imbin meigim detlot krulbala bos fil sori langa olabat du.
YAWEI, melabat God, yu seibum melabat, en yu bringimbek melabat brom ola najalot kantri, wulijim melabat garra gibit theingks en preisim yu holiwan neim.
Preisim YAWEI det trubala God blanga Isreil. Preisim im tudei en olagijawan! Ebribodi tok, “Yuwai! Trubala!” Preisim YAWEI det trubala God!
“Gibit theingks langa YAWEI dumaji im gudwan. Blanga im filing blanga laigim pipul jidan olagijawan.”
Tok lagijat na blanga preisim YAWEI ol yumob hu imbin seibum. Imbin seibum yumob brom ol yumob enamimob,
en imbin bringimbek yumob brom ola streinja kantri langa sangidapwei en sangodanwei en brom nowathwei en sauthwei.
Sambala pipul bin gitbush langa deset kantri nomo garram eni roud blanga bulurrum, en nomo bin faindim eni bigwan taun blanga jidan deya.
Olabat bin ol hanggri en thestiwan, en deibin ol gibap na.
Brom deya langa olabat trabul, deibin jingat langa YAWEI, en imbin seibum olabat brom olabat trabul.
Imbin deigim olabat langa streitwan roud langa det bigwan taun blanga jidan.
Dei garra gibit theingks langa YAWEI dumaji im kipgon laigim olabat olagijawan, en blanga ola gudwan ting weya imbin oldei dum blanga olabat.
Im meigim sedisfaid ol detlot hu jidan thestiwan, en im meigim bulap detlot pipul hu jidan hanggriwan garram ola gudwan daga.
Sambala bin jidan nogudbinjiwei langa brabli dakbala pleis. Deibin prisana garram tjein en deibin ardimbat,
dumaji dei nomo bin teiknodis ola wed blanga det brabli Boswan God, en deibin nokambek wanim imbin tok.
Olabat bin nokap brom dumbat adwek. Deibin oldei buldan en nobodi bin albumbat olabat.
Bat deibin jinginat langa YAWEI blanga olabat trabul, en imbin seibum olabat.
Imbin deigimat olabat brom det dakbala pleis, en imbin breigimap hafenhaf ol detlot tjein blanga olabat.
Dei garra gibit theingks langa YAWEI dumaji im laigimbat olabat olagijawan, en blanga ola gudwan ting weya imbin oldei dum blanga olabat.
Im oldei breigimap ola kopawan geit blanga olabat enamimob, en im smeshimap ola aiyanwan ba blanga larram im pipul jidan fri.
Sambala pipul bin siliwan, en deibin ardimbat dumaji deibin oldei dumbat brabli nogudbala ting.
Olabat nomo bin wandi dagat daga en deibin gulijap dai.
Bat deibin jingat langa YAWEI, en imbin seibum olabat brom olabat trabul.
Imbin meigim olabat gudwan garram im wed, en imbin seibum olabat brom greibyad.
Dei garra gibit theingks langa YAWEI dumaji im kipgon laigim olabat olagijawan, en blanga ola gudwan ting weya imbin oldei dum blanga olabat.
Dei garra gibit theingks langa YAWEI garram sekrifais ofring, en garram ola hepiwan song blanga dalimbat pipul blanga ebrijing imbin dumbat.
Sambala pipul bin oldei go langa solwoda garram bigwan bout weya deibin oldei wekwekbat blanga mani.
Deibin luk wanim YAWEI gin dum wen imbin dum ola gudwan ting langa solwoda.
Imbin jis tok en strongbala win bin blo, en det solwoda bin sterrimap ola weib.
Detlot ola bigwan bout bin lidap ontop en deibin kamdan adbala insaid langa det solwoda. Detlot men hubin wek langa detlot bout bin brabli bradin dumaji imbin brabli deinjawan.
Deibin buldanbat en wokaranbat jis laik drangginbala pipul. Deibin sabi hendulum bout, bat deya na dei nomo bin sabi wanim blanga dum.
Bat deibin jingat langa YAWEI, en imbin seibum olabat brom olabat trabul.
Imbin meigim det bigwan win seduldan, en detlot woda bin jidan kwaitwan.
Deibin gudbinji dumaji ebrijing bin jidan kwaitwan, en imbin meigim olabat kamat seifwan langa det pleis weya deibin wandi go.
Dei garra gibit theingks langa YAWEI dumaji im kipgon laigim olabat olagijawan, en blanga ola gudwan ting weya imbin oldei dum blanga olabat.
Dei garra tok blanga im haibalawei langa ola pipul, en preisim im langa ol detlot lidamob.
YAWEI bin meigim ola riba draiyap brabliwei, en det kantri bin jidan brabli draiwan.
Imbin meigim ola gudwan graun jidan garram solt, dumaji ol detlot hubin jidan langa det kantri bin dumbat ola brabli nogudwan ting.
Bat imbin meigim deset kantri jidan garram ola bilibong, en draiwan graun imbin meigim kamat garram ola springwoda.
Imbin larram ola hanggriwan pipul blanga jidan deya, en deibin bildimap bigwan taun blanga jidan.
Deibin growimap ola gadin blanga olabat en deibin plentimbat ola greiptri, en deibin gedimbat detmatj daga brom detlot gadin.
Imbin dum gudwan ting blanga im pipul olabat en olabat bin abumbat detmatj biginini. Imbin meigim olabat buligimob kipgon abumbat detmatj gabigabi du.
Wen detlot enamimob blanga ola pipul blanga God bidim olabat, en kilim ded detmatj pipul, en oni lilbit stil jidan, en detlot enamimob gibitbat olabat adtaim en ardimbat olabat, olabat jidan sheimwan.
En God garra jidan nogudbinji en panishim detlot enamimob, en meigim olabat wokaranbat langa deset kantri.
Bat im garra seibum ola powan pipul brom olabat trabul, en meigim olabat femilimob jidan detmatj na, wulijim ship.
Ola pipul hu jidan trubala langa God sabi dijan, en olabat brabli gudbinji. Bat ola nogudwan pipul kaan tok enijing blanga tharran.
Larram ol detlot hu jidan sabibalawei jinggabat dislot ting. Larram olabat jinggabat det filing blanga YAWEI weya im kipgon laigimbat olagijawan.

Ai garra kipgon trastimbat yu, God. Trubala, ai garra kipgon trastimbat yu. Ai garra sing en preisim yu!
Mi dalimbat miselp, “Jidan gudbinji! Gajim yu gita en sing! Ai garra gidap bifo det san en sing!”
YAWEI, ai garra gibit yu theingks lida langa ola pipul. Ai garra preisim yu lida langa ola pipul brom ebri kantri.
Yu filing blanga kipgon laigimbat pipul im jidan ebriweya, brom longwei ontop raitdan langa graun. Yu trubalawei im gajimap det skai.
God, yu shoum pipul yu haibala pawa deya ontop langa skai, en yu larram pipul luk yu brabli shainiwan lait ebriweya langa dijan wel.
Ensim main preya en seibum melabat garram yu pawa, wulijim ola pipul hu yu laigim yu garra jidan seifwan.
God bin tok brom im brabli seikridwan pleis, “Gudbinjiwei ai garra kadimat det taun gulum Shekam, en gibit det kantri Sukait Beli langa main pipul olabat.
Det dubala kantri gulum Giliyad en Manesa blanga main. Det kantri Ifreiyim jidan jis laik main speshalwan het, en det kantri Juda im jidan jis laik main speshalwan stik.
Bat ai garra meigim det kantri Moweb jidan wulijim rabishwan pleis weya tjakam dardiwan woda, en ai garra tjakam main but langa det kantri Idam blanga shoum mi bos blanga im. Mi jingat gudbinjiwei, dumaji aibin bidim detlot Filistain pipul.”
God, hu garra album mi en deigim mi langa det bigwan taun garram haibala wol? Hu garra album mi en deigim mi langa det kantri gulum Idam?
Maitbi yubin libum melabat olagijawan na God. Yu garra stil go garram melabat ami olabat o najing?
Yu album melabat fait langa dislot enami. Pipul kaan album melabat. Najing! Olabat nomo strongwan.
Oni God na garra meigim wi win. Im na garra bidim wi enami olabat.
God, mi preisim yu. Nomo jidan kwaitbala!
Ola brabli nogudbala en laiyinbala pipul bin meigim trabul blanga mi. Olabat oldei meigimap laiya stori blanga mi,
en olabat oldei toktok brabli nogudbalawei blanga mi. Olabat oldei wandi ardim mi fo najing.
Nomeda olabat oldei wandim blanga ardim mi bat stil mi laigim olabat, en mi oldei preipreibat blanga olabat.
Nomeda aibin dumbat ola gudbala ting blanga olabat, bat stil dei oldei dumbat nogudbala ting langa mi. Nomeda ai laigim olabat detmatj, bat olabat heidimbat mi.
YAWEI yu garra pikimat nogudwan jadj blanga kotim main enami, en yu meigim im ronwan enami kotim im.
Yu meigim im jidan gilti, en yu meigim im preya shoum im giltiwan du.
Meigim im laif binijap, en larram najamen teikoba det wek blanga im.
Meigim im biginini olabat jidan nomo garram enibodi, en meigim im waif jidan widogel.
Meigim im biginini olabat wokaranbat en askimbat blanga enijing. Meigim olabat gowei brom det breikapwan haus weya olabat jidanabat.
Meigim detlot pipul weya im owim mani, deigimwei ola ebrijing brom im, en larram ola streinja gedim ola ebrijing weya imbin oldei wekwekbat blanga gedim.
Nomo larram enibodi kain langa im, en nomo larram enibodi lukaftumbat im biginini olabat weya imbin libum biyain.
Meigim ol im femili olabat binijap, en nomo larram enibodi jinggabat im neim igin.
YAWEI, yu garra oldei jinggabat ol detlot nogudbalawei blanga im grengrenfatha olabat, en yu nomo larram im mami go fri brom im nogudbalawei.
YAWEI, yu garra oldei jinggabat ola nogudbalawei blanga olabat, bat meigim olabat binijap, en nobodi garra jinggabat olabat igin.
Det men na nomo bin jinggabat blanga jidan kainbala. Imbin oldei gibitbat adtaim langa ola powan pipul en langa detlot hu nomo bin abum enijing en langa detlot hubin jidan nogudbinjiwei, raidap sambala bin dai.
Imbin oldei laigim toktokbat nogudbalawei langa najalot pipul. Wal yu meigim nogud ting hepin langa im. Im nomo bin laigim dumbat gudbala ting langa najalot pipul. Wal yu nomo larram enibodi dum gudbala ting langa im.
Imbin laigim toktokbat nogudbalawei ebridei, jis laik imbin oldei laigim werrimon klos, en dagadagat daga en dringgimbat woda ebridei.
Larram ol im nogudbala wed gobek langa im igin en gaburrumap im jis laik klos en jidan raidaran im wulijim belt.
YAWEI, yu panishim main enami olabat lagijat na, ol detlot na hu tok nogudbalawei langa mi.
YAWEI main boswan God, yu album mi laik yubin pramis blanga dum. En yu seibum mi, dumaji yu gudwan filing blanga laigimbat im olagijawan.
Mi powan en nomo garram enijing. Mi brabli nogudbinji insaid jis laik pein weya ardimbat mi.
Jis laik det san weya im godan, wal lagijat na mi gulijap binij. Mi wulijim insek weya det win blowimwei.
Main dubala ni brabli wikwan brom det taim weya ai nomo bin dagadagat daga, en mi brabli bouniwan na.
Wen pipul luk langa mi, olabat laf langa mi, en olabat mokimbat mi.
YAWEI main God, album mi. Yu seibum mi, dumaji det filing blanga yu blanga laigimbat jidan olataim.
Yu meigim main enami olabat sabi yu na seibumbat mi.
Dei gin tok nogudbalawei langa mi bat yu na garra oldei dum gudbala ting blanga mi. Nomo larram main enami olabat win, en yu meigim mi, yu wekinmen, jidan gudbinji.
Meigim main enami olabat sheim miselp brabliwei. Larram det sheim blanga olabat gaburrumap olabat jis laik dei werrimon kout.
Ai garra oldei gibit theingks langa YAWEI brabliwei. Wen ola pipul majurrumap miselp blanga weship, ai garra preisim im,
dumaji im oldei maindimbat ola powan pipul, en im oldei seibum olabat brom ol detlot hu oldei wandi kilim olabat ded.
YAWEI det trubala God bin dalim main Bos, “Jidan iya langa main raidensaid en ai garra bidim ola enami blanga yu en meigim olabat jidan lobala langa yu.”
Brom Saiyan na YAWEI garra meigim yu jidan bos blanga loda kantri. Im tok, “Yu jidan bos blanga yu enami olabat.”
Langa det dei wen yu garra fait langa yu enami olabat, yu pipul olabat garra kaman en album yu. En jis laik det dyu weya im jidan ailibala, wal seimwei na ola yangbala men garra kaman langa yu deya ontop langa detlot seikridwan hil.
YAWEI bin meigim strongbala pramis en im kaan breigim det pramis. Imbin tok, “Yu garra jidan haibala serramonimen olagijawan jis laik Melkisadek.”
Det Bos jidan langa yu raidensaid. Wen im garra gitwail im garra binijimap ola king.
Im garra jadjim ola pipul langa ebri kantri, en im garra gaburrumap det faiting pleis garram ola ded bodi. Im garra bidim ola king oloba langa dijan wel.
Det king kaan wori blanga im enami olabat na, en im gin dringgim woda brom eni lilwan krik. En im garra jidan brabli strongbala dumaji imbin win.
Preisim YAWEI det trubala God! Ai garra gibit theingks langa YAWEI garram ol main hat. Lida langa ol im pipul weya majurrumap miselp,
Trubala! Ola ting weya YAWEI oldei dumbat, olabat brabli gudwan. Ol detlot pipul hu oldei gudbinji blanga detlot gudwan ting, oldei wandim sabi mowa blanga olabat.
Garram detmatj rispek en pawa im dum ebrijing, en im trubalawei jidan olagijawan.
YAWEI nomo larram wi fogedabat blanga ola gudwan ting weya im oldei dumbat. Im brabli kainbalawan en im garram soribalawan filing blanga pipul.
Im gibit daga langa ol detlot hu rispek im. Im nomo fogedabat im strongwan pramis.
Imbin shoum im pawa langa im pipul olabat wen imbin gibit olabat ola kantri blanga ola najalot pipul.
Langa ebrijing im dum im trubala, en im oldei gibit feyago langa pipul. Yu gin trastim ol im lowa brabliwei.
Im lowa jidan olagijawan. Olabat jidan trubala en dei jidan raitwei, nomo garram eni rong.
Imbin baiyimbek im pipul olabat, en imbin meigim det olagijawan brabli strongwan pramis garram olabat. Im na det holiwan en det haibalawan God.
Yu garra abum rispek langa YAWEI basdam blanga jidan sabibala, en im garra gibit ol detlot pipul hu teiknodis langa im lowa gudbala main blanga jinggabat raitwei. Pipul garra oldei kipgon preisimbat im olagijawan.
Preisim YAWEI det trubalawan God! Im gudbinji langa ol detlot pipul hu weship langa im, en hu teiknodis langa ol im lowa gudbinjiwei.
Ola bigininimob blanga detlot pipul garra jidan strongbalawan langa olabat kantri, dumaji YAWEI im gibit ebrijing langa ol detlot bigininimob hu bulurrum im.
Olabat garra jidan ritjwan garram ebrijing, en olabat garra oldei jidan trubalawei.
Wen ol detlot pipul na jidan langa dakbala pleis, God garra jandim lait langa olabat jis laik wen det san gidap, dumaji olabat jidan brabli kainbalawei, en abum soribalawan filing en jidan gudbinjiwei.
Ol detlot hu gibitat enijing gudbinjiwei, en hu nomo ad garram olabat mani, en hu dum ebrijing trubalawei, olabat na garra abum brabli gudwan laif.
Trabul kaan kaman langa olabat, najing. Nobodi kaan foget blanga ola kainbalawan ting weya deibin oldei dumbat.
Dei nomo bradin blanga gedim bednyus. Olabat jidan strongwan langa YAWEI en trastim langa im.
Olabat nomo jinggabat blanga enijing, en nomo bradin du. Olabat sabi brabliwei olabat enamimob kaan win, najing.
Olabat garra oldei jidan trubalawei. Detlot najalot pipul garra toktokbat olataim blanga olabat, dumaji deibin oldei dumbat ola gudwan ting blanga ola powan pipul.
Wen ola nogudwan pipul garra luk, olabat garra barn binji brabliwei blanga tharran, en dei garra kipgon lagijat raidap olabat binij. Olabat kaan gedim detlot ting weya deibin wandimbat brabliwei.
Preisim YAWEI det trubalawan God! Kaman en preisim im neim ol yumob hu wek blanga im.
Preisim im neim tudei en olagijawan.
Wi garra preisim det neim blanga YAWEI brom sangidaptaim raidap sangodantaim.
YAWEI im jidan mowa haibalawan langa ola pipul langa ebri kantri tudei. Im jidan mowa haibalawan oba ebrijing ontop langa hebin.
Nobodi gin jidan wulijim YAWEI det trubalawan God blanga wi. Im jidan brabli haibalawan na.
Im jukdan blanga luk ebrijing langa skai en langa dijan wel.
God im album ol detlot powan pipul hu nomo garram enijing, jis laik dei jidan langa det rabishwan pleis, en brom deya im lidimap olabat,
en im meigim olabat jidan mijamet garram ola bos blanga im pipul olabat.
Wen det waifwan kaan abum biginini, wal YAWEI larram im blanga abum biginini, en det gel jidan brabli gudbinji. Preisim YAWEI det trubalawan God.
Wen detlot Isreil pipul hubin det femilimob blanga Jeikob bin libum det kantri Ijip weya pipul deya tok najawan langgus,
ola Juda pipul bin jidan seikridwan blanga YAWEI, en ola Isreil pipul bin jidan ronwan pipul blanga YAWEI.
God bin kaman langa det Redsi en imbin draiyimap det woda, en det Jodan Riba bin stap randan.
Detlot bigwan hil bin jampjamp wulijim nenigout, en najalot hil bin jamparanbat wulijim yangwan ship.
Wanim bin hepin langa yu solwoda blanga meigim yu draiyap? En yu Jodan Riba, wotfo yubin stap randanbat?
Ol yumob bigwan hil, wotfo yumob bin jampjamp wulijim nenigout? En ol yumob hil, wotfo yumob bin jamparanbat wulijim yangwan ship?
Sheiksheik graun! YAWEI im kaminap. Sheik lida langa YAWEI det God blanga Jeikob.
Im na bin meigim woda kamat brom bigwan rok, en bin meigim springwoda ranat brom ola adwan rok.
Oni langa yu na YAWEI, oni langa yu melabat garra preisimbat, dumaji yu kipgon laigimbat yu pipul olabat, en yu jidan brabli trubalawan langa olabat. Melabat kaan preisim miselp.
Wotfo ola pipul brom najalot kantri askim melabat, “Wujei yumob God?”
Blanga melabat God im jidan langa hebin. Im gin dum enijing im wandim blanga dum.
Ola drimin blanga najalot pipul, olabat bin meigim brom silba en gol. Garram olabat ronwan bingga olabat bin meigim detlot drimin.
Detlot drimin garram mawus bat olabat kaan tok, najing. Olabat garram ai, bat olabat kaan luk, najing.
Olabat garram irriwol bat olabat kaan lisin enijing, en blanga olabat nos kaan smelim enijing.
Blanga olabat bingga kaan filim enijing. Blanga olabat leig kaan mubabat blanga wok, najing. Olabat kaan tok du, najing.
Larram ol detlot pipul hubin meigimbat olabat en hu trastim olabat jidan jis laik detlot drimin sheip weya deibin meigim.
Ola Isreil pipul, yumob garra trastim langa YAWEI. Im na oldei albumbat en maindimbat yumob.
Ola femili blanga Eran, hu jidan detlot serramonimen blanga YAWEI, yumob garra trastim langa YAWEI. Im na oldei albumbat en maindimbat yumob.
Ebribodi hu weship langa YAWEI, yumob garra trastim langa YAWEI. Im na oldei albumbat en maindimbat yumob.
YAWEI kaan fogedabat langa wi. Im garra albumbat ola Isreil pipul, en ola serramonimen blanga God.
YAWEI garra albumbat ol detlot hu oldei weshipbat langa im, nomeda im haibala o lobala.
Mi prei langa YAWEI blanga meigim yumob femili en blanga olabat femilimob blanga jidan bigmob.
Larram YAWEI gibit ol gudwan ting langa yumob. Im na bin meigim ebrijing langa skai en dijan kantri.
Det haibala hebin im jidan blanga YAWEI, bat imbin gibit ola kantri langa dijan wel langa wi.
Ol detlot hubin binijap kaan preisim YAWEI enimo.
Oni wi na hu jidan laibala garra gibit im theingks olagijawan. Aleiluya! Preisim YAWEI!

YAWEI, dumaji ola wikitwan pipul nomo teiknodis langa detlot lowa blanga yu, yu nomo seibum olabat.
YAWEI, det kainbalawan filing blanga yu im jidan detmatj na. Yu sori langa mi en yu seibum mi.
Ai garram loda enami en bedfren hu oldei tridim mi nogudwei, bat ai nomo tenawei brom detlot lowa blanga yu.
Wen mi luk langa detlot pipul hu nomo bilib langa yu im meigim mi fil brabli nogudbinji, dumaji olabat nomo bulurrum detlot lowa blanga yu.
Yu luk haumatj mi laigim detlot lowa blanga yu YAWEI. Wen yu laigim pipul, tharran kaan tjeinj. Im olagijawan na. Yu shoum yu laigim mi en yu seibum mi.
YAWEI, yu wed im trubala, en ebrijing weya yu titjimbat pipul garra jidan olagijawan.
YAWEI, ola brabli haibala pipul nomo gibit mi feyago nomo garram risan, bat brabliwei mi rispek yu lowa.
Dumaji blanga ol yu pramis mi brabli gudbinji, jis laik sambodi hu gudbinji brabliwei wen im faindim samting brabli gudwan.
Brabliwei ai nomo laigim detlot pipul hu dalimbat laiya, bat mi laigim ol yu lowa.
Sebenbalataim ebridei mi tok theingkyu langa yu dumaji wen yu jadjim pipul yu gibit olabat feyago.
Detlot hu laigim yu lowa, olabat jidan brabli gudbalawei. Najing kaan meigim olabat go nogudbalawei.
YAWEI, mi weit langa yu blanga seibum mi. Mi dum wanim yu dalim mi.
Mi duwit langa ol yu lowa, en mi laigim olabat insaid langa main hat.
Mi lisin en bilib blanga ol detlot lowa blanga yu en langa wanim yu tok. Yu sabi ebrijing weya mi dum.
YAWEI, mi jingat langa yu blanga album mi, Yu meigim mi sabi yu wed brabliwei jis laik yubin pramis.
YAWEI, irrim main preya. Seibum mi jis laik yubin tok langa yu pramis.
Ai garra oldei preisimbat yu, dumaji yu oldei lenimbat mi blanga ol yu lowa.
Ai garra sing song blanga ol yu lowa, dumaji ol yu lowa im trubalawan, nomo garram enijing rong.
YAWEI, jidan redibala blanga album mi, dumaji mi bulurrum detlot lowa blanga yu.
Mi oldei wandim yu blanga seibum mi brabliwei, YAWEI. Detlot lowa blanga yu meigim mi jidan gudbinjiwei.
Larram mi jidan laibala, wulijim ai garra oldei preisim yu. Larram detlot lowa blanga yu album mi.
Mi wokaranbat laiga ship weya imbin los. Wal yu kaman en lukabat mi, yu wekinmen, dumaji ai nomo bin fogedabat ola lowa blanga yu.
Wen aibin abum trabul, aibin jingat langa YAWEI, en imbin ensim mi en album mi.
YAWEI, yu seibum mi brom ola laiyawan pipul, en brom detlot pipul hu nomo jidan trubalawei.
Yumob ola laiyawan pipul, wanim God garra dum langa yumob? Hau im garra panishim yumob?
Im garra panishim yumob brabliwei garram ola shapwan spiya blanga solja, en barnimap yumob garram brabli hotwan eshis.
Mi jidanabat garram yumob, en im nogudwan. Im seim laik mi jidan garram detlot krulbala pipul brom det dubala kantri gulum Mishek en Keda.
Aibin jidan brabli longtaim garram pipul hu nomo laigim blanga jidan gudbinjiwei.
Wen mi tok blanga jidan kwaitbalawei, olabat wandi fait.
Ai lukap langa ola hil. Hu garra kaman blanga album mi wen mi abum trabul?
YAWEI det trubala God na garra kaman blanga album mi. Im na bin meigim ebrijing langa skai en langa graun.
YAWEI, im oldei wotjimbat wi wulijim wi kaan buldan. Im oldei lukaftumbat wi. Im nomo go silip.
Tharran hu lukaftumbat im pipul langa Isreil, im jidan weik en wotjimbat. Im nomo go silip.
YAWEI kipum wi seif brom olkain trabul, jis laiga bigwan tri im gudwan sheid brom det hotwan san.
YAWEI im blokim ebrijing. Det san kaan ardim wi deitaim, en det mun kaan ardim wi naitaim. Nomo enijing kaan ardim wi deitaim en naitaim.
YAWEI garra kipum wi seif. Nomo enijing kaan ardim wi. Im garra wotjimbat wi.
Wen yu gowei YAWEI garra wotjimbat yu, en wen yu kambek im garra lukaftum yu, tudei na, en tumorro en olagijawan.
Aibin gudbinji wen deibin tok langa mi, “Kaman! Wi ol go langa det haus blanga YAWEI.”
Wal wi iya na jandapbat insaid langa detlot geit blanga Jerusalem.
Jerusalem im det taun weya deibin bildimap brabli gudwei, en weya ola pipul kaman mijamet nomo garram eni trabul.
Dijan na det pleis weya ola klen blanga Isreil kaman mijamet blanga gibit theingks langa YAWEI jis laik imbin tok langa im wed.
Iya na ola king blanga Isreil jidan blanga kotimbat olabat pipul.
Askim God blanga larram ola pipul langa Jerusalem jidan gudbinjiwei. Prei langa God, “God, larram ol detlot pipul hu laigim yu jidan gudbinjiwei.
Larram ol detlot pipul jidan gudbinjiwei deya insaid langa det wol blanga Jerusalem, en ola boswan jidan seifwan langa olabat bigwan haus.”
Dumaji ai laigim main femili olabat en ol main fren olabat, ai askim God blanga larram olabat jidan gudbinjiwei.
En dumaji ai laigim det haus blanga YAWEI, wi God, ai askim im blanga larram ebribodi langa Jerusalem jidan gudbinjiwei.
YAWEI ai lukap langa yu deya ontop langa hebin weya yu jidan king langa dijan wel.
Jis laik det wekinmen lukinat blanga im bos, en jis laik det wekingel lukinat blanga im gelwan bos, wal melabat du garra kipgon lukinat en weidabat blanga yu YAWEI, melabat God, raidap yu garra fil sori langa melabat.
YAWEI yu sori langa melabat. Yu sori langa melabat. Najalot pipul bin tridimbat melabat brabli nogudbalawei.
Ola ritjwan pipul oldei mokimbat melabat, en ola praudbala pipul oldei tok blanga melabat nogudbalawei.
If YAWEI nomo bina jidan garram wi, wanim bina hepin langa wi? Yumob Isreil pipul ensim mi!
“If YAWEI nomo bina jidan garram wi wen wi enamimob bin kaman blanga fait langa wi,
dei bina binijimap wi, dumaji deibin wail langa wi detmatj,
en jis laiga fladwoda, olabat bina deigimwei wi en gaburrumap wi,
en det fladwoda bina binijimap wi na.”
Wi gibit theingks langa YAWEI. Im nomo bin larram wi enamimob kilim wi ded, jis laiga brabli jigiwan dog.
Wibin ranawei friwan wulijim bard wen im flaiwei brom det breikinwan trep.
Oni YAWEI na oldei albumbat wi. Im na bin meigim det skai en dijan graun.
Detlot hu trastim langa YAWEI jidan wulijim det bigwan hil gulum Saiyan, weya najing gin sheikim en najing gin mubum im.
Wulijim ola bigwan hil jadimap Jerusalem raidaran, wal lagijat du YAWEI jadimap im pipul olabat tudei en olagijawan du.
Ola nogudbala pipul kaan oldei bosoba langa ola kantri blanga ola pipul hu jidan trubalawei langa yu, dumaji if olabat bosoba, bambai detlot pipul hu jidan trubalawei mait stat dumbat nogudwan ting du.
YAWEI, yu garra dum gudwan ting langa detlot pipul hu jidan gudwei, langa ol detlot hu teiknodis langa yu wed.
Bat wen yu panishim detlot nogudbala pipul hu oldei dumbat ola nogudbala ting, yu garra panishim ol detlot pipul hubin libum det wei blanga yu du. YAWEI, yu garra meigim yu ronwan pipul, ola Isreil pipul, jidan gudbinjiwei.
Wen YAWEI bin bringimbek melabat langa Jerusalem imbin jis laik melabat bin drim tharran.
Wibin laflafbat en wibin singsingbat dumaji wibin gudbinji. En ola pipul brom ola najalot kantri bin tok blanga melabat lagijat, “YAWEI bin dum ola brabli gudbala ting langa olabat.”
Trubala imbin dum ola brabli gudbala ting blanga wi, en wibin brabli gudbinji!
YAWEI, yu gibit melabat ebrijing igin, jis laik rein wen im bilimap woda langa ola draiwan riba.
Larram ol detlot pipul hubin kraikrai wen deibin plentimbat olabat gadin, gajimbat detlot sid daga gudbinjiwei.
Ol detlot pipul hubin kraikrai wen deibin go blanga plentimbat ola sid daga, garra kambek singsingbat gudbinjiwei wen olabat bringimbek ola daga.
If YAWEI nomo albumbat detlot wekinmen bildimap det haus, wal det wek im nomo enijing. If YAWEI nomo maindimbat det taun, wal im nogud blanga detlot solja blanga maindimbat det taun.
Im nogud blanga wori en adwek brom sangidaptaim raidap sangodantaim blanga gajimbat naf daga, dumaji YAWEI im dumbat ebrijing langa ol detlot pipul hu laigim im en im gibit olabat taim blanga silip du.
YAWEI na oldei gibit pipul biginini. Olabat brabli speshalwan brom im.
Wen det men im yangbala en abum loda san, wal detlot san blanga im, olabat jidan jis laik loda spiya langa solja bingga.
Wal det men im hepiwan weya im garram loda san, dumaji im enami olabat kaan bidim im wen im midap langa olabat.
Ol detlot pipul hu teiknodis langa YAWEI en hu bulurrum im wei, olabat na garra jidan gudbinjiwei.
Yu garra dum wek blanga gajim ola enijing blanga yu laif, en yu garra jidan gudbalawei.
Yu waif garra abum detmatj biginini jis laik greiptri weya abum detmatj daga, en olabat garra jidan raidaran langa yu faiya pleis.
Lagijat na YAWEI im gibit ola gudbala ting langa pipul hu teiknodis en duwit langa im.
Ai askim YAWEI blanga gibit yu ola gudbala ting brom im serramoni pleis langa Saiyan, en blanga larram yu luk Jerusalem abum ebrijing brom tudei raidap yu dai.
Ai prei yu garra jidan laibalawan raidap yu luk yu bigininimob biginini olabat. YAWEI, yu meigim ola Isreil pipul jidan gudbinjiwei!
Det serramonimen bin sing, “Yumob Isreil pipul, yumob garra sing blanga hau wi enami olabat bin oldei gibitbat wi adtaim brom wen wibin yang.”
En detlot Isreil pipul bin sing, “Brom wen wibin yang wi enami olabat bin oldei gibitbat wi adtaim, bat dei nomo bin bidim wi, najing.
Deibin beldimbat wi en meigim dipwan mak langa wi bekboun, jis laik det fama weya im kadim det graun blanga growimap daga.
Bat YAWEI oldei dum wanim rait, en imbin meigim wi fri brom jidanbat prisana blanga wekwekbat blanga ola nogudbala pipul.”
YAWEI, wi askim yu blanga bidim ol detlot pipul hu nomo laigim yu serramoni pleis langa Saiyan, en yu meigim olabat sheim miselp en ranawei.
Meigim olabat jidan jis laik sid daga gras weya grogro ontop langa haus en im draiyap bifo im gro bigwan,
en nobodi kaan hipimap en deigidawei eni sid daga.
En dumaji nobodi garra gajimbat eni sid daga wal nobodi kaan tok dijan, “Larram det gudbalawei blanga YAWEI jidan garram yu.” En nobodi kaan ensim, “Wi garra gudbala langa yu garram det neim blanga YAWEI.”
YAWEI, mi brabli nogudbinji en im jis laik mi jidanabat langa dakwan pleis. Mi jinginatbat langa yu blanga album mi.
YAWEI, yu lisin langa mi wen mi jinginatbat langa yu blanga album mi.
YAWEI, if yu bina raidimdan ol melabat nogudbalawei, ebribodi bina git panish en dai.
Bat yu nomo bin peiyimbek melabat blanga melabat nogudbalawei, wulijim melabat gin shoum rispek langa yu.
Mi weit garram opin hat blanga YAWEI blanga album mi, en mi trastim langa im wed.
Mi weidabat blanga yu YAWEI garram opin hat brabliwei, jis laik detlot men hu oldei wek wotjimbat olnait, en weidabat blanga wotaim im garra ailibala.
Trastim YAWEI ol yumob Isreil pipul. Im kaan neba stap laigimbat yumob, en im oldei redi blanga seibumbat yumob.
Oni im na garra seibum ol yumob Isreil pipul brom ol yumob nogudbalawei.
YAWEI, aibin libum ol main praudbalawei. Ai nomo reken miselp blanga jinggabat hau blanga dum detlot ting weya im brabli adwan, o hau blanga dum klebabala ting.
Bat mi jidan kwaitwan jis laiga biginini weya im jidan garram im mami. En main hat im jidan lagijat du.
Yumob Isreil pipul, yumob trastim langa YAWEI tudei en olagijawan.
YAWEI, yu nomo fogedabat Deibid, en ola adtaim imbin abumbat.
YAWEI, yu jinggabat wanim imbin pramis langa yu, det haibalawan God blanga Jeikob,
“Ai kaan gobek langa kemp o gobek blanga leidan langa bed,
en ai kaan abum spel o silip,
raidap ai meigim haus blanga YAWEI, det haibalawan God blanga Jeikob.”
Wibin irrim stori langa Bethlahem blanga det Seikridwan Boks, en wibin faindim im deya langa det pedik gulijap langa det taun gulum Jerim.
Melabat bin tok, “Kaman! Wi garra go deya langa det Serramoni Pleis blanga YAWEI en wi garra nildan en weship im lida langa im speshalwan tjeya.”
YAWEI, kaman en jidan deya langa yu Serramoni Pleis garram det Seikridwan Boks, weya pipul sabi yu pawa oldei jidan.
Larram ol detlot serramonimen blanga yu oldei dum wanim rait olataim. Larram ol yu pipul olabat jingat adbala gudbinjiwei.
YAWEI, yubin meigim pramis langa yu wekinmen Deibid. Nomo gibit bekboun langa im, det king weya yubin pikimat.
Yubin meigim brabli strongwan pramis langa Deibid, en yu garra oldei kipum det pramis. “Ai garra oldei meigim wan san blanga yu femili lain jidan king.
If dei jidan trubalawei langa main strongbala pramis, en if dei teiknodis langa wanim ai dalim olabat, wal dei garra kipgon jidan king.”
YAWEI bin pikimat Saiyan, en im wandim meigim tharran im kemp.
“Iya na ai garra jidan olagijawan, en iya na ai wandim jidan bos.
Ai garra gibit Saiyan ebrijing im wandim, en ai garra meigim ola powan pipul sedisfaid garram daga.
Ebrijing detlot serramonimen dum ai garra gudbinji langa olabat, en ola pipul garra sing ola song gudbinjiwei.
Iya na ai garra meigim wanbala jidan haibala king brom det femili lain blanga Deibid, en im garra jidan laiga lait weya im shain olagija.
Ai garra meigim ol im enami olabat jidan sheim nomo lilbit, bat det kantri weya im garra jidan bos garra abum detmatj ebrijing.”
Trubala im brabli gudwan wen pipul blanga God jidan wanmob gudbinjiwei!
Im brabli gudwan jis laik wen deibin spilim det brabli gudwan oil ontop langa det hed blanga Eran, en det oil bin randan brom im hed raitdan langa im speshalwan klos.
En im brabli gudwan jis laik det dyu ontop langa det bigwan hil gulum Hemen en langa detlot hil langa Saiyan. Deya na YAWEI bin pramisim blanga gibit im pipul olabat det olagijawan laif.
Kaman en preisim YAWEI ola wekinmen blanga im, ol yumob pipul hu wek naitaim langa im Serramoni Pleis.
Lidimap yumob bingga en prei, en preisim YAWEI.
Ai askim YAWEI hu jidan deya langa Saiyan, en hubin meigim hebin en dijan wel, blanga jidan gudbalawei blanga yumob.
Preisim YAWEI det trubala God! Preisim im neim, ol yumob hu wek blanga YAWEI.
Yumob hu wek deya insaid langa det haus blanga YAWEI wi God,
preisim im dumaji im gudwan. Sing song blanga preisim im neim dumaji im jidan kainbala.
Imbin pikimat Jeikob en ola Isreil pipul blanga im ronselp.
YAWEI im God blanga wi, en ai sabi im det brabli haibalawan God. Im mowa haibala langa najalot drimin.
Im dum wanim im wandim langa hebin en langa dijan kantri en insaid langa solwoda raitdan langa bodam.
Im bringimap rein klaud brom olaran langa ebri kantri. Im meigim laitining blanga ola bigwan rein, en im bringimap win brom det pleis weya im jidan.
Langa det kantri Ijip imbin binijimap ola men en ola enimul hubin bon fes.
Deya na imbin dum ola klebabala ting blanga panishim det king en ol im brabli haibala wekinmen olabat.
Imbin binijimap detmatj pipul brom najalot kantri, en ola brabli strongbala king,
det King Saihan blanga det Emarait traib, en King Og brom Beishan, en ola king langa det kantri gulum Keinan.
Imbin gibit ola kantri blanga olabat langa ola Isreil pipul, detlot pipul blanga im na.
YAWEI, pipul garra oldei tok yu jidan God. Brom ola femili tudei raidap langa ola femili hu garra jidan bambai, dei garra oldei jinggabat blanga yu.
YAWEI garra oldei lukaftumbat im pipul olabat. Im garra oldei jidan kainbala langa im wekinmen olabat.
Ola pipul brom najalot kantri bin meigim ola drimin sheip garram gol en silba. Deibin meigim garram olabat ronwan bingga.
Detlot drimin sheip garram mawus bat dei kaan tok, en dei garram ai bat dei kaan luk.
Detlot drimin sheip garram irriwol bat dei kaan irrim, en dei nomo blowin.
Larram ol detlot pipul hubin meigimbat olabat en hu trastimbat olabat, jidan nomo garram eni pawa wulijim detlot drimin sheip.
Ola Isreil pipul, preisim YAWEI! Ola wekinmen blanga God, preisim im.
Ol yumob Libai klen, preisim YAWEI. Ol yumob hu weship im, preisim im du.
Preisim YAWEI langa Saiyan deya langa Jerusalem weya im jidan. Preisim YAWEI det trubala God!
YAWEI det trubala God im gudbala langa wi. Dumaji im gudbala langa wi, blanga tharran na wi garra gibit im theingks. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.
Im na det brabli haibala God. Blanga tharran na, wi garra gibit im theingks. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.
Im na det bos. Dumaji im bos, wal wi garra gibit im theingks. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.
Im dum ola brabli klebabala ting weya nobodi iya kaan dum. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.
Im na sabi ebrijing brabliwei. Lagijat na imbin meigim det skai. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.
Imbin meigim det graun jidan ontop langa det solwoda. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.
Imbin meigim ola lait. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.
Imbin meigim det san shain deitaim. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.
Imbin meigim det mun en ola sta shain naitaim. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.
God bin panishim detlot pipul langa Ijip, en imbin kilim ded ola feswan san blanga olabat. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan. Garram im strongwan pawa, imbin seibum ola Isreil pipul brom Ijip. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.

Imbin deigim detlot Isreil pipul thru langa midul. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.

Imbin deigim im pipul thru langa det bush kantri. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.
Imbin kilim ded ola strongbala boswan. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.

Imbin jinggabat wi wen wibin jidan brabli nogudbinji. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.
Imbin seibum wi brom wi enami olabat. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.
Im gibit daga langa ebribodi en langa ola enimul du. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.
Gibit theingks langa YAWEI. Im deya langa hebin. Trubala, im laigim wi tudei en olagijawan.
Deya gulijap langa detlot riba langa Bebalon wibin jidan, en deya na wibin krai nomo lilbit wen wibin jinggabat Saiyan.
Wi nomo bin abum filing blanga sing en plei gita, en wibin heingimap olabat langa gulijapwan tri.
Detlot Bebalon pipul hubin meigim wi prisana bin dalim wi blanga sing, “Yumob sing song langa melabat blanga Saiyan.”
Hau wi garra sing song langa YAWEI iya langa dijan streinja kantri?
Nomo larram mi plei gita igin if mi fogedabat yu, Jerusalem.
Nomo larram mi sing igin if mi fogedabat yu, en if ai nomo jinggabat yu weya yu jidan det nambawan blanga mi.
YAWEI, yu jinggabat wanim detlot pipul blanga Idam bin dum detaim wen deibin teikoba Jerusalem. Yu jinggabat hau deibin kipgon toktok, “Nokamdan im holbit raitdan langa graun.”
Pipul blanga Bebalon, bambai yumob garra binijap. Detlot pipul hu garra peiyimbek yumob blanga wanim yumob bin dum langa melabat, garra gudbinji.
Olabat garra deigim yumob beibimob en smeshimap olabat langa bigwan ston.
YAWEI, ai gibit theingks langa yu garram ol main hat. Ai sing preis song langa yu lida langa ol detlot najalot drimin.
Ai weship en preisim yu. Yu filing blanga laigim jidan olagijawan en yu jidan trubalawan. Yu neim en yu wed jidan brabli haibala.
Yubin ensim mi wen aibin jingat langa yu. Garram yu pawa yubin meigim mi strongbala.
YAWEI, ola king langa dijan wel garra preisim yu, dumaji deibin irrim ol yu pramis.
Olabat garra sing song blanga wanim yubin dum, en blanga yu haibalawanwei.
Nomeda yu jidan deya langa top, yu kain langa pipul hu jidan lobalawei, en praudbala pipul kaan haidim miselp brom yu.
Wen detmatj trabul kaman langa mi, yu kipum mi seifwan. Yu seibum mi garram yu pawa brom ol main enami olabat wen dei wail langa mi.
Yu garra dum ebrijing yubin pramis. YAWEI, yu filing blanga laigim mi jidan olagijawan. Yu binijim det wek yubin olredi stat dumbat.
YAWEI, yubin luk insaid main hat, en yu sabi ebrijing weya mi dum en jinggabat.
Yu sabi ebrijing. Wen mi jidan en wen mi jandap, yu sabi. Nomeda yu longwei, bat stil yu sabi wanim mi jinggabat.

Det brabli sabibalawan im jis laik det wuman hu oldei jinginatbat langa ebri roud langa det taun en langa detlot pleis weya pipul oldei go blanga baiyim enijing.
Im oldei jinginatbat adbala langa detlot taun geit en langa ola pleis weya pipul midap.
Wal im tok, “Ol yumob silibala pipul, haulong yumob garra jidan lagijat? Haulong yumob garra dumbat detkain ting en meigimbat fan langa mi? Wotfo yumob nomo len blanga dum gudbala ting?
Yumob lisin gudwei na wanim ai garra dalim yumob. Ai garra dalimbat yumob gudwan wed weya ai sabi.
Aibin oldei jinginat langa yumob, bat yumob nomo bin lisin langa mi, najing. Aibin trai pudumat main bingga, bat yumob nomo bin teiknodis, najing.
Yumob nomo bin teiknodis langa main wed. Yumob nomo wandim mi blanga dalim yumob hau blanga jidan raitwei.
“Wal bambai ai garra laflaf langa yumob wen yumob garra abum trabul, en ai garra meigimbat fan langa yumob wen nogudbala ting garra hepin langa yumob.
Det brabli nogudbala ting garra kaman langa yumob wulijim bigiswan rein. Det trabul garra kaman langa yumob jis laik det wiliwili, en yumob garra abum loda pein en yumob garra nogudbinji nomo lilbit.
Bambai na yumob garra jingat langa mi blanga album yumob, bat ai kaan ensim yumob. En yumob garra lukabat blanga mi, bat yumob kaan faindim mi.
Yumob nomo bin wandim len blanga det sabibalawei brom mi en yumob nomo bin teiknodis langa YAWEI.
Yumob nomo bin lisin en teiknodis langa main wed. Yumob nomo bin laigim dum ola rait ting wen aibin dalimbat yumob.
Wal yumob garra faindat wanim garra hepin langa yumob. Yumob garra abum trabul. En detlot nogudwan plen weya yumob bin meigimbat blanga najalot pipul garra kambek langa yumob igin.
“Wal ola pipul hu nomo sabi enijing garra gitkil, dumaji dei nomo lisin langa ola gudwan wed en dei nomo wandim dum ola gudbala ting.
Bat detlot pipul hu lisin gudwei langa mi garra jidan gudbalawei langa seifwan pleis. Nomo enijing kaan ardimbat olabat na en dei kaan bradin blanga enijing.” Lagijat na det brabli sabibalawan bin tok.
Wal det sabibala tok dijan, “Main biginini, yu len wanim mi titjimbat yu. Yu garra oldei jinggabat wanim mi oldei dalimbat yu blanga dum.
Yu garra lisin langa ola brabli gudwan wed en trai blanga sabi detlot ting.
Yu garra kipgon askimbat mi blanga meigim yu jidan sabibalawan.
Yu garra wek brabli adbala blanga jidan sabibala, jis laik wen yu go lukabat blanga silba o gol, en yu kaan gibap, najing.
If yu dum lagijat yu garra sabi en shoum rispek langa YAWEI det trubala God en yu garra sabi mowa blanga im.
Oni YAWEI na garra meigim yu jidan sabibala, en album yu blanga sabi mowa.
Im na oldei maindimbat en albumbat detlot pipul hu oldei dum wanim rait en jidan trubalawei.
Im na oldei maindimbat detlot pipul hu oldei gibit feyago langa najalot pipul en im oldei maindimbat detlot pipul hu oldei jidan trubala langa im.
“Wal if yu dum lagijat yu garra sabi hau blanga jidan trubalawei en gibit pipul feyago, en hau blanga jidan raitwei.
Yu garra jidan sabibala en yu garra jidan brabli gudbinji wen yu sabi brabliwei.
Detlot brabli gudwan wed garra seibum yu en album yu nomo blanga dumbat eni nogudbala ting, en im garra seibum yu brom detlot pipul hu oldei toktokbat nogudbalawei blanga yu.
<range>
Olabat bin stap dumbat ola rait ting. Dei oldei dumbat ola nogudbala ting jis laik dei wok langa brabli dakbala pleis.
Olabat oldei laigim dumbat ola nogudbala ting en olabat gudbinji blanga dumbat detlot nogudwan ting.
Yu kaan trastim olabat dumaji det wei blanga olabat nomo trubalawan.
“Wal detlot brabli gudwan wed garra album yu blanga gibit bekboun langa eni tufeis gel weya tok garram brabli switwan wed langa yu.
Det gel nomo jidan trubala langa im hasbin. Im fogedabat det pramis weya imbin meigim lida langa God.
If yu go langa im haus, wal yu garra dai dumaji im jis laik yu wokwokbat langa det nogudwan roud langa det pleis weya ola dedbala pipul oldei jidanbat.
Nobodi kaan go langa im haus en kambek laibwan brom det pleis.
Bat yu garra bulurrum det wei blanga ola sabibala pipul en jidan gudwei.
Detlot pipul hu oldei jidan trubalawei garra jidan langa olabat kantri.
Bat detlot nogudbala pipul hu oldei dumbat nogudbala ting, wal God na garra andimwei olabat brom olabat kantri.”
Wal det sabibala bin kipgon tok, “Wal main biginini, yu nomo fogedabat wanim aibin oldei titjimbat yu. Yu garra kipum ol detlot wed langa yu main,
wulijim yu garra jidan laibala longtaim en yu laif garra jidan brabli gudwan.
Yu garra jidan brabli trubala en yu garra kain langa ebribodi en yu garra shoum ebribodi yu gin dum gudbala ting. Yu garra kipum ol dislot wed langa yu main.
If yu dum lagijat wal God en ola pipul garra brabli gudbinji langa yu.
“Yu garra trastim YAWEI det trubala God garram yu hat holbit. Nomo reken miselp blanga dum ebrijing yuselp.
Yu jinggabat langa YAWEI blanga ebrijing weya yu dum en im garra shoum yu det raitwei.
Nomo reken miselp yu sabi blanga dumbat ola gudwan klebabala ting. Yu garra teiknodis en rispek langa YAWEI en yu nomo dumbat nogudbala ting.
If yu dum lagijat, wal im jis laik medisin blanga meigim yu gudwan brom ola sowa langa yu bodi en deigidawei ola pein.
Yu garra shoum rispek langa YAWEI en gibit im ol detlot feswan frut daga en sid daga weya yu gajim brom yu fam,
wulijim yu fam garra jidan garram olkain frut daga en detlot nyuwan wain garra jidan raitful langa detlot wodadram.
“Main biginini, yu garra teiknodis langa YAWEI en yu nomo gitwail wen im gibit yu woning blanga dum rait ting.
YAWEI oldei gibit woning langa detlot pipul weya im laigim jis laik det dediwan wen im gibit woning langa im biginini olabat weya im laigim.
“Wal detlot pipul hu sabi dumbat ola gudwan klebabala ting garra jidan brabli hepiwan en olabat garra jidan gudbinji blanga len mowa.
If yu klebabala wal im mobeda den if yu jidan brabli ritjwan garram silba en gol.
If yu sabi hau blanga dum ola sabibalawan ting wal im mobeda langa ola purdiwan ston. Nomo enijing weya yu wandimbat kaan jidan lebul langa im.
Det brabli sabibalawan im meigim yu jidan laibala longtaim en im meigim yu jidan ritjwan en im meigim yu jidan haibala.
Det brabli sabibalawan meigim yu jidan brabli gudbalawei, nomo garram eni trabul.
Detlot pipul hu jidan sabibala garra jidan gudbinji. Det gudbinjiwei garra gibit olabat laif.
“Wal garram det sabibalawei blanga im, YAWEI bin meigim dijan wel, en imbin sabi hau blanga pudum det skai langa im pleis.
Garram im sabibalawei imbin meigim detlot riba kamat en imbin meigim detlot klaud jandimdan rein langa dijan graun.
“Wal main biginini, yu garra oldei jinggabat en dum ola gudwan klebabala ting. Nomo fogedabat detlot.
Jis laik wen yu werrimon det tjein langa yu nek blanga meigim yu luk brabli gudwan, wal lagijat du wen yu lisin en teiknodis langa ol dislot wed dei garra meigim yu jidan gudbalawei,
en yu garra jidan seifwan en najing kaan ardim yu.
Yu kaan bradin blanga enijing wen yu silip. Wen yu silip langa yu sweig yu garra silip brabli gudbalawei.
Yu kaan wori wen trabul kaman kwikbala langa yu, en yu kaan bradin wen detlot nogudbala ting kaman langa detlot nogudbala pipul,
dumaji YAWEI det trubala God na garra oldei maindimbat yu. Im na garra oldei lukaftumbat yu wulijim yu kaan git trep.
“Wal wen pipul wandim yu blanga album olabat yu garra duwit gudbinjiwei.
If yu fren askim yu blanga album im yu kaan dalim im, ‘Yu weit! Ai garra album yu tumorro.’ Nomo. Yu kaan tok lagijat. Yu garra duwit streidawei.
Yu nomo meigim plen blanga ardim yu fren. Im jidan gulijap langa yu en im oldei trastim yu.
Yu nomo agamin langa enibodi wen im nomo bin dum enijing blanga ardim yu.
Yu nomo git jelas langa enibodi hu oldei faitfaitbat, en yu nomo jidan wulijim olabat,
dumaji YAWEI nomo laigim detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat rong ting, bat im jidan fren langa detlot pipul hu oldei jidan trubalawei.
“Wal YAWEI garra tok brabli strongbala wed blanga meigim trabul blanga detlot nogudbala femili, bat im garra tok brabli gudbala wed blanga album detlot femili hu oldei dumbat ebrijing raitwei.
YAWEI nomo laigim detlot pipul hu oldei meigim miselp haibala, bat im jidan kainwan langa detlot pipul hu meigim miselp lobala.
Ola sabibala pipul garra jidan haibala, bat detlot nogudbala pipul garra jidan nogudbinji en dei garra jidan sheimwan du.”
Wal det sabibala bin kipgon tok, “Wal main biginini, yu garra lisin en teiknodis wanim yu dedi oldei dalimbat en lenimbat yu. If yu dum lagijat, wal yu garra sabi wanim mi titjimbat yu im brabli gudwan.
“Wal yu nomo fogedabat wanim mi oldei dalimbat yu du.
Wen aibin oni lilboi en oni san blanga main mami en dedi,
main dedi bin titjimbat mi. Imbin oldei tok, ‘Yu jinggabat en nomo fogedabat main wed. If yu kipum ol detlot wed wal yu garra jidan laibala.
Yu garra sabi en len mowa blanga ola gudwan klebabala ting. Yu nomo fogedabat en tjakidawei main wed.
Yu garra oldei jinggabat en teiknodis blanga det sabibalawei en im garra album yu. En if yu laigim im brabliwei, wal im garra kipum yu seifwan.
Blanga jidan sabibala im brabli speshalwan ting. Wal tharran na yu garra sabi. Im mobeda den enijing.
Wen yu jinggabat en laigim det sabibalawan im gin meigim yu jidan haibala.
Yu garra jidan haibala jis laik wen yu win det reis o pipul meigim yu jidan bos.’ Lagijat na main dedi bin tok wen aibin lilboi.
“Main biginini, yu lisin langa mi na en yu kipum ol detlot wed weya ai oldei dalimbat yu, wulijim yu garra jidan laibala longtaim.
Mi na bin shoumbat yu det sabibalawei en det raitwei blanga jidan gudbalawei.
Nomo enijing kaan stapam yu wen yu wok langa det sabibalawei, en nomo enijing kaan meigim yu buldan wen yu ran.
Yu garra oldei jinggabat wanim yubin len en yu nomo larramgo. Yu garra oldei kipum ol detlot wed yubin lenlenbat, dumaji olabat brabli speshalwan blanga yu laif.
Yu nomo bulurrum det wei blanga detlot nogudwan pipul, en yu nomo dum detlot nogudbala ting olabat dumbat.
Yu nomo bulurrum olabat wei. Yu go yu ronwei,
dumaji ola nogudbala pipul kaan silip raidap olabat dum det nogudbala ting en ardim sambodi.
Wen olabat oldei dumbat nogudbala ting en ardimbat pipul, wal tharran im jis laik det daga en dringk blanga olabat.
“Wal det wei blanga ola gudbala pipul im jis laik det san wen im gidap ailibala en im kipgon meigim ebrijing mowa braitwan.
Bat det wei blanga ola nogudbala pipul im jis laik wen olabat wokwok langa det dakbala roud naitaim en dei kaan luk wanim bin meigim olabat buldan.
“Main biginini, yu lisin en teiknodis langa main wed. Yu lisin brabli gudwei wanim mi dalimbat yu.
Yu nomo fogedabat main wed. Yu kipum holot insaid langa yu hat.
Dijan wed garra meigim yu jidan brabli gudwei en nomo garram siknis.
Yu garra wotjim wanim yu jinggabat, dumaji yu laif shoum wanim yu oldei jinggabat.
Yu nomo dalimbat laiya en yu nomo tok enijing blanga trikim enibodi.
Yu garra kipgon jinggabat ola trubalawan ting en nomo jidan sheimwan.
Yu garra oldei meigim plen blanga dum wanim rait, en im garra hepin lagijat na.
Yu nomo dum eni nogudbala ting. Yu garra dum ola gudbala ting.”
Wal det sabibala bin kipgon tok, “Main san, yu lisin en teiknodis langa main sabibalawei en brabli gudwan wed,
wulijim yu garra sabi hau blanga jidan gudwei, en enijing yu tok garra shoum najalot pipul yu sabibala.
Maitbi naja men waif mait tok langa yu garram brabli switbala wed jis laik shugabeig. Im switinimap yu brabliwei en im kiskisbat yu en meigim yu wandim im,
bat bambai na im garra libum yu en meigim yu jidan brabli nogudbinji garram loda pein.
Det gel garra lidim yu blanga dai. Det wei blanga im garra go streit langa greibyad.
Im nomo jinggabat blanga im laif, en im nomo sabi det wei weya im oldei bulurrumbat, im rong.
“Wal main san, yu lisin langa mi na. Yu nomo tjakidawei detlot wed weya aibin oldei dalimbat yu.
Yu kaan go gulijap langa detkain wuman. Yu nomo go gulijap langa det dowa langa im haus.
If yu go deya wal najalot pipul garra rabishim yu en olabat garra gedim det rispek yubin abum basdam, en maitbi det hasbinwan garra kilim yu ded wen yu stil yangbala.
En afta ola streinja pipul garra gajim yu ebrijing, nomeda yubin dum adwek blanga gajim detlot enijing, bat dei garra deigidawei detlot ebrijing na,
en yu garra kraikrai en abumbat loda pein en yu bodi garra binijap.
En yu garra tok, ‘Wotfo ai nomo bin len? Wotfo ai nomo bin larram det sambodi dalimbat mi blanga dum rait ting?
Ai nomo bin lisin langa ol main titja. Ai nomo bin teiknodis langa olabat.
En mi jidan lida langa olabat en mi sheim miselp na.’
“Wal yu garra laigim yu waif brabliwei en yu garra jidan trubalawei langa im.
Wal im brabli nogud blanga yu wen yu faindim biginini brom najawan gel.
Wen yu biginini olabat growap, yu wandim olabat blanga album yu, nomo detlot streinja pipul.
Yu garra jidan brabli hepiwan garram yu waif en jidan brabli gudbinjiwei garram im du.
Im brabli purdiwan gel jis laik det reinbo. Im laigim yu brabliwei, en larram im meigim yu jidan brabli hepiwan en im na garra oldei holdim yu gulijap.
Main boi, wotfo yu wandim gibit miselp langa najawan gel? Wotfo yu wandim silipsilipbat garram naja men waif?
YAWEI det trubala God oldei luk ebrijing yu dumbat en im oldei lukinat weya yu oldei go.
Det nogudbalawei blanga nogudbala pipul im laiga trep. Det nogudbalawei blanga olabat garra taiyimap olabat wulijim roup.
Olabat garra dai, dumaji olabat nomo bin sabi hau blanga jidan gudbalawei. Olabat nogudbalawei garra deigim olabat langa greib.”
Wal det sabibala bin kipgon tok, “Main biginini, yu garra wotjim miselp. Yu nomo meigim pramis blanga pei mani blanga det men hubin boro mani. Maitbi im kaan peiyimbek yu.
If yu meigim pramis lagijat langa enibodi, yu mait trepam yu ronselp garram yu ronwan wed.
Wen yu dum lagijat, wal det men garra jidan bos blanga yu na. Bat ai dalim yu hau blanga jidan friwan. Yu garra go kwikbala langa det men en yu garra askim im gudwei blanga larramgo yu fri brom det pramis weya yubin meigim garram im.
Yu nomo go en silip o abum spel.
Yu garra meigim miselp friwan brom det trep jis laik wen det bard o enimul gidawei brom det hanta.
“Wal ola leisibala pipul garra len brom detlot lilwan ent hau dei oldei jidan.
Detlot ent nomo garram eni bos o lida, najing,
bat hotwethataim olabat oldei pudumwei ola daga redibala blanga det kolwethataim.
Haulong det leisibala men garra silip? Wotaim im garra gidap brom silip?
Im tok, ‘Ai garra abum lilwan silip. Ai jis garra dabulumap main am dubala en abum spel na.’
Bat wen im silip, streidawei im garra jidan brabli powan na, jis laik sambodi bin stilimbat ola ebrijing brom im.
“Wal sambala pipul brabli wikitwan en dei oldei goran ebriweya en dalimbat laiya.
Dei oldei mubumbat olabat hed blanga meigim yu bilib, bat olabat laiya.
Olabat oldei jinggabat blanga meigimbat nogudwan plen blanga meigimbat trabul ebriweya.
Dumaji blanga tharran weya deibin dumbat, wal trabul garra kaman en binijimap olabat en olabat garra ardim en dei garra dai.
“Wal YAWEI nomo laigim dislot sebenbala ting na, det sambodi hu oldei luk praudbalawei, det mawus blanga sambodi hu oldei dalimbat laiya, det bingga blanga sambodi hu oldei kilimbat pipul hu nomo bin dum eni rong ting, det main blanga sambodi hu oldei jinggabat blanga meigimbat nogudbala plen, det dubala fut blanga sambodi hu oldei wandim dum nogudbala ting kwikbala, det witnis hu kipgon dalimbat laiya, en det sambodi hu meigimbat trabul blanga im femili o fren olabat.”
