Wal det sabibala bin kipgon tok, “Wal main san, yu garra dum wanim yu dedi oldei dalimbat yu, en yu nomo fogedabat wanim yu mami oldei titjimbat yu.
Yu garra jinggabat detlot wed olataim. Yu garra kipum detlot wed insaid langa yu hat olagijawan.
Detlot wed garra gaidim yu wen yu wokabat langa najawan pleis en dei garra lukaftum yu wen yu silip, en dei garra album yu wen yu wek deitaim.
Detlot wed jis laik det lemp blanga shoum yu det wei, en wen yu mami en dedi streitinimap yu, tharran garra album yu blanga dumbat gudbala ting.
“Wal detlot wed garra kipum yu brom ola nogudbala gel en brom najamen waif hu oldei tok garram brabli switwan wed blanga meigim yu gudbinji.
Yu nomo go langa im dumaji im brabli purdiwan. Yu nomo larram im trepam yu wen im oldei lukinatbat langa yu garram im ai.
Det men hu pei mani blanga silip garram eni gel garra faindim miselp powan, bat det men hu silipsilip garram merrit gel maitbi im garra pei garram im laif.
“Wal if yu garrimap brabli hotwan eshis langa yu briskit yu garra barnimap yu klos.
En if yu wok ontop langa hotwan eshis yu garra barnim yu dubala fut.
Wal seimwei lagijat du yu garra meigimbat trabul blanga yu ronselp wen yu silipsilipbat garram najamen waif. Wal if enibodi dum detkain ting, wal im garra abum panishmen.
“Wal pipul nomo heidimbat sambodi hu stilimbat enijing dumaji im hanggriwan,
bat if sambodi faindim im stilimbat, wal im garra lafta peibek sebentaim blanga wanim imbin stilimbat. Im garra gibit ol im ebrijing weya im garram.
“Wal eni men hu go en silipsilipbat garram najamen waif, im nomo sabi enijing. Im garra binijimap miselp.
Im garra sheim miselp en im garra gedim haiding en im garra jidan sheimwan olagijawan.
Det hasbin im gitwail brabliwei wen im jelas. Im kaan sori langa det najawan men.
Nomo enikain ting o mani garra meigim im sedisfaid! Im garra kipgon jidanbat wailwan!”
“Wal main biginini, yu jinggabat wanim aibin dalimbat yu, en yu nomo fogedabat wanim aibin dalimbat yu blanga dum.
Yu dum ebrijing aibin dalim yu en yu garra jidan laibala. Yu teiknodis langa detlot wed weya aibin titjimbat langa yu jis laik yu lukaftumbat yu ai dubala.
Yu kipgon jinggabat detlot wed en yu kipum insaid langa yu hat.
Yu garra laigim det sabibalawei brabliwei jis laik im yu ronwan sista, en det streitbala main jis laik yu ronwan fren.
Dei garra album yu blanga kipawei brom detlot gel hu nomo jidan trubalawei garram olabat hasbin en hu oldei tok garram ola switwan wed blanga meigim eni men gudbinji.”
Wal det sabibala bin kipgon tok, “Wandei aibin lukinatbat atsaid thru langa main windo brom main haus,
en aibin luk bigismob yangboi hu nomo sabi matj, en aibin luk wanbala deya hu nomo bin sabi eni klebabalawei.
Imbin wokwokbat langa det kona langa det roud weya bin go gulijap langa det haus blanga wanbala gel.
Imbin go gulijap langa det haus wen imbin naitaim na.
“Wal det wanbala gel bin kaman langa det men na. Imbin dresap wulijim gel hu oldei silipsilipbat garram eni men blanga mani en imbin meigimbat plen blanga trikim im.
Det gel bin brabli nogudbala gel en im nomo bin abum eni sheim. Imbin oldei wokwokbat langa detlot roud.
Det gel bin oldei weidabat blanga eni yangmen langa eni roud o langa makit pleis.
“Wal det gel bin grebum det yangmen en kis langa im, en im nomo bin sheim, najing. Imbin luk im streit langa im ai en imbin tok,
‘Ai garram det bifpat brom det sekrifais ofring langa main kemp,
en aibin kamat iya blanga lukabat yu, en aibin faindim yu iya.
Aibin gaburrumap main sweig garram det brabli purdiwan matiriyal brom Ijip.
Aibin meigim main sweig smel brabli gudwan garram detlot gudsmelwan medisin.
Yu kaman en yunmi go en silipsilip deya raidap ailibala. Yunmi meigim miselp gudbinji en abum gudtaim.
Main hasbin im nomo iya. Imbin gowei longwei langa najawan kantri.
Imbin gowei fo dubala wik, en imbin deigim loda mani.’
Lagijat na det gel bin tok garram switbala wed en imbin meigim det yangmen gudbinji, en imbin lidim det yangmen blanga dum rong ting.
“Wal streidawei det yangmen bin bulurrum det gel jis laik det buligi wen dei lidim im langa det pleis weya dei garra kilim im, o jis laik det enimul wen im git trep,
en sambodi shudum det erro thru langa im hat. Imbin git trep jis laik bard weya gowin langa det net. Im nomo bin sabi im laif langa deinja.
“Wal main san, yu lisin langa mi. Yu lisin en teiknodis wanim ai dalim yu.
Yu nomo larram detkain wuman trikimbat en teikoba yu. Yu nomo go en bulurrum im.
Imbin ardim loda gudbala men en imbin meigim bigismob men dai du.
If yu go langa im haus wal im jis laik yu go deya blanga dai. Det roud im det shotkat blanga dai en go langa det pleis weya ola dedbala pipul jidan.” Lagijat na det sabibala bin tok.
Wal det brabli sabibalawan im jis laik det wuman hu oldei jinginatbat.
Im jinginat ontop langa hil, en im jandap deya langa det roud weya jidan kroswei.
Im oldei jandapbat wansaid langa det geit blanga det taun en im oldei jinginat deya.
Im tok, “Mi na jinginat langa yumob. Mi jinginat langa ola pipul langa dijan wel.
Yumob stil jinggabat ebrijing jis laiga biginini. Yumob garra lafta growap. Yumob silibala pipul. Yu garra lafta len mowa blanga andasten brabliwei.
“Wal yumob lisin langa main brabli gudwan wed. Mi oldei dalimbat yumob blanga ola raitwan ting.
Wanim ai dalimbat yumob im brabli trubala. Ai nomo laigim detlot laiyawan wed.
Ebrijing mi oldei toktokbat im brabli trubala, en nomo laiyawan weya garra lidimbat yumob rongwei.
If yumob sabi brabliwei, yumob sabi main wed im brabli gudwan blanga yumob.
Yumob garra laigim main wed. Im mobeda den silba. En blanga jidan garram klebabala main, im mobeda den gol.
“Wal mi na brabli sabibala. Mi mobedawan langa detlot purdiwan ston, en mi mobedawan langa ol detlot enijing weya yumob wandimbat.
Mi na brabli sabibala, en mi sabi ebrijing. Ai garram brabli gudbala main en oldei gibit ebribodi feyago.
If yumob shoum rispek langa YAWEI en meigim im mowa haibala, wal yumob garra libum detlot nogudbalawei. Ai nomo laigim det praudbalawei, en ola laiyawan wed en ola nogudbala ting.
Ai meigim ola plen en ai kipum olataim. Ai garram brabli gudbala main en mi brabli strongbala du.
Mi oldei album ola king en ola lida olabat blanga jidan bos, en meigim ola gudwan lowa.
Mi na oldei album ola boswan blanga jidan bos, en album ola lida olabat du.
Ai laigim detlot pipul hu laigim mi, en detlot pipul hu lukabat mi, garra faindim mi.
Ai garra meigim pipul rispek langa yumob, en meigim yumob jidan ritjwan olataim. En ai garra meigim ebrijing hepin gudwei blanga yumob.
Wanim yu gajim brom mi, im mobedawan langa det brabli gudwan gol, en im mobedawan langa det brabli gudwan silba.
Mi oldei wok langa det raitwei. Mi bulurrum det gudwan roud weya gibit ebribodi feyago,
en mi oldei gibit main enijing langa detlot pipul hu laigim mi, en mi oldei bilimap olabat haus garram ola gudbala ting.
“Wal mi na bin jidan garram YAWEI wen imbin stat meigimbat dijan wel. Aibin iya longtaim bifo imbin meigim ebrijing.
Aibin jidan brom longtaim, bifo dijan wel bin jidan iya.
Aibin jidan bifo imbin meigim det solwoda, en wen nomo eni springwoda bin jidan.
Aibin bon bifo imbin meigim detlot bigwan en lilwan hil.
Aibin jidan bifo imbin meigim dijan wel en fam en dijan graun.
Aibin deya wen imbin pudum det skai deya langa top, en wen imbin pudum det mak weya det skai en kantri en solwoda jidan.
Aibin deya wen imbin meigim detlot klaud langa top, en wen imbin meigim det solwoda kamat.
Aibin deya wen imbin dalim det solwoda nomo blanga pasim det mak, en aibin deya wen imbin meigim det draiwan graun.
Aibin deya wansaid langa im, jis laik det men weya oldei meigim det plen hau blanga bildimap haus. Aibin oldei meigim im gudbinji ebridei, en aibin brabli gudbinji blanga jidanbat garram im.
Aibin jidan brabli hepiwan langa dijan wel, en aibin brabli gudbinji garram ola pipul.
“Orait ol yumob yangmen, yumob garra lisin langa mi na. Yumob dum wanim mi dalimbat yumob blanga dum, wulijim yumob garra jidan hepiwan.
Yumob garra teiknodis wanim yumob bin len. Yumob garra len hau blanga jidan gudwei, en nomo gibit bekboun langa detlot wed.
Det men hu oldei jandap en weidabat blanga mi langa main dowa en lisin langa mi, im na garra jidan brabli hepiwan.
Det men hu faindim mi, garra jidan garram gudwan laif, en YAWEI garra gudbinji garram im.
Det men hu nomo laigim mi garra abumbat loda pein. Enibodi hu nomo laigim mi garra dai.” Lagijat na det brabli sabibalawan bin tok.
Wal det brabli sabibalawan im jis laik det wuman hubin bildimap brabli bigwan haus garram sebenbala purdiwan pos.
Imbin kilim enimul en miksimap olkain wain en pudum ola daga en wain ontop langa det teibul redibala.
En imbin olredi jandimat ol im wekingel blanga jingat brom ontop blanga det brabli haibala pleis langa det taun.
En deibin jingat langa detlot pipul hu nomo sabi brabliwei, “Kaman langa det haus blanga det brabli sabibalawan.” En deibin jingat langa ola silibala pipul,
“Yumob kaman iya en dagat dislot daga en dringgim det wain weya wibin meigim redibala.
Yumob stap dumbat nogudbala ting wulijim yumob garra jidan gudwei. Yumob nomo kopikopibat najalot pipul en yumob garra sabi blanga ola gudbala ting.” Lagijat na ola wekingel bin jinginatbat.
Wal det sabibala tok dijan, “If yu trai en dalim sambodi hu oldei meigim fan langa det gudwan wed, wal im garra tokbek langa yu garram nogudbala wed, en if yu trai blanga tok gudwei langa det nogudbala men, wal im garra meigim yu nogudbinji.
Yu nomo tok blanga streitinimap detkain pipul hu oldei dum nogudbala ting. Olabat kaan laigim yu blanga tharran en olabat garra heidim yu na. Bat if yu go en tok blanga streitinimap det men hu sabi en hu garram gudwan main, wal im garra rispek yu.
Wen yu go en tok langa det men hu sabi, wal im garra jidan mowa sabibala. En wen yu go en titjimbat det gudwan men, im garra len mowa brom yu.
“If yu wandim jidan sabibala, yu garra abum rispek en teiknodis langa YAWEI det trubala God basdam. If yu sabi det Holiwan God, yu jidan mowa sabibala langa yu main.
If yu bulurrum det brabli sabibalawan, wal yu garra jidan laibala longtaim.
Wen yu abum det sabibalawei langa yu laif, wal yu garra abum ola gudwan ting, bat if yu meigim fan langa det sabibalawei, wal yu garra ardimbat detmatj.” Lagijat na det sabibala bin tok.
Wal det brabli silibalawan im jis laik det gel weya jinginatbat adbala, dumaji im nomo sheim. Im nomo sabi enijing.
Im oldei jidan rait langa det dowawei langa im haus o ontop langa det brabli haibala pleis langa det taun,
en im oldei jinginatbat langa detlot pipul hu oldei wokpas en hu oldei go olabat ronwei en nomo jinggabat enijing.
Im tok, “Yumob kaman iya langa mi, yumob pipul hu nomo sabi matj.” En langa ola silibala pipul im tok,
“Wen yu stilim woda im teist brabli switwan, en wen yu stilim daga, im teist mobedawan.” Lagijat na det brabli silibalawan bin tok.
Bat dislot pipul nomo sabi dei garra dai wen dei go deya langa im haus. Olabat nomo sabi detlot pipul hubin go deya bifo bin git trep en olabat deya langa det pleis weya ola dedbala pipul oldei go.
Wal dislot na ola brabli gudwan wed blanga King Salaman. Det sabibala biginini oldei meigim im dedi jidan brabli hepiwan, bat det silibala biginini im meigim im mami brabli nogudbinji.
Enibodi hu oldei gajimbat mani nogudbalawei kaan jidan gudwei, bat detlot pipul hu jidan raitwei, tharran na garra seibum yu.
Wal detlot pipul hu oldei jidan gudbalawei, YAWEI det trubala God kaan larram olabat jidan hanggriwan. En im kaan larram detlot nogudwan pipul abum wanim olabat wandim.
Wen enibodi jidan leisiwan wal im garra jidan brabli powan, bat det men hu oldei dumbat adwek garra jidan brabli ritjwan.
Det men hu go en gajimbat detlot sid daga wen dei redi, wal im brabli sabibala, bat det men hu silip oldei en nomo dum eni wek, wal im brabli silibala.
Sambala pipul garra tok gudbala wed langa detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat ola rait ting bat detlot pipul hu oldei toktok nogudbala wed, wal dei jidan brabli krulbala insaidwei.
Pipul garra kipgon jinggabat detlot gudbala pipul olataim, bat dei kaan jinggabat detlot nogudbala pipul enimo.
Det sabibala men oldei duwit langa ola gudwan wed, bat detlot pipul hu toktok silibalawei garra ol binijap.
Detlot pipul hu jidan trubalawei garra jidan seifwan weya najing kaan ardim olabat, bat detlot pipul hu nomo jidan trubalawei garra faindim miselp langa trep.
Wen enibodi nomo tok trubalawei im meigim trabul, bat wen enibodi toktokbat trubala wed streidat, wal im meigim ebrijing wek gudwei.
Det wed blanga det gudbala men im jis laik det woda weya yu dringgim weya meigim yu jidan laibala, bat det wed blanga det nogudbala men im rabishwan en jigibala.
If yu heidim sambodi wal yu meigim trabul kamat, bat if yu laigim enibodi wal yu garra larramgo im fri brom det rong ting weya imbin dum.
Detlot sabibala pipul tok gudbalawei, bat detlot pipul hu nomo sabi enijing garra abum panishmen.
Detlot pipul hu jidan sabibala, olabat kipgon lenlenbat mowa, bat wen detlot silibala pipul toktok trabul garra kaman.
Wen yu jidan ritjwan, tharran gin lukaftum yu olataim, bat wen yu jidan powan, tharran gin binijimap yu.
Detlot pipul hu dumbat gudbala ting garra abum brabli gudbala laif, bat detlot nogudbala ting meigim yu dumbat mowa nogudbala ting.
Detlot pipul hu irrim en teiknodis en dum ola rait ting, wal dei garra jidan laibala, bat detlot hu nomo teiknodis en nomo onap blanga olabat rongwei, wal dei garra faindim miselp langa deinja.
Det men hu heidim sambodi bat tok im nomo heidim det sambodi, wal im dalimbat laiya. En if enibodi deigimbat yan, wal im brabli siliwan.
If yu toktokbat oldei, wal yu garra faindim miselp dumbat nogudbala ting. If yu garram gudbala main, wal yu garra jidan kwaitbala.
Det wed blanga brabli gudwan men im jis laik det brabli gudwan silba, bat wen det nogudwan men oldei jinggabat detlot nogudbalawei dei nomo enijing.
Det wed blanga gudbala men garra album najalot pipul, bat yu gin dai brom dumbat ola nogudbala ting.
Wen YAWEI albumbat yu im meigimbat yu jidan gudwei garram olkain gudwan ting. Ola adwan wek kaan meigim yu jidan mowa gudwan.
Yu granggibala if yu gudbinji blanga dumbat nogudwan ting, bat ola gudbala pipul oldei gudbinji blanga dumbat ola gudbala en sabiwan ting.
Det gudbala men garra gedim ola gudbala ting weya im wandim, bat det nogudbala men garra gedim det ting weya meigim im jidan brabli bradinwan.
Brabli strongbala rein garra kaman en blowimwei detlot nogudbala pipul, bat detlot gudbala pipul garra oldei jidan langa seifwan pleis.
Nomo askimbat leisiwan men blanga dum samting blanga yu. Im garra oni meigim trabul blanga yu, jis laik smok jidan langa yu dubala ai o biniga jidan langa yu tuth.
Detlot pipul hu oldei teiknodis en shoum rispek langa YAWEI garra jidan laibala longtaim, bat detlot nogudbala pipul hu nomo teiknodis langa YAWEI olabat garra abum shotwan laif.
Det gudwan men garra jidan brabli hepiwan, bat det nogudbala men kaan abum gudbala taim, najing.
Wal YAWEI garra oldei maindimbat detlot gudbala pipul, bat im garra binijimap detlot nogudbala pipul hu oldei dumbat ola rong ting.
Ola gudbala pipul garra oldei jidanbat seifwan, bat detlot nogudbala pipul kaan jidan laibala langa olabat kantri.
Detlot gudbala pipul bin oldei toktokbat ola sabibala wed, bat detlot pipul hu oldei dalimbat laiya garra abum panishmen.
Ola gudbala pipul oldei sabi toktok blanga olkain gudbala wed, bat detlot nogudbala pipul oldei toktok ola wed blanga ardimbat pipul.
Wal YAWEI det trubala God nomo laigim enibodi hu tjidimbat pipul, en im nomo laigim enibodi hu oldei yusumbat laiyawan skeil, bat im oldei gudbinji langa detlot pipul hu oldei yusumbat skeil gudwei.
Detlot pipul hu oldei jidan praudbalawei garra jidan sheimwan bambai. Wal im mobeda blanga jidan lobala.
Det trubalawei garra gaidim yu, bat detlot laiyawan pipul garra binijap, dumaji nobodi nomo trastim olabat.
Wen yu redi blanga dai, detlot ebrijing blanga yu kaan album yu, bat wen yu dumbat ola raitwan ting wal tharran na gin seibum yu.
Det gudbala men garra abum brabli isiwan laif wen im dum ola raitwan ting, bat det wikitwan men garra binijap brom im ronwan wikitbalawei.
Detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat ola rait ting, garra jidan seifwan, bat detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat nogudbala ting garra trepam miselp garram olabat ron nogudbalawei.
Wen wikitwan pipul jidan laibala dei reken nomo enijing garra hepin langa olabat dumaji deibin oldei trastimbat ola ebrijing, bat wen olabat dai, ol detlot ting nomo bin album olabat.
Wal gudbala pipul nomo abumbat trabul en dei jidan seifwan, bat ola wikitwan pipul oldei abumbat trabul.
Ola nogudbala wed weya nogudbala pipul toktok garra meigim trabul blanga yu, bat det sabibala wed brom gudbala pipul garra seibum yu.
Wen ola gudwan pipul dum enijing brabli gudwei, en wen nogudbala pipul dai, detlot pipul langa det taun jidan hepiwan en jinginatbat gudbinjiwei.
Ola gudbala pipul meigim olabat taun jidan gudwan, bat wen ola nogudbala pipul tok nogudwan wed dei meigim det taun jidan rabishwan.
Im siliwan blanga tok nogudbalawei blanga enibodi. If yu garram gudwan main, wal yu garra jidan kwaitbala.
Enibodi hu oldei deigimbat yan kaan kipum eni wed sigrid, bat det men weya jidan trubalawei garra kipum det wed sigridwan.
Detlot solja garra bidim detlot pipul hu nomo garram sabibala lida, bat wen olabat abum bigismob sabibala lida, dei garra jidan seifwan.
If sambodi meigim pramis blanga pei wanim najamen owim, wal im garra abum adtaim. Nomo meigim eni pramis lagijat.
Pipul garra shoum rispek langa det wuman hu oldei kain en albumbat enibodi, bat dei kaan shoum rispek langa det nogudwan wuman. Det leisibala men kaan abum eni mani, bat det men hu dumbat adwek garra jidan ritjwan.
Im brabli gud ting blanga yu ronselp wen yu dumbat ola kainbala ting langa enibodi, bat wen enibodi dumbat krulbala ting langa enibodi wal im meigim trabul kambek langa im ronselp.
Det wikitbala men kaan gedim enijing nomeda imbin trai wek brabli adbala blanga gajim im enijing, bat detlot pipul hu dumbat rait ting garra gedim gudwan ebrijing.
Detlot pipul hu oldei jidan trubalawei garra jidan laibala, bat detlot pipul hu oldei laigim dumbat nogudbala ting garra ol binijap.
Wal YAWEI nomo laigim detkain pipul hu oldei jinggabat nogudwei, bat im oldei gudbinji langa detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat ola raitwan ting.
Yu sabi detlot nogudbala pipul garra git panish, bat detlot pipul hu oldei dum ola rait ting kaan git panish.
If det brabli purdiwan gel nomo sabi enijing, wal im jis laik sambodi hu weistim golwan ring wen im pudum langa bigibigi nos.
Detlot pipul hu oldei jinggabat gudwei meigim gudbala ting hepin trubala, bat God garra binijimap detlot nogudbala pipul, dumaji olabat oldei meigimbat plen blanga dum ola nogudwan ting.
Sambala pipul oldei gibitbat olabat mani blanga albumbat najalot pipul en olabat jidan mowa ritjwan, bat najalot pipul nomo albumbat enibodi en olabat jidan mowa powan.
If yu gibit enijing langa najalot pipul wal yu garra jidan brabli ritjwan en if enibodi albumbat najalot pipul wal sambodi garra album im du.
Wal pipul oldei tok nogudbalawei langa detlot pipul hu kipum olabat sid daga blanga selim bambai blanga gedim mowa mani, bat dei oldei tok gudwei langa detlot pipul hu selimbat olabat sid daga streidawei.
If yu oldei trai dumbat ola gudbala ting pipul garra shoum rispek langa yu, bat if yu oldei lukabat blanga trabul, wal yu garra abum bigiswan trabul.
Detlot pipul hu oldei laigim jidanbat ritjwan olataim garra buldan jis laik ola lif weya oldei buldan olataim, bat detlot gudbala pipul garra jidan gudbalawei jis laik detlot grinwan bushis weya kamat rein taim.
Det sambodi hu oldei meigimbat trabul langa im femilimob garra jidan nomo garram enijing, en det silibala men garra jidan prisana blanga detlot sabibala men.
Wen pipul dumbat ola raitwan ting wal olabat garra jidan laibala, bat if pipul faitfaitbat en meigimbat trabul wal loda pipul garra binijap.
Detlot gudbala pipul garra gedim gudwan prais langa dijan wel, en detlot nogudbala pipul garra git panish blanga olabat nogudbalawei.
Enibodi hu sabi ebrijing en laigim len mowa, wal wen pipul dalim im wanim rong, wal im garra gudbinji, bat if im dum samting rong im rili siliwan if im nomo laigim det sambodi hu dalimbat im wanim imbin dum rong.
Wal YAWEI det trubala God im brabli gudbinji langa gudbala pipul, bat im garra panishim detlot pipul hu oldei meigimbat plen blanga dum ola nogudwan ting.
Detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat ola nogudwan ting kaan jidan gudbalawei, bat detlot pipul hu oldei dum gudbala ting garra jidan gudwei en brabli strongbala.
Det gel hu jidan brabli gudwei meigim im hasbin brabli gudbinji, bat det gel hu nomo jidan gudwei meigim im hasbin brabli nogudbinji en im jis laik det nogudwan siknis weya kamat langa boun.
Detlot gudbala pipul oldei gibit feyago langa najalot pipul, bat detlot wikitwan pipul oldei meigimbat plen blanga trikimbat pipul.
Detlot wikitwan pipul oldei tok blanga kilimbat pipul, bat detlot wed blanga ola gudwan pipul oldei seibum detlot pipul hu abumbat trabul.
Ol detlot wikitwan pipul oldei daidaibat en dei nomo libum eni femili biyain, bat detlot gudbala men femili kipgon jidanbat laibala.
If yu garram gudwan main en jinggabat blanga dumbat ola gudwan ting, wal pipul garra tok gudbala wed blanga yu, bat det men hu oldei jinggabat en dumbat ola nogudwan ting, wal nobodi kaan rispek langa im.
Im mobeda blanga jidan wekinmen en abum loda daga den jidan laiga haibala men en nomo garram eni daga.
Detlot gudbala pipul oldei lukaftumbat olabat enimulmob gudwei, bat detlot wikitwan pipul oldei dumbat krulbala ting langa olabat enimulmob.
Detlot pipul hu oldei wekwekbat langa olabat fam garra abum bigismob daga, bat detlot pipul hu oldei drimdrimbat blanga olkain ting, olabat siliwan langa olabat main.
Detlot nogudbala pipul oldei wandim dumbat ola nogud ting, bat detlot gudbala pipul oldei wandim dumbat ola gudbala ting blanga jidan strongbala.
Detlot nogudwan pipul oldei trepam miselp garram olabat ronwan nogudbala wed, bat ola pipul hu jidan trubalawei oldei deigimat miselp brom eni trabul.
If enibodi dumbat gudbala ting im garra gedim gudbala prais, bat if enibodi dumbat nogudbala ting im garra abum panishmen.
Detlot silibala pipul oldei reken olabat oldei dumbat ola rait ting, bat detlot sabibala pipul oldei lisin langa ola gudbala wed blanga enibodi.
Wen det silibala men jidan apset, im dalim ebribodi kwikbalawei garram im ekshan, bat pipul hu garram gudbala main nomo teiknodis langa nogudbala wed.
Wen yu tok trubalawan wed blanga enijing, yu meigim ebrijing jidan gudwei, bat wen yu dalimbat laiyawan wed, yu meigim ebrijing go nogudwan.
Wen yu tok nogudbalawei, wal im ardim yu jis laik bigwan naif kadim yu, bat wen yu tok gudbala wed wal im album yu en meigim yu fil gudwan.
Det trubala wed garra jidan olagijawan, bat det laiyawan wed garra binij kwikbala.
Detlot pipul hu oldei meigimbat nogudwan plen garra hatjamp wen olabat garra sabi wanim garra hepin langa olabat bambai, bat detlot pipul hu oldei meigimbat gudwan plen garra jidan brabli hepi.
Nomo enijing kaan ardim detlot gudbala men, bat detlot nogudwan men garra abumbat loda trabul.
Wal YAWEI nomo laigim detlot pipul hu oldei dalimbat laiya, bat im oldei gudbinji langa detlot pipul hu oldei kipum detlot wed wen dei meigim pramis.
Detlot sabibala pipul nomo toktok blanga wanim olabat sabi, bat detlot nogudbala pipul oldei shoumbat ola nogudwan ting dei oldei dumbat.
Detlot pipul hu dumbat adwek garra jidan garram pawa, bat detlot pipul hu jidanbat leisibala garra oldei dumbat rabishwan wek.
Wen yu wori olataim im meigim yu nogudbinji, bat det brabli kainbala wed garra meigim yu gudbinji.
Detlot pipul hu jidan raitwei oldei album olabat fren, bat det wei blanga nogudwan pipul garra meigim olabat dum ola rong ting.
If yu jidan leisiwan en nomo dum eni wek wal yu kaan gedim det ting weya yu wandim, bat if yu dumbat wek yu garra gedim ola gudbala ting weya yu wandim.
Det gudbalawei im deigim yu langa det roud blanga laif, bat det nogudbalawei im deigim yu langa det roud blanga dai.
Detlot gudbala biginini oldei lisin en teiknodis wanim olabat dedi dalim olabat blanga dum, bat najalot biginini meigim fan langa det gudbala wed en dei kaan lisin.
Detlot pipul hu oldei tok gudwei langa enibodi garra gedim ola gudbala ting, bat detlot pipul hu oldei trikimbat enibodi oldei wandim meigimbat trabul.
Yu garra jinggabat gudwei wanim blanga tok blanga lukaftum yu laif, dumaji enibodi hu tok enijing eniweya en nomo jinggabat garra oni binijimap im laif.
Detlot pipul hu jidanbat leisiwan en nomo dumbat wek kaan gajim enijing nomeda haumatj dei wandim det ting, bat detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat wek garra gajim bigismob enijing dei wandim.
Ola gudbala pipul nomo laigim ola laiyawan wed, bat ola wed blanga ola wikitwan pipul oldei meigim olabat jidan brabli sheimwan.
Detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat ola raitwan ting garra jidan seifwan, bat detlot nogudbala pipul hu oldei dumbat rong ting garra dai.
Sambala pipul reken dei jidan ritjwan, bat dei nomo abum enijing, en sambala pipul reken dei powan, bat dei abum blendibala ebrijing.
If sambodi go en grebum en deigidawei wanbala ritjmen, en brom deya im askim im femili blanga pei bigismob mani, wal im femili garra lafta pei blanga seibum im laif, bat nobodi nomo dum lagijat langa ola po pipul dumaji olabat nomo garram eni mani.
Detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat raitwan ting garra jidan jis laik det brabli braitwan lait, en detlot wikitwan pipul garra jidan jis laik det faiya weya barnbarn en binij.
Detlot pipul hu nomo wandi lisin en hu oldei laigim agamin garram enibodi, oldei meigimbat trabul, bat detlot pipul hu oldei teiknodis en lisin langa ola gudbala wed garra jidan klebawan.
Enibodi hu gedim mani isiwei garra lujim det mani streidawei, bat enibodi hu gedim mani brom dumbat wek garra abum loda mani.
Yu fil brabli nogud insaid wen yu nomo garram detlot enijing weya yu wandim, bat wen yu wandim det samting en im hepin trubala, wal im meigim yu brabli gudbinji.
If yu nomo laigim lisin en teiknodis langa ola gudwan wed weya garra album yu, wal yu garra faindim miselp langa trabul, bat if yu teiknodis en duwit, wal yu garra jidan seifwan.
Detlot gudbala wed weya detlot sabibalamen titjimbat yu jidan jis laik det woda weya seibum yu laif, en detlot gudbala wed na garra album yu en kipum yu seifwan.
Pipul garra shoum rispek langa detlot pipul hu sabi en andasten ebrijing, bat detlot pipul hu trikimbat pipul dei bulurrum det roud weya garra binijimap olabat laif.
Detlot klebabala pipul oldei jinggabat wanim dei garra dum bifo dei dum det ekshan, bat detlot granggibala pipul kipgon dumbat ola nogudbala ting.
Detlot mesinja weya yu kaan trastim oldei meigimbat trabul, bat detlot pipul weya yu trastim oldei meigim ebrijing jidan gudwei.
Detlot pipul hu nomo laigim len ola raitwan ting garra jidan brabli sheimwan en brabli powan, bat pipul garra rispek detlot pipul hu oldei lisin wen enibodi streitinimap olabat.
Im rili gud blanga gedim wanim yu wandim, bat detlot silibala pipul kaan stap dumbat ola nogudbala ting.
Enibodi hu laigim jidanbat garram ola sabibala pipul garra jidan sabibala du, bat if enibodi jidan fren garram detlot silibala pipul, wal im garra abum trabul.
Ola nogudbala pipul oldei abumbat trabul ebriweya, bat detlot gudbala pipul garra oldei jidan gudbinjiwei nomo garram eni trabul.
Det gudbala men garra libum ola ebrijing blanga im langa ol im grenkid, en det gudbala men garra gajim ebrijing blanga det nogudwan men wen im dai.
Sambala pipul nomo gibit feyago langa ola po pipul blanga growimap daga langa detlot gudbala graun langa detlot pedik weya olabat nomo yusumbat.
If yu nomo streitinimap yu bigininimob wal yu nomo laigim olabat, bat if yu laigim yu bigininimob brabliwei wal yu garra streitinimap olabat.
Ola gudbala pipul oldei abum loda daga, bat detlot wikitwan pipul oldei jidan hanggriwan, nomo garram eni daga.
Det sabibala wuman meigim im femilimob jidan strongbala, bat det silibala wuman gin meigim trabul blanga im femilimob en tridim olabat nogudbalawei.
If yu jidan trubalawei yu shoum yu garram loda rispek blanga YAWEI det trubala God, bat if yu nomo jidan trubalawei wal yu shoum yu nomo garram eni rispek blanga YAWEI.
Det praudbalawei blanga silibala pipul meigim olabat tok olkain siliwan ting en bambai dei garra abum trabul, bat det wed blanga sabibala pipul meigim olabat jidan seifwan.
If yu nomo abum eni buligi blanga wek langa yu fam wal yu kaan abum eni daga, bat if yu garram buligi wal yu garra abum loda sid daga langa yu stowa rum.
Detlot pipul hu jidan trubalawei kaan dalimbat laiya langa det kothaus, bat detlot pipul hu nomo jidan trubalawei oldei dalimbat laiya langa det kothaus.
Detlot pipul hu oldei meigimbat fan langa pipul kaan neba len en sabi det gudbalawei, bat detlot pipul hu jidan trubalawei len en sabi ebrijing isibalawei.
Yu nomo bulurrumbat detlot silibala pipul, dumaji dei kaan titjim yu eni gudwan ting.
Klebabala pipul oldei sabi wanim blanga dum, but silibala pipul reken dei sabi ebrijing, bat najing.
Detlot silibala pipul nomo wori wen dei dum olkain nogudbala ting, bat God im oldei gudbinji langa detlot pipul hu wandim jidan friwan brom olabat nogudbalawei.
Wen yu nogudbinji o wen yu gudbinji det filing im blanga yuselp, en nobodi kaan abum det seimwan filing.
Det haus blanga det gudbala men garra jandap strongbala, bat det haus blanga det nogudbala men garra binijap.
Sambala pipul reken dei oldei dum ola raitwan ting, bat najing. Olabat rong, en tharran na garra binijimap olabat.
Wen enibodi laflafbat im fil gudbinji, bat wen det gudbala filing binij, det wori stil jidan deya.
Detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat nogudwan ting garra git panish, en detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat gudbala ting garra gajim ola gudwan ting.
Detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat silibala ting bilib langa enijing, bat detlot sabibala pipul oldei jinggabat wanim dei garra dum.
Detlot pipul weya sabi ebrijing oldei wotjim miselp en dei kipawei brom trabul, bat detlot silibala pipul nomo jinggabat enijing en oldei dum siliwan ting.
Detlot pipul hu oldei gitwail kwikbala oldei dumbat siliwan ting, bat detlot pipul hu sabibala, jidan kwaitbala.
Detlot pipul hu nomo sabi enijing kaan gajim enijing, dumaji dei oldei dumbat ola siliwan ting, bat detlot sabibala pipul garra sabi mowa, dumaji dei oldei dumbat ola gudwan ting.

Enibodi hu sabi blanga dum ola gudbala ting garra gajim gudbala ting, bat detlot silibala pipul garra oldei jidan siliwan.
Det witnis hu oldei toktok trubalawei langa kothaus gin seibum enibodi, bat det witnis hu oldei dalimbat laiya langa kothaus meigim trabul blanga pipul.
Enibodi hu shoum rispek langa YAWEI garra jidan gudbalawei en im bigininimob garra jidan seifwan du.
Enibodi hu shoum rispek langa YAWEI garra jidan laibala. Im jis laik wen yu dringgimbat woda en im seibum yu wulijim yu kaan dai.
Det king gin jidan haibala bos if im bos blanga bigismob pipul, bat im kaan jidan haibala if oni lilbit pipul jidan deya.
Enibodi hu nomo gitwail kwikbala langa sambodi, wal im jidan sabibala, bat det sambodi hu gitwail streidawei wen enibodi tok langa im, wal im garram siliwan main.
Enibodi hu garram gudbala main jidan garram gudwan bodi, bat if enibodi oldei jelas, wal im jis laiga nogudwan siknis insaid langa im bodi.
Enibodi hu dum krulbala ting langa ola powan pipul, im nomo shoum rispek langa God hubin meigim olabat, bat det men hu kain langa enibodi, wal im jis laik im weshipbat God wen im dum lagijat.
Detlot wikitwan pipul garra dai brom olabat ronwan nogudbalawei, bat detlot pipul hu oldei dumbat ola gudbala ting garra jidan seifwan.
Detlot pipul hu sabi ebrijing jidan brabli sabibala, bat detlot silibala pipul nomo sabi enijing.

Det gudbala wed im gibit wi laif, bat det nogudwan wed im meigim wi fil nogud insaid.
Im nogud blanga yu if yu nomo teiknodis langa yu dedi en mami, bat im gud if yu dum wanim dubala dalim yu.
Ola gudbala pipul garra abum loda ebrijing langa olabat haus, bat detlot nogudbala pipul garra lujim olabat ebrijing wen dei abum trabul.
Detlot sabibala pipul oldei go en spredimatbat sabibala wed, bat detlot silibala pipul nomo dum lagijat, najing.

YAWEI nomo laigim detlot nogudbala pipul hu oldei dumbat ola nogudbala ting, bat im laigim detlot hu oldei dumbat ola gudbala ting.
Detlot pipul hu nomo dumbat ola rait ting garra git panish, bat detlot pipul hu nomo wandim enibodi blanga streitinimap olabat garra dai.
Wal YAWEI sabi ebrijing langa det pleis weya ola dedwan pipul oldei jidan en im sabi blanga detlot pipul hu stil jidan laibala, en wanim olabat oldei jinggabat.
Enibodi hu meigimbat fan langa enibodi, nomo laigim wen sambodi dalim im, im rong. Dei nomo askimbat sabibala pipul blanga album olabat.
Wen yu jidan brabli hepiwan, wal yu luk hepiwan, bat wen yu jidan sedwan, wal yu luk brabli sedwan.
Pipul hu wandim jidan brabli sabibala oldei wandim len mowa blanga dum ola sabibala ting, bat detlot silibala pipul kipgon dumbat silibala ting.

Im mobeda yu jidan powan en shoum rispek langa YAWEI den yu jidan ritjwan en abum loda trabul.
Im mobeda yu dagadagat difrinwan daga garram detlot pipul hu laigim yu den blanga dagat bif garram detlot pipul hu nomo laigim yu.

Detlot pipul hu nomo sabi ola gudbala ting laigim dumbat ola silibala ting, bat detlot pipul hu jidan sabibala oldei dum ola rait ting.

YAWEI kaan lisin langa detlot wikitwan pipul, bat im oldei lisin langa detlot gudbala pipul hu oldei preipreibat en hu dumbat ola rait ting.

If yu lisin wen enibodi streitinimap yu, wal yu garra jidan mowa sabibala.

YAWEI nomo laigim detlot pipul hu oldei jidan praudbalawei, en olabat garra abum panishmen.

Det wed blanga king im garram detmatj pawa, en det wed weya im tok garra hepin.
YAWEI wandim ebribodi blanga dum ebrijing trubalawei en nomo tjidimbat enibodi, jis laik det trubala skeil weya weiyimbat enijing en dalim hau hebi det ting jidan.
